```text
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent stdlib execution of frozen mapping data against source context.

Goldens are a read-only comparison input loaded only after construction. This
module imports no application, current design validator, resource builder,
synthetic harness, generated graph, SQL, or calibration enumerator. Missing
typed selectors and anchors are named baseline failures. No retained source
join is silently supplied to complete an under-specified mapping.
"""
import argparse
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
IMPORT_ALLOWLIST=('argparse','ast','copy','hashlib','importlib.util','json','pathlib','sys')
SOURCE_SHA='96caa6275e23b42954ce6ae687787aa978e0863ab0de4d5bd4c39e3d1fe98390'
FIXTURE_SHA='0209d1b1227cb4a9d637fd265b8afdbb5183f3755f30618831ec6dfc9d9a5bb2'
GOLDEN_SHA='abc00a1bfe25e8e9cfc7a3e76c40c7074dc94a910d9d7f566e7345850e2c4b5b'
VERSION='paprnav-ad-v4-independent-semantic-interpreter-2'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('independent_source_validator',HERE/'acceptance-source-validator.py')
source=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules[spec.name]=source
spec.loader.exec_module(source)
bootstrap_spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('independent_bootstrap_ast',HERE/'acceptance-bootstrap-ast-executor.py')
bootstrap=importlib.util.module_from_spec(bootstrap_spec)
sys.modules[bootstrap_spec.name]=bootstrap
bootstrap_spec.loader.exec_module(bootstrap)
J=source.canonical_bytes
C='candidate_only'; H='human_determination_required'
RANK={C:0,H:1}
SOURCE_FIELDS='slice projectionId proposalId id identityHash nodeType nodeKey sourcePointer parentNodeId canonicalOrdinal canonicalNodeHash createdAt'.split()

class OracleError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self,code,detail): self.code=code; self.detail=detail; super().__init__(code)

def digest(value): return hashlib.sha256(J(value)).hexdigest()
def sha(path): return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(path): return source.read_json(path)
def pointer(value,path):
    if path in ('','/'): return value
    for part in path.lstrip('/').split('/'):
        key=part.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
        value=value[int(key)] if type(value) is list else value[key]
    return value
def row_hash(slice_name,table,identity):
    domain=b'paprnav:ad_extraction_v4:applicability-row:2\0' if slice_name=='slice_3a' else b'paprnav:ad_extraction_v4:obligation-row:1\0'
    return hashlib.sha256(domain+J({'table':table,'identity':identity})).hexdigest()
def unique_index(rows,key,code='DUPLICATE_ROW_IDENTITY'):
    result={}
    for row in rows:
        identity=key(row)
        if identity in result: raise OracleError(code,{'identity':identity,'rows':[result[identity],row]})
        result[identity]=row
    return result

def predicate(rule,owner,raw,parent=None):
    op=rule['op']; field=rule.get('field'); value=owner.get(field)
    if op=='true': return True
    if op=='false': return False
    if op in ('eq','in'): return any(source.exact_equal(value,v) for v in rule['values'])
    if op=='all': return all(predicate(t,owner,raw,parent) for t in rule['terms'])
    if op=='any': return any(predicate(t,owner,raw,parent) for t in rule['terms'])
    if op in ('property_present','property_absent'):
        present=type(raw) is dict and rule['property'] in raw
        return present if op=='property_present' else not present
    if op in ('field_eq','field_in'): return value==rule['value'] if op=='field_eq' else value in rule['values']
    if op in ('fields','not_fields'):
        matched=all(owner.get(k) in v for k,v in rule['fields'].items())
        return matched if op=='fields' else not matched
    if op in ('parent_fields','parent_fields_not'):
        matched=all((parent or {}).get(k)==v for k,v in rule['fields'].items())
        return matched if op=='parent_fields' else not matched
    raise OracleError('MAPPING_UNKNOWN_PREDICATE',rule)

class Interpreter:
    def __init__(self,fixture,mapping,validator):
        self.fixture=fixture; self.mapping=mapping; self.validator=validator
        self.context=fixture['context']; self.binding=self.context['binding']; self.proposal=fixture['envelope']['proposal']
        self.diagnostics=[]; self.coverage={'branchCases':[],'edgeExecutions':[],'identityStates':[],'externalBranches':[]}
        self.nodes={}; self.owners={}; self.families={}; self.raw={}; self.actual_edges=[]
        self.policies={p['id']:p for p in mapping['branchPolicies']}
        self.evidence_policies={p['id']:p for p in mapping['evidencePolicies']}
        self.cardinalities={p['id']:p for p in mapping['cardinalityPolicies']}
        self.node_rules={n['id']:n for n in mapping['nodes']}
        self.rule_by_node={}; self.references=[]; self.mappings=[]

    def report(self,code,detail,rule=None):
        self.diagnostics.append({'fixtureId':self.fixture['fixtureId'],'code':code,'ruleId':rule,'detail':detail})

    def bound_projection(self,slice_name): return self.binding['slice3aProjectionId' if slice_name=='slice_3a' else 'slice3bProjectionId']

    def construct(self):
        self.validator.validate(self.fixture['envelope'])
        if self.validator.canonicalize(self.fixture['envelope'])!=self.fixture['envelope']:
            raise OracleError('SOURCE_NONCANONICAL_FIXTURE',self.fixture['fixtureId'])
        missing=[]
        for rule in self.mapping['nodes']:
            selector=rule['selector']
            if not selector.get('sourceSelectorAst'):
                missing.append(('MAPPING_SOURCE_SELECTOR_MISSING:'+rule['id'],rule))
            if not selector.get('anchorAst'):
                missing.append(('MAPPING_ANCHOR_MISSING:'+rule['id'],rule))
        for rule in self.mapping['edges']:
            for field,code in [('sourceSelectorAst','MAPPING_SOURCE_SELECTOR_MISSING'),('targetSelectorAst','MAPPING_TARGET_SELECTOR_MISSING'),('anchorAst','MAPPING_ANCHOR_MISSING')]:
                if not rule.get(field): missing.append((code+':'+rule['id'],rule))
        for code,rule in missing: self.report(code,{'required':'explicit typed selector/anchor AST; intrinsic kind joins are not supplied'},rule['id'])
        # These are independent operator operands from the frozen source
        # context, NOT rows selected by a completed mapping construction.
        self.audit_node_policy_operands()
        self.audit_source_union_selection()
        if not missing:
            # A new typed AST contract needs its own reviewed executor. This
            # bootstrap cannot silently declare a future, unknown AST grammar.
            self.report('MAPPING_TYPED_AST_EXECUTOR_NOT_REVIEWED',{'reason':'Current frozen manifest does not define a typed source/target selector grammar.'})
        return {'fixtureId':self.fixture['fixtureId'],'constructionStatus':'UNEXECUTABLE_MAPPING_CONTRACT','expressibleNodePolicyResults':list(self.nodes.values()),'expressibleEvidenceResults':self.evidence},self.diagnostics,self.coverage

    def audit_source_union_selection(self):
        trace=[]; self.validator.validate(self.fixture['envelope'],trace=trace)
        entries=unique_index(self.mapping['sourceInventory']['unions'],lambda u:u['schema'],'MAPPING_UNION_SITE_DUPLICATE')
        for item in trace:
            site=item['site']; value=pointer(self.fixture['envelope'],item['pointer']); candidates=[]
            if site in entries:
                for branch in entries[site]['branches']:
                    if all(k in value for k in branch['required']) and all(d['field'] in value and value[d['field']] in d['values'] for d in branch['discriminators']) and not set(value)-set(branch['required'])-set(branch['optional']): candidates.append(branch['index'])
            if len(candidates)!=1:
                self.report(('UNION_SELECTION_MULTIPLE:' if candidates else 'UNION_SELECTION_NONE:')+site,{'pointer':item['pointer'],'matches':candidates})

    def audit_node_policy_operands(self):
        bound_nodes=self.context['semanticNodes']; owners=self.context['typedOwners']
        unique_index(bound_nodes,lambda n:(n['slice'],n['id']))
        unique_index(owners,lambda o:(o['table'],o['semantic_node_id']),'SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH')
        for n in bound_nodes:
            if n['projectionId']!=self.bound_projection(n['slice']) or n['proposalId']!=self.binding['proposalId']:
                raise OracleError('SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH',n)
        for rule in self.mapping['nodes']:
            selector=rule['selector']
            if selector['op']!='typed_owner_join': raise OracleError('MAPPING_UNKNOWN_SELECTOR',selector)
            if selector['semanticTable']!=('ad_v4_candidate_app_semantic_nodes' if rule['slice']=='slice_3a' else 'ad_v4_candidate_obligation_semantic_nodes'):
                raise OracleError('SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH',selector)
            for n in bound_nodes:
                if n['slice']!=rule['slice'] or n['nodeType']!=selector['nodeType']: continue
                selected=[o for o in owners if o['table']==selector['ownerTable'] and o['semantic_node_id']==n['id']]
                if len(selected)!=1: raise OracleError('SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH',{'node':n,'owners':selected})
                owner=copy.deepcopy(selected[0])
                if owner['projection_id']!=n['projectionId'] or owner['proposal_id']!=n['proposalId']:
                    raise OracleError('SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH',owner)
                if n['id'] in self.nodes: raise OracleError('SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH',n)
                try: raw=pointer(self.proposal,n['sourcePointer'])
                except (KeyError,IndexError,ValueError,TypeError):
                    raw=self.context.get('syntheticSourceValues',{}).get(n['sourcePointer'])
                    if n['nodeType']!='change_dependency' or owner.get('dependency_kind')!='incoming_supersession_signal' or raw!={'sourceDependencyId':owner.get('source_dependency_id'),'targetProjectionId':n['projectionId']}:
                        raise OracleError('SOURCE_OCCURRENCE_MISSING',n)
                if digest(raw)!=n['canonicalNodeHash']: raise OracleError('NODE_VALUE_HASH_MISMATCH',n)
                self.check_identity(n,owner,raw)
                node={key:copy.deepcopy(n[key]) for key in SOURCE_FIELDS}
                if rule['ordinalRule']=='persisted_canonical_ordinal': pass
                elif rule['ordinalRule']=='fixed_0': node['canonicalOrdinal']=0
                else: raise OracleError('MAPPING_UNKNOWN_NODE_ORDINAL',rule)
                if rule['parentRule']!='persisted_parent_node_id' or rule['keyRule']!='source_key_or_pointer': raise OracleError('MAPPING_UNKNOWN_NODE_IDENTITY',rule)
                cases=[(i,c) for i,c in enumerate(self.policies[rule['branchPolicy']]['cases']) if predicate(c['predicate'],owner,raw)]
                if len(cases)!=1:
                    code='UNION_SELECTION_MULTIPLE' if cases else 'UNION_SELECTION_NONE'
                    raise OracleError(code+':'+rule['branchPolicy'],{'nodeId':n['id'],'matchingCases':[i for i,c in cases]})
                case_index,case=cases[0]
                self.coverage['branchCases'].append({'policyId':rule['branchPolicy'],'caseIndex':case_index,'nodeId':n['id']})
                node.update(representationStatus=case['representation'],baseGate=case['baseGate'],reasonCode=case['reason'])
                self.nodes[n['id']]=node; self.owners[n['id']]=owner; self.raw[n['id']]=raw; self.rule_by_node[n['id']]=rule['id']
        if len(self.nodes)!=len(bound_nodes) or len(owners)!=len(bound_nodes): raise OracleError('SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH',{'selected':len(self.nodes),'nodes':len(bound_nodes),'owners':len(owners)})
        for node in self.nodes.values():
            if node['parentNodeId'] is not None and node['parentNodeId'] not in self.nodes: raise OracleError('NODE_PARENT_MISMATCH',node)
        self.evidence=[]
        for node in self.nodes.values(): self.construct_evidence(node)

    def check_identity(self,node,owner,raw):
        identity={'projectionId':node['projectionId'],'nodeType':node['nodeType'],'nodeKey':node['nodeKey'],'pointer':node['sourcePointer']}; table='semantic-node'
        prefix='avn' if node['slice']=='slice_3a' else 'aon'
        if node['nodeType']=='designation_value':
            table='designation-value'; identity={'projectionId':node['projectionId'],'pointer':node['sourcePointer'],'value':raw}
        if node['nodeType']=='identity_mapping':
            table='identity-mapping'; prefix='avi'; identity={'projectionId':node['projectionId'],'kind':owner['identity_kind'],'occurrence':owner['source_occurrence_node_id']}
        h=row_hash(node['slice'],table,identity)
        if node['identityHash']!=h or node['id']!=prefix+'_'+h[:32]: raise OracleError('NODE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH',node)

    def construct_evidence(self,node):
        rule=self.node_rules[self.rule_by_node[node['id']]]; policy=self.evidence_policies[rule['evidencePolicy']]
        raw=self.raw[node['id']]; owner=self.owners[node['id']]; path=node['sourcePointer']; purpose_rule=policy['purposeBy']; purpose=None
        if purpose_rule['op']=='constant': purpose=purpose_rule['value']
        elif purpose_rule['op']=='owner_kind_cases':
            if 'owner_kind' not in owner:
                self.report('MAPPING_OPERAND_FIELD_MISSING:'+rule['id'],{'policyId':policy['id'],'field':'owner_kind','ownerColumns':sorted(owner)},rule['id'])
                purpose=None
            else: purpose=purpose_rule['cases'].get(owner['owner_kind'])
        elif purpose_rule['op']=='pointer_cases':
            for case in purpose_rule['cases']:
                if path.startswith(case.get('prefix','')) and path.endswith(case.get('suffix','')) and case.get('contains','') in path:
                    purpose=case['value']; break
        else: raise OracleError('MAPPING_UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE_PURPOSE',purpose_rule)
        if purpose is None and policy['owner']!='none':
            self.report('MAPPING_EVIDENCE_PURPOSE_UNEXECUTABLE:'+rule['id'],{'nodeId':node['id'],'policyId':policy['id']},rule['id'])
            return
        keys=[]
        if policy['owner']!='none':
            if policy['inheritance']=='product_manufacturer_uses_normalized_identity_keys_otherwise_self' and path.startswith('/productScopes/') and path.endswith('/manufacturer/sourceValue'):
                keys=pointer(self.proposal,path.rsplit('/',1)[0])['normalizedIdentity']['evidenceKeys']
            elif type(raw) is dict: keys=raw.get('evidenceKeys',[])
        if policy['cardinality']=='one_or_more' and not keys: self.report('EVIDENCE_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH',{'nodeId':node['id'],'policyId':policy['id'],'actual':0},rule['id'])
        if policy['cardinality']=='zero' and keys: self.report('EVIDENCE_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH',{'nodeId':node['id'],'policyId':policy['id'],'actual':len(keys)},rule['id'])
        if policy['cardinality'] not in ('one_or_more','zero'): raise OracleError('MAPPING_UNKNOWN_EVIDENCE_CARDINALITY',policy)
        generated=[]
        for ordinal,key in enumerate(keys):
            matches=[b for b in self.context['evidenceBindings'] if b['proposal_id']==node['proposalId'] and b['evidence_key']==key]
            if len(matches)!=1: raise OracleError('EVIDENCE_BINDING_MISMATCH',{'nodeId':node['id'],'evidenceKey':key,'bindings':matches})
            binding=matches[0]; canonical_binding=self.proposal['evidenceBindings'][key]
            if (binding['fragment_id'],binding['fragment_hash'])!=(canonical_binding['fragmentId'],canonical_binding['fragmentHash']): raise OracleError('EVIDENCE_BINDING_MISMATCH',binding)
            identity={'projectionId':node['projectionId'],'nodeId':node['id'],'purpose':purpose,'evidenceKey':key} if node['slice']=='slice_3a' else {'projectionId':node['projectionId'],'semanticNodeId':node['id'],'purpose':purpose,'evidenceKey':key,'ordinal':ordinal}
            h=row_hash(node['slice'],'evidence-link',identity)
            generated.append({'slice':node['slice'],'projectionId':node['projectionId'],'proposalId':node['proposalId'],'id':('avl_' if node['slice']=='slice_3a' else 'aoe_')+h[:32],'nodeId':node['id'],'purpose':purpose,'canonicalOrdinal':ordinal,'evidenceKey':key,'candidateBindingId':binding['id'],'linkHash':h})
        actual_source=[r for r in self.context['evidenceLinks'] if r['slice']==node['slice'] and r['nodeId']==node['id']]
        if sorted(actual_source,key=J)!=sorted(generated,key=J): self.report('EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH:'+node['id'],{'persisted':actual_source,'interpreted':generated},rule['id'])
        self.evidence.extend(generated)
        node['evidence']=sorted([[r['purpose'],r['canonicalOrdinal'],r['evidenceKey'],r['candidateBindingId'],r['linkHash']] for r in generated])
        node['evidenceCount']=len(generated); node['evidenceSetHash']=digest(node['evidence'])


def schema_operands(validator,value,schema,location,pointer_path=''):
    """Enumerate validation operands only, never semantic expected rows."""
    if type(schema) is bool: return
    yield location,schema,value,pointer_path
    if '$ref' in schema:
        yield from schema_operands(validator,value,validator.resolve(schema['$ref']),schema['$ref'],pointer_path)
    if 'oneOf' in schema:
        for i,branch in enumerate(schema['oneOf']):
            try: validator._validate(value,branch,pointer_path,location+'/oneOf/'+str(i),None)
            except source.SourceError: continue
            yield from schema_operands(validator,value,branch,location+'/oneOf/'+str(i),pointer_path)
    if type(value) is dict:
        for key,item in value.items():
            child=schema.get('properties',{}).get(key)
            loc=location+'/properties/'+key
            if child is None:
                patterns=[(p,s) for p,s in schema.get('patternProperties',{}).items() if source.re.search(p,key)]
                if patterns: pattern,child=patterns[0];loc=location+'/patternProperties/'+pattern
                elif type(schema.get('additionalProperties')) is dict: child=schema['additionalProperties'];loc=location+'/additionalProperties'
            if child is not None: yield from schema_operands(validator,item,child,loc,source.child_pointer(pointer_path,key))
    if type(value) is list and 'items' in schema:
        for i,item in enumerate(value): yield from schema_operands(validator,item,schema['items'],location+'/items',source.child_pointer(pointer_path,i))

def flatten_error(error):
    yield error
    for child in error.causes: yield from flatten_error(child)

def patch_one(value,path,new_value,remove=False):
    result=copy.deepcopy(value); parent_path,_,key=path.rpartition('/'); parent=pointer(result,parent_path)
    key=key.replace('~1','/').replace('~0','~')
    if type(parent) is list: key=int(key)
    if remove: del parent[key]
    else: parent[key]=copy.deepcopy(new_value)
    return result

def source_mutation_contract(fixtures,controls,schema):
    validator=source.SourceValidator(schema); required={}; closed={}; unions={}
    inputs=[{'controlId':f['fixtureId'],'schemaLocation':'#','value':f['envelope'],'semanticFixtureId':f['fixtureId']} for f in fixtures]
    inputs.extend(controls['controls'])
    for control in inputs:
        validator.validate(control['value'],control['schemaLocation'])
        entry=schema if control['schemaLocation']=='#' else validator.resolve(control['schemaLocation'])
        for location,sub,value,ipath in schema_operands(validator,control['value'],entry,control['schemaLocation']):
            if type(value) is dict:
                for field in sub.get('required',[]):
                    required.setdefault((location,field),{'controlId':control['controlId'],'schemaLocation':control['schemaLocation'],'pointer':source.child_pointer(ipath,field),'schemaPointer':location,'value':control['value']})
                if sub.get('additionalProperties') is False: closed.setdefault(location,{'controlId':control['controlId'],'schemaLocation':location,'value':value})
            if 'oneOf' in sub:
                for i,branch in enumerate(sub['oneOf']):
                    try: validator._validate(value,branch,'',location+'/oneOf/'+str(i),None)
                    except source.SourceError: continue
                    unions.setdefault((location,i),{'controlId':control['controlId'],'schemaLocation':location,'value':value,'alternative':i})
    mutations=[]
    for (location,field),witness in sorted(required.items()):
        mutations.append({'id':'source-required-'+digest([location,field])[:16],'family':'source_required_field','control':witness,'operation':'remove_source_field','pointer':witness['pointer'],'expectedCode':'SOURCE_REQUIRED_MISSING:'+witness['pointer']})
    for location,witness in sorted(closed.items()):
        mutations.append({'id':'source-closed-'+digest(location)[:16],'family':'source_forbidden_field','control':witness,'operation':'insert_forbidden_field','expectedCode':'SOURCE_FORBIDDEN_FIELD:/__forbidden__'})
    for (location,index),witness in sorted(unions.items()):
        for op,code in [('duplicate_schema_alternative','SOURCE_ONEOF_MULTIPLE:'),('remove_schema_alternative','SOURCE_ONEOF_NONE:')]:
            mutations.append({'id':op+'-'+digest([location,index])[:16],'family':'source_oneof','control':witness,'operation':op,'expectedCode':code+location})
        branch=validator.resolve(location)['oneOf'][index]; branch_location=location+'/oneOf/'+str(index)
        while '$ref' in branch: branch_location=branch['$ref']; branch=validator.resolve(branch_location)
        candidates=[k for k in ['kind','nodeType','state','designationKind','logic'] if k in branch.get('required',[])]
        if candidates:
            field=candidates[0]
            mutations.append({'id':'source-relaxed-discriminator-'+digest([location,index])[:16],'family':'source_discriminator_relaxation','control':witness,'operation':'relax_required_discriminator','schemaPointer':branch_location,'field':field,'expectedCode':'SOURCE_VALIDITY_EXPECTATION_MISMATCH:'+witness['controlId']})
            mutations.append({'id':'source-changed-discriminator-'+digest([location,index])[:16],'family':'source_discriminator_change','control':witness,'operation':'change_discriminator','field':field,'expectedCode':'SOURCE_ONEOF_NONE:'+location})
        if branch.get('additionalProperties') is False:
            mutations.append({'id':'source-relaxed-closed-'+digest([location,index])[:16],'family':'source_closed_relaxation','control':witness,'operation':'relax_closed_field','schemaPointer':branch_location,'expectedCode':'SOURCE_VALIDITY_EXPECTATION_MISMATCH:'+witness['controlId']})
    for control in controls['controls']:
        mutations.append({'id':'source-wrong-discriminator-'+control['controlId'],'family':'source_only_discriminator','control':control,'operation':'source_only_wrong_discriminator','field':control['wrongDiscriminator']['field'],'value':control['wrongDiscriminator']['value'],'expectedCode':'SOURCE_DISCRIMINATOR_REJECTED:'+control['controlId']})
    mutations.append({'id':'source-unknown-assertion','family':'source_unknown_keyword','control':inputs[0],'operation':'unknown_schema_keyword','expectedCode':'SOURCE_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_KEYWORD'})
    return mutations,{'requiredSchemaFieldWitnessCount':len(required),'closedObjectWitnessCount':len(closed),'unionAlternativeWitnessCount':len(unions),'sourceValidationOnlyControlCount':len(controls['controls'])}

def execute_source_mutation(mutation,schema):
    control=mutation['control']; value=copy.deepcopy(control['value']); changed_schema=copy.deepcopy(schema); location=control['schemaLocation']; op=mutation['operation']; target_pointer=None
    if op=='remove_source_field': target_pointer=mutation['pointer']; value=patch_one(value,target_pointer,None,True)
    elif op=='insert_forbidden_field': value['__forbidden__']='unexpected'; target_pointer='/__forbidden__'
    elif op in ('duplicate_schema_alternative','remove_schema_alternative'):
        union=pointer(changed_schema,location[1:])['oneOf']; index=control['alternative']
        if op=='duplicate_schema_alternative': union.append(copy.deepcopy(union[index]))
        else: del union[index]
    elif op in ('relax_required_discriminator','relax_closed_field'):
        branch=pointer(changed_schema,mutation['schemaPointer'][1:])
        if op=='relax_required_discriminator':
            field=mutation['field']; del value[field]; branch['required'].remove(field)
        else: value['__forbidden__']='unexpected'; branch['additionalProperties']=True
        try: source.SourceValidator(schema).validate(value,location)
        except source.SourceError: pass
        else: raise OracleError('SOURCE_MUTATION_CONTROL_NOT_INVALID',mutation['id'])
    elif op=='change_discriminator': value[mutation['field']]='unrecognized_discriminator'
    elif op=='source_only_wrong_discriminator': value[mutation['field']]=mutation['value']
    elif op=='unknown_schema_keyword': changed_schema['unknownAssertionKeyword']=True
    else: raise OracleError('SOURCE_MUTATION_OPERATION_UNKNOWN',op)
    errors=[]
    try: source.SourceValidator(changed_schema).validate(value,location)
    except source.SourceError as error: errors=list(flatten_error(error))
    if op in ('relax_required_discriminator','relax_closed_field'):
        actual='SOURCE_VALIDITY_EXPECTATION_MISMATCH:'+control['controlId'] if not errors else 'SOURCE_MUTATION_DID_NOT_RELAX'
    elif op=='source_only_wrong_discriminator': actual='SOURCE_DISCRIMINATOR_REJECTED:'+control['controlId'] if errors else 'SOURCE_UNEXPECTED_ACCEPTANCE'
    elif target_pointer is not None:
        desired='SOURCE_REQUIRED_MISSING' if op=='remove_source_field' else 'SOURCE_FORBIDDEN_FIELD'
        hit=next((e for e in errors if e.code==desired and e.pointer==target_pointer),None)
        actual=desired+':'+target_pointer if hit else (errors[0].code if errors else 'SOURCE_UNEXPECTED_ACCEPTANCE')
    elif op=='unknown_schema_keyword': actual=errors[0].code if errors else 'SOURCE_UNEXPECTED_ACCEPTANCE'
    else:
        desired='SOURCE_ONEOF_MULTIPLE' if op=='duplicate_schema_alternative' else 'SOURCE_ONEOF_NONE'
        actual=desired+':'+location if any(e.code==desired and e.schema_pointer==location for e in errors) else (errors[0].code if errors else 'SOURCE_UNEXPECTED_ACCEPTANCE')
    return {'mutationId':mutation['id'],'family':mutation['family'],'expectedCode':mutation['expectedCode'],'actualCode':actual,'status':'KILLED_NAMED_SOURCE_MISMATCH' if actual==mutation['expectedCode'] else 'SURVIVED_OR_WRONG_DIAGNOSTIC','error':errors[0].record() if errors else None,'controlStatus':'VALID_BEFORE_MUTATION'}


def mapping_schema_validate(value,schema,path=''):
    """Validate the original exact-const schema, never regenerate/rebind it."""
    if schema is False: raise OracleError('MAPPING_SCHEMA_FORBIDDEN',path)
    if schema is True: return
    allowed={'$schema','$id','type','const','required','properties','additionalProperties','minItems','maxItems','prefixItems','items'}
    if set(schema)-allowed: raise OracleError('MAPPING_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_KEYWORD',sorted(set(schema)-allowed))
    if 'type' in schema and not source.json_type(value,schema['type']): raise OracleError('MAPPING_SCHEMA_TYPE',path)
    if 'const' in schema and not source.exact_equal(value,schema['const']): raise OracleError('MAPPING_SCHEMA_CONST_BINDING',path)
    if type(value) is dict:
        for key in schema.get('required',[]):
            if key not in value: raise OracleError('MAPPING_SCHEMA_REQUIRED',source.child_pointer(path,key))
        for key,item in value.items():
            child=schema.get('properties',{}).get(key,schema.get('additionalProperties',True))
            mapping_schema_validate(item,child,source.child_pointer(path,key))
    if type(value) is list:
        if len(value)<schema.get('minItems',0) or len(value)>schema.get('maxItems',len(value)): raise OracleError('MAPPING_SCHEMA_CARDINALITY',path)
        prefix=schema.get('prefixItems',[])
        for index,item in enumerate(value): mapping_schema_validate(item,prefix[index] if index<len(prefix) else schema.get('items',True),source.child_pointer(path,index))

def compare_expressible(result,golden):
    expected={n['id']:n for n in golden['nodes']}; mismatches=[]
    codes={'canonicalOrdinal':'NODE_ORDINAL_MISMATCH','baseGate':'GATE_MISMATCH','representationStatus':'REPRESENTATION_MISMATCH','reasonCode':'REASON_CODE_MISMATCH','evidence':'EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH','evidenceCount':'EVIDENCE_COUNT_MISMATCH','evidenceSetHash':'EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH'}
    for actual in result['expressibleNodePolicyResults']:
        if actual['id'] not in expected:
            mismatches.append({'code':'NODE_SET_MISMATCH','actual':actual,'expected':None});continue
        node=expected[actual['id']]
        for field,value in actual.items():
            if value!=node.get(field): mismatches.append({'code':codes.get(field,'NODE_TUPLE_MISMATCH')+':'+actual['id'],'field':field,'pointer':actual['sourcePointer'],'expected':node.get(field),'actual':value})
    return mismatches

def run_attempt(fixture,mapping,validator):
    try:
        result,diagnostics,coverage=Interpreter(fixture,mapping,validator).construct()
        return {'result':result,'diagnostics':diagnostics,'coverage':coverage,'exception':None}
    except (OracleError,source.SourceError) as error:
        detail=error.record() if isinstance(error,source.SourceError) else error.detail
        return {'result':None,'diagnostics':[{'fixtureId':fixture['fixtureId'],'code':error.code,'detail':detail}],'coverage':{},'exception':None}
    except Exception as error:
        # Recorded loudly; never a successful mismatch or mutation kill.
        return {'result':None,'diagnostics':[],'coverage':{},'exception':{'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)}}

def exact_disposable_mutation(base,mutation):
    path=mutation['pointer'];old=pointer(base,path);new=mutation['newValue']
    if not source.exact_equal(old,mutation['oldValue']): raise OracleError('MUTATION_OLD_VALUE_MISMATCH',mutation['id'])
    if type(old) is not type(new): raise OracleError('MUTATION_JSON_TYPE_CHANGED',mutation['id'])
    changed=patch_one(base,path,new)
    if source.exact_equal(old,new) or not source.exact_equal(patch_one(changed,path,old),base): raise OracleError('MUTATION_NOT_EXACTLY_ONE_DECLARED_PATH',mutation['id'])
    return changed

def semantic_mutation_contract(fixtures,goldens,mapping,attempts):
    mutations=[]; by_id={f['fixtureId']:f for f in fixtures}; golden_by_id={g['fixtureId']:g for g in goldens}; seen={}
    for fixture,attempt in zip(fixtures,attempts,strict=True):
        for c in attempt['coverage'].get('branchCases',[]): seen.setdefault((c['policyId'],c['caseIndex']),(fixture['fixtureId'],c['nodeId']))
    def declare(mid,fid,path,new,expected,family,scope='expressible_operator',target='mapping'):
        base=mapping if target=='mapping' else by_id[fid]
        mutations.append({'id':mid,'fixtureId':fid,'target':target,'scope':scope,'family':family,'pointer':path,'oldValue':copy.deepcopy(pointer(base,path)),'newValue':copy.deepcopy(new),'expectedCode':expected,'requiredForFullGate':True})
    for policy_index,policy in enumerate(mapping['branchPolicies']):
        for case_index,case in enumerate(policy['cases']):
            fid,nid=seen[(policy['id'],case_index)]
            declare('gate-'+policy['id']+'-'+str(case_index),fid,f'/branchPolicies/{policy_index}/cases/{case_index}/baseGate',H if case['baseGate']==C else C,'GATE_MISMATCH:'+nid,'gate_branch')
            for kind in ['overlap','missing']:
                cases=copy.deepcopy(policy['cases'])
                if kind=='overlap': cases.append(copy.deepcopy(case))
                else: del cases[case_index]
                declare('policy-'+kind+'-'+policy['id']+'-'+str(case_index),fid,f'/branchPolicies/{policy_index}/cases',cases,('UNION_SELECTION_MULTIPLE:' if kind=='overlap' else 'UNION_SELECTION_NONE:')+policy['id'],'mapping_union')
    validator=source.SourceValidator(read(HERE/'acceptance-source-schema-v2.json'))
    source_witness={}
    for fixture in fixtures:
        trace=[];validator.validate(fixture['envelope'],trace=trace)
        for item in trace: source_witness.setdefault((item['site'],item['alternative']),fixture['fixtureId'])
    for union_index,union in enumerate(mapping['sourceInventory']['unions']):
        for branch_index,branch in enumerate(union['branches']):
            fid=source_witness[(union['schema'],branch['index'])]
            for operation in ['missing','overlap']:
                branches=copy.deepcopy(union['branches'])
                if operation=='missing': del branches[branch_index]
                else: branches.append(copy.deepcopy(branch))
                declare('mapping-source-union-'+operation+'-'+digest([union['schema'],branch_index])[:16],fid,f'/sourceInventory/unions/{union_index}/branches',branches,('UNION_SELECTION_NONE:' if operation=='missing' else 'UNION_SELECTION_MULTIPLE:')+union['schema'],'mapping_source_union')
    # Edge mutations are concretely declared but cannot be counted as killed
    # while source/target selectors and their anchors are absent.
    for index,rule in enumerate(mapping['edges']):
        fid=next(g['fixtureId'] for g in goldens if any(e['ruleId']==rule['id'] for e in g['edges']))
        declare('cardinality-'+rule['id'],fid,f'/edges/{index}/cardinalityPolicy','two_required' if rule['cardinalityPolicy']!='two_required' else 'required_one','CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:'+rule['id'],'cardinality','full_graph')
        declare('ordinal-'+rule['id'],fid,f'/edges/{index}/ordinalPolicy','fixed_1' if rule['ordinalPolicy']=='fixed_0' else 'fixed_0','EDGE_ORDINAL_MISMATCH:'+rule['id'],'ordinal','full_graph')
        declare('target-'+rule['id'],fid,f'/edges/{index}/childNodes',['B13'] if rule['childNodes']!=['B13'] else ['A01'],'REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:'+rule['id'],'wrong_target','full_graph')
    for label,policy in [('fixed-three','three_fixed_assertions'),('min-one','required_one')]:
        declare('E02-'+label,'3a-main','/edges/1/cardinalityPolicy',policy,'E02_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH','E02','full_graph')
    declare('E13-required-both','3a-main','/edges/12/cardinalityPolicy','two_required','E13_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH','E13','full_graph')
    for index,selector in enumerate(mapping['identitySelectors']):
        declare('identity-known-only-'+selector['id'],'3a-main',f'/identitySelectors/{index}/presence',{'op':'fields','fields':{'state':['known']}},'IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:'+selector['id'],'identity_missing','full_graph')
        declare('identity-invent-'+selector['id'],'3a-main',f'/identitySelectors/{index}/presence',{'op':'true'},'IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:'+selector['id'],'identity_extra','full_graph')
    for index,rule in enumerate(mapping['edges']):
        if not rule['propagates']:
            declare('integrity-propagates-'+rule['id'],'slice3b-unknown-conflicting-evidence',f'/edges/{index}/propagates',True,'EDGE_PROPAGATION_MISMATCH:'+rule['id'],'integrity_propagation','full_graph')
    for index,rule in enumerate(mapping['nodes']):
        if rule['rootPolicy']=='noncontrolling':
            fid='3a-main' if rule['slice']=='slice_3a' else 'slice3b-complete-candidate'
            declare('noncontrolling-aggregates-'+rule['id'],fid,f'/nodes/{index}/rootPolicy','controlling','AGGREGATE_READINESS_MISMATCH','noncontrolling_root','full_graph')
    main=by_id['3a-main']; context=main['context']; node=context['semanticNodes'][0]
    declare('wrong-node-projection','3a-main','/context/semanticNodes/0/projectionId','foreign-projection','SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH','projection_context','source_context',target='fixture')
    declare('wrong-owner-projection','3a-main','/context/typedOwners/0/projection_id','foreign-projection','SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH','projection_context','source_context',target='fixture')
    declare('duplicate-owner-join','3a-main','/context/typedOwners',context['typedOwners']+[context['typedOwners'][0]],'SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH','join_multiplicity','source_context',target='fixture')
    declare('missing-owner-join','3a-main','/context/typedOwners',context['typedOwners'][1:],'SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH','join_multiplicity','source_context',target='fixture')
    declare('shortened-source-row-identity','3a-main','/context/semanticNodes/0/id',node['id'][:-1],'SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH','source_row_identity','source_context',target='fixture')
    first=context['evidenceLinks'][0]
    declare('required-evidence-loss','3a-main','/context/evidenceLinks',context['evidenceLinks'][1:],'EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH:'+first['nodeId'],'evidence_loss','source_context',target='fixture')
    expression=next(n for n in context['semanticNodes'] if n['slice']=='slice_3a' and n['nodeType']=='expression')
    binding=context['evidenceBindings'][0];purpose='rule_clause';key=binding['evidence_key'];h=row_hash('slice_3a','evidence-link',{'projectionId':expression['projectionId'],'nodeId':expression['id'],'purpose':purpose,'evidenceKey':key})
    invented={'slice':'slice_3a','projectionId':expression['projectionId'],'proposalId':expression['proposalId'],'id':'avl_'+h[:32],'nodeId':expression['id'],'purpose':purpose,'canonicalOrdinal':0,'evidenceKey':key,'candidateBindingId':binding['id'],'linkHash':h}
    declare('zero-evidence-inherits-parent','3a-main','/context/evidenceLinks',context['evidenceLinks']+[invented],'EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH:'+expression['id'],'evidence_inheritance','source_context',target='fixture')
    seen_families=set()
    for fixture in fixtures:
        for index,node in enumerate(fixture['context']['semanticNodes']):
            family=(node['slice'],node['nodeType'])
            if family in seen_families: continue
            seen_families.add(family)
            declare('source-ordinal-'+node['slice']+'-'+node['nodeType'],fixture['fixtureId'],f'/context/semanticNodes/{index}/canonicalOrdinal',1 if node['canonicalOrdinal']==0 else 0,'NODE_ORDINAL_MISMATCH:'+node['id'],'source_ordinal','source_context',target='fixture')
    return mutations

def execute_semantic_mutation(mutation,fixtures,goldens,mapping,validator,base_attempts):
    by_id={f['fixtureId']:f for f in fixtures}; gold={g['fixtureId']:g for g in goldens}; fid=mutation['fixtureId']
    base=mapping if mutation['target']=='mapping' else by_id[fid]; changed=exact_disposable_mutation(base,mutation)
    attempt=run_attempt(changed if mutation['target']=='fixture' else by_id[fid],changed if mutation['target']=='mapping' else mapping,validator)
    diagnostics=attempt['diagnostics'][:]
    if attempt['result'] is not None: diagnostics.extend(compare_expressible(attempt['result'],gold[fid]))
    codes=[d['code'] for d in diagnostics]
    base_attempt=base_attempts[fid]; baseline=base_attempt['diagnostics'][:]
    if base_attempt['result'] is not None: baseline.extend(compare_expressible(base_attempt['result'],gold[fid]))
    operand_control=mutation['expectedCode'] not in [d['code'] for d in baseline]
    hit=next((d for d in diagnostics if d['code']==mutation['expectedCode']),None)
    if attempt['exception'] is not None: status='UNCLASSIFIED_EXCEPTION_NOT_A_KILL'
    elif mutation['scope']=='full_graph': status='UNEXECUTABLE_MAPPING_SELECTOR_OR_ANCHOR'
    elif hit and operand_control: status='KILLED_NAMED_OPERATOR_OR_CONTEXT_MISMATCH'
    elif not operand_control: status='CONTROL_ALREADY_FAILS_EXPECTED_OPERAND'
    else: status='SURVIVED_OR_WRONG_DIAGNOSTIC'
    return {'mutationId':mutation['id'],'family':mutation['family'],'scope':mutation['scope'],'expectedCode':mutation['expectedCode'],'actualCode':hit['code'] if hit else next((c for c in codes if c.startswith('MAPPING_TARGET_SELECTOR_MISSING:')),(codes[0] if codes else 'NO_MISMATCH')),'status':status,'controlStatus':'OPERAND_CONTROL_PASS_FULL_MAPPING_BLOCKED' if operand_control else 'OPERAND_CONTROL_FAIL','freshnessBypass':'exactly_one_declared_mutation' if mutation['target']=='mapping' else 'none_disposable_source_context','declaredDiff':{'pointer':mutation['pointer'],'oldValue':mutation['oldValue'],'newValue':mutation['newValue']},'matchedDiagnostic':hit,'exception':attempt['exception'],'fullGraphSemanticKill':False}


def counts(values):
    result={}
    for value in values: result[value]=result.get(value,0)+1
    return dict(sorted(result.items()))

def compare_complete(actual,expected):
    """Exact tuple comparator; expected data is used only after construction."""
    differences=[]
    def note(code,a,b):differences.append({'code':code,'actual':a,'expected':b})
    for field in ['nodes','edges','identityMappings','evidence','references','externalDependencies']:
        if actual[field]!=expected[field] and sorted(actual[field],key=J)==sorted(expected[field],key=J):note('NORMALIZED_ARRAY_ORDER_MISMATCH:'+field,actual[field],expected[field])
    an={n['id']:n for n in actual['nodes']};en={n['id']:n for n in expected['nodes']}
    if set(an)!=set(en):note('NODE_SET_MISMATCH',sorted(an),sorted(en))
    codes={'canonicalOrdinal':'NODE_ORDINAL_MISMATCH','baseGate':'GATE_MISMATCH','effectiveGate':'EFFECTIVE_GATE_MISMATCH','rootRole':'ROOT_ROLE_MISMATCH','representationStatus':'REPRESENTATION_MISMATCH','reasonCode':'REASON_CODE_MISMATCH','evidence':'EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH','evidenceCount':'EVIDENCE_COUNT_MISMATCH','evidenceSetHash':'EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH'}
    for nid in sorted(set(an)&set(en)):
        for key in sorted(set(an[nid])|set(en[nid])):
            if an[nid].get(key)!=en[nid].get(key):note(codes.get(key,'NODE_TUPLE_MISMATCH')+':'+nid,an[nid].get(key),en[nid].get(key))
    for rid in sorted({e['ruleId'] for e in actual['edges']+expected['edges']}):
        a=sorted([e for e in actual['edges'] if e['ruleId']==rid],key=J);e=sorted([x for x in expected['edges'] if x['ruleId']==rid],key=J)
        if a==e:continue
        if len(a)!=len(e):note('EDGE_SET_MISMATCH:'+rid,a,e)
        endpoint=lambda r:(r['parentSlice'],r['parentNodeId'],r['childSlice'],r['childNodeId'])
        if sorted(map(endpoint,a))!=sorted(map(endpoint,e)):note('REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:'+rid,a,e);note('EDGE_TARGET_MISMATCH:'+rid,a,e)
        else:
            ad={endpoint(x):x for x in a};ed={endpoint(x):x for x in e}
            if any(ad[k]['canonicalOrdinal']!=ed[k]['canonicalOrdinal'] for k in ad):note('EDGE_ORDINAL_MISMATCH:'+rid,a,e)
            if any(ad[k]['propagatesGate']!=ed[k]['propagatesGate'] for k in ad):note('EDGE_PROPAGATION_MISMATCH:'+rid,a,e)
        slot=lambda r:(r['parentSlice'],r['parentNodeId'],r['edgeKind'],r['canonicalOrdinal'],r['childSlice'],r['childNodeId'])
        if sorted(map(slot,a))!=sorted(map(slot,e)):note('EDGE_TARGET_MISMATCH:'+rid,a,e)
    for field,code in [('identityMappings','IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH'),('evidence','EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH'),('references','REFERENCE_SET_MISMATCH')]:
        if sorted(actual[field],key=J)!=sorted(expected[field],key=J):note(code,actual[field],expected[field])
    if sorted(actual['externalDependencies'],key=J)!=sorted(expected['externalDependencies'],key=J):
        note('EXTERNAL_SET_MISMATCH',actual['externalDependencies'],expected['externalDependencies'])
        for rid in ['X01','X02','X03','X04','X05','X06']:note('REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:'+rid,actual['externalDependencies'],expected['externalDependencies'])
    ar=sorted(n['id'] for n in actual['nodes'] if n['rootRole']=='controlling_root');er=sorted(n['id'] for n in expected['nodes'] if n['rootRole']=='controlling_root')
    if actual['aggregateReadiness']!=expected['aggregateReadiness'] or ar!=er:note('AGGREGATE_READINESS_MISMATCH',{'value':actual['aggregateReadiness'],'controllingRoots':ar},{'value':expected['aggregateReadiness'],'controllingRoots':er})
    if actual['retentionClassification']!=expected['retentionClassification']:note('RETENTION_CLASSIFICATION_MISMATCH',actual['retentionClassification'],expected['retentionClassification'])
    return differences

def run_reference(fixture,program,validator,grammar):
    engine=None
    try:
        grammar.validate(program)
        engine=bootstrap.AstExecutor(fixture,program,validator,sys.modules[__name__])
        result,coverage=engine.construct()
        return {'result':result,'coverage':coverage,'diagnostics':[],'exception':None}
    except (OracleError,source.SourceError) as error:
        return {'result':None,'coverage':{},'diagnostics':[{'code':error.code,'detail':error.record() if isinstance(error,source.SourceError) else error.detail}],'exception':None,'completedEdgeRows':copy.deepcopy(engine.edges) if engine is not None and engine.completed_edges else None}
    except Exception as error:return {'result':None,'coverage':{},'diagnostics':[],'exception':{'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)}}

def reference_mutation_contract(program,fixtures,legacy):
    mutations=[];by_id={f['fixtureId']:f for f in fixtures}
    def declare(mid,fid,path,new,code,family,architecture=None):
        mutations.append({'id':mid,'fixtureId':fid,'target':'referenceProgram','family':family,'pointer':path,'oldValue':copy.deepcopy(pointer(program,path)),'newValue':copy.deepcopy(new),'expectedCode':code,'architectureContract':architecture,'requiredForFullGate':True})
    for m in legacy:
        if m['scope']!='full_graph':continue
        mid=m['id'];fid=m['fixtureId'];family=m['family'];parts=m['pointer'].split('/');i=int(parts[2])
        if family=='cardinality':declare(mid,fid,f'/edges/{i}/cardinality/min',999,m['expectedCode'],family)
        elif family=='ordinal':
            old=program['edges'][i]['queries'][0]['select']['canonicalOrdinal'];declare(mid,fid,f'/edges/{i}/queries/0/select/canonicalOrdinal',{'op':'add','args':[old,{'op':'literal','value':1}]},m['expectedCode'],family)
        elif family=='wrong_target':
            rule=program['edges'][i];allowed={(n['slice'],n['nodeType']) for n in program['nodes'] if n['id'] in rule['targetRules']};wrong=next(n for n in by_id[fid]['context']['semanticNodes'] if (n['slice'],n['nodeType']) not in allowed)
            declare(mid,fid,f'/edges/{i}/queries/0/select/childNodeId',{'op':'literal','value':wrong['id']},m['expectedCode'],family)
        elif family in ('E02','E13'):
            new=3 if mid=='E02-fixed-three' else 1 if mid=='E02-min-one' else 2
            declare(mid,fid,f'/edges/{i}/cardinality/min',new,'CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:'+program['edges'][i]['id'],family)
        elif family=='identity_missing':
            qs=copy.deepcopy(program['identitySelectors'][i]['queries'])
            for q in qs:q['where']={'op':'and','terms':[q['where'],{'op':'eq','left':{'op':'field','alias':'co','name':'normalized_state'},'right':{'op':'literal','value':'known'}}]}
            declare(mid,fid,f'/identitySelectors/{i}/queries',qs,m['expectedCode'],family)
        elif family=='identity_extra':
            qs=copy.deepcopy(program['identitySelectors'][i]['queries']);qs.extend(copy.deepcopy(program['identitySelectors'][(i+1)%8]['queries']))
            declare(mid,fid,f'/identitySelectors/{i}/queries',qs,m['expectedCode'],family)
        elif family=='integrity_propagation':declare(mid,fid,f'/edges/{i}/propagates',True,m['expectedCode'],family)
        elif family=='noncontrolling_root':declare(mid,fid,f'/nodes/{i}/rootPolicy','controlling',m['expectedCode'],family)
        else:raise OracleError('REFERENCE_MUTATION_ADAPTER_MISSING',m)
        mutations[-1]['legacyExpectedCode']=m['expectedCode']
    if len(mutations)!=145:raise OracleError('REFERENCE_LEGACY_MUTATION_COUNT',len(mutations))
    def arch(mid,path,new,code,fid='3a-main'):declare(mid,fid,path,new,code,'architecture',mid)
    arch('E02-skip-serial-part','/edges/1/queries',program['edges'][1]['queries'][:1],'EDGE_SET_MISMATCH:E02')
    qs=copy.deepcopy(program['edges'][1]['queries'])
    for q in qs:q['select']['canonicalOrdinal']={'op':'literal','value':0}
    arch('E02-compact-slots','/edges/1/queries',qs,'EDGE_ORDINAL_MISMATCH:E02')
    serial=next(n for n in by_id['3a-main']['context']['semanticNodes'] if n['sourcePointer']=='/productScopes/7/serialScope' and n['nodeType']=='designation_scope')
    arch('E02-equal-count-duplicate','/edges/1/queries/2/select/childNodeId',{'op':'literal','value':serial['id']},'EDGE_TARGET_MISMATCH:E02')
    arch('E13-omit-condition','/edges/12/queries',program['edges'][12]['queries'][:1],'EDGE_SET_MISMATCH:E13')
    qs=copy.deepcopy(program['edges'][12]['queries'])
    for i,q in enumerate(qs):q['select']['canonicalOrdinal']={'op':'literal','value':1-i}
    arch('E13-swap-targets','/edges/12/queries',qs,'EDGE_TARGET_MISMATCH:E13')
    arch('E13-use-source-ordinal','/edges/12/queries/1/select/canonicalOrdinal',{'op':'field','alias':'c','name':'canonicalOrdinal'},'EDGE_ORDINAL_MISMATCH:E13')
    for i,s in enumerate(program['identitySelectors']):
        declare('identity-double-consumption-'+s['id'],'3a-main',f'/identitySelectors/{i}/queries',s['queries']+[s['queries'][0]],'IDENTITY_DOUBLE_CONSUMPTION:'+s['id'],'architecture','identity-double-consumption-I01-I08')
    arch('projection-anchor-dropped','/nodes/0/query/from/where/terms/2',{'op':'true'},'SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH')
    arch('row-identity-shortened','/edgeRowIdentity',[k for k in program['edgeRowIdentity'] if k!='childNodeId'],'EDGE_ROW_IDENTITY_MISMATCH:E05')
    arch('wrong-external-target-projection','/externalBranches/0/queries/0/select/targetProjectionId',{'op':'param','name':'slice3aProjectionId'},'REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:X01','external-outgoing-resolved')
    # Serializer cannot hide a changed target key: same membership and count,
    # a valid typed scalar expression, then the semantic reference detector.
    declare('serializer-target-key-preserved','3a-main','/references/0/select/targetNodeKey',{'op':'literal','value':'wrong-target-key'},'REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH','serializer')
    declare('aggregate-minimum-operator','3a-main','/aggregate/operator','minimum','AGGREGATE_READINESS_MISMATCH','aggregate')
    return mutations

def execute_reference_mutation(m,fixtures,goldens,program,validator,grammar,controls):
    fixture=next(f for f in fixtures if f['fixtureId']==m['fixtureId']);golden=next(g for g in goldens if g['fixtureId']==m['fixtureId'])
    changed=exact_disposable_mutation(program,m);attempt=run_reference(fixture,changed,validator,grammar)
    diagnostics=attempt['diagnostics'][:]
    if attempt['result'] is not None:diagnostics.extend(compare_complete(attempt['result'],golden))
    elif attempt.get('completedEdgeRows') is not None:
        # A deliberately propagating integrity edge can create a cycle after
        # every edge tuple was successfully constructed. After construction has
        # stopped, compare those complete edge tuples directly. The cycle alone
        # is not substituted for the requested propagation detector.
        key=lambda e:(e['ruleId'],e['parentSlice'],e['parentNodeId'],e['edgeKind'],e['canonicalOrdinal'],e['childSlice'],e['childNodeId'])
        expected_edges={key(e):e for e in golden['edges']}
        for edge in attempt['completedEdgeRows']:
            expected=expected_edges.get(key(edge))
            if expected is not None and edge['propagatesGate']!=expected['propagatesGate']:
                diagnostics.append({'code':'EDGE_PROPAGATION_MISMATCH:'+edge['ruleId'],'actual':edge,'expected':expected,'constructionStoppedAfter':'complete edge tuple construction; controlled cycle rejection during gate evaluation'})
    hit=next((d for d in diagnostics if d['code']==m['expectedCode']),None)
    control=controls[m['fixtureId']];control_pass=control['result'] is not None and not compare_complete(control['result'],golden) and not control['exception']
    status='KILLED_NAMED_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH' if hit and control_pass and not attempt['exception'] else 'UNCLASSIFIED_EXCEPTION_NOT_A_KILL' if attempt['exception'] else 'CONTROL_NOT_PASS' if not control_pass else 'SURVIVED_OR_WRONG_DIAGNOSTIC'
    return {'mutationId':m['id'],'family':m['family'],'architectureContract':m['architectureContract'],'expectedCode':m['expectedCode'],'actualCode':hit['code'] if hit else diagnostics[0]['code'] if diagnostics else 'NO_MISMATCH','status':status,'controlStatus':'FULL_REFERENCE_CONTROL_PASS' if control_pass else 'FAIL','freshnessBypass':'exactly_one_declared_mutation','declaredDiff':{'pointer':m['pointer'],'oldValue':m['oldValue'],'newValue':m['newValue']},'matchedDiagnostic':hit,'exception':attempt['exception'],'fullGraphSemanticKill':status=='KILLED_NAMED_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH'}

def grammar_and_executor_probes(program,fixtures,goldens,validator,grammar):
    probes=[]
    for name,path,value in [('unknown-operator','/nodes/0/query/from/where/op','execute_python'),('unknown-table','/nodes/0/query/from/table','production_payload'),('unknown-parameter','/nodes/0/query/from/where/terms/2/right/name','outsideProjection'),('unknown-object-field','/nodes/0/query',dict(program['nodes'][0]['query'],hiddenPayload=True)),('serializer-lossy-omit','/referenceEnvelope/validatedRedundantFields',['sourceProjectionId','targetNodeId'])]:
        changed=patch_one(program,path,value)
        try:grammar.validate(changed);actual='UNEXPECTED_GRAMMAR_ACCEPTANCE'
        except source.SourceError:actual='AST_GRAMMAR_REJECTED'
        probes.append({'id':name,'expectedCode':'AST_GRAMMAR_REJECTED','actualCode':actual,'matched':actual=='AST_GRAMMAR_REJECTED'})
    engine=bootstrap.AstExecutor(fixtures[0],program,validator,sys.modules[__name__])
    for name,expr,expected in [('field-missing',{'op':'field','alias':'n','name':'not_a_column'},'AST_TYPED_FIELD_MISSING'),('integer-bool-distinct',{'op':'add','args':[{'op':'literal','value':True},{'op':'literal','value':1}]},'AST_EXPRESSION_TYPE_MISMATCH')]:
        try:engine.value(expr,{'n':{}});actual='UNEXPECTED_EXECUTOR_ACCEPTANCE'
        except OracleError as e:actual=e.code
        probes.append({'id':name,'expectedCode':expected,'actualCode':actual,'matched':actual==expected})
    # Actual engine-method fault injection, not an output/golden mutation. Each
    # implementation is restored in finally; no module or repository is written.
    original=bootstrap.AstExecutor.value
    def shifted_add(self,expr,env):
        value=original(self,expr,env)
        return value+1 if expr['op']=='add' else value
    bootstrap.AstExecutor.value=shifted_add
    try:attempt=run_reference(fixtures[0],program,validator,grammar)
    finally:bootstrap.AstExecutor.value=original
    ds=attempt['diagnostics']+(compare_complete(attempt['result'],goldens[0]) if attempt['result'] else [])
    expected='EDGE_ORDINAL_MISMATCH:E17';hit=next((d for d in ds if d['code']==expected),None)
    probes.append({'id':'executor-add-off-by-one','expectedCode':expected,'actualCode':hit['code'] if hit else ds[0]['code'] if ds else 'NO_MISMATCH','matched':hit is not None and attempt['exception'] is None,'method':'AstExecutor.value(add)','exception':attempt['exception']})
    original_propagate=bootstrap.AstExecutor.propagate
    def minimum_fold(self):
        original_propagate(self)
        children={nid:[] for nid in self.nodes}
        for e in self.edges:
            if e['propagatesGate']:children[e['parentNodeId']].append(e['childNodeId'])
        done={}
        def visit(nid):
            if nid not in done:done[nid]=min([self.nodes[nid]['baseGate']]+[visit(c) for c in children[nid]],key=RANK.__getitem__)
            return done[nid]
        for nid,n in self.nodes.items():n['effectiveGate']=visit(nid)
        return max((n['effectiveGate'] for n in self.nodes.values() if n['rootRole']=='controlling_root'),key=RANK.__getitem__)
    bootstrap.AstExecutor.propagate=minimum_fold
    try:attempt=run_reference(fixtures[0],program,validator,grammar)
    finally:bootstrap.AstExecutor.propagate=original_propagate
```

# Independent semantic-oracle bootstrap provenance

Status: **BLOCKED_CURRENT_MAPPING_CONTRACT — no bootstrap/design approval claimed.**
The frozen literal corpus and source validator exist. The strict interpreter
exposes the current mapping's missing selector/anchor contract; it deliberately
does not invent source/target joins. Full graph construction and a no-survivor
full semantic-mutation gate remain unproved. H-005 remains open.

## Model routing

- Builder: `/root/v4_s4b_semantic_oracle_bootstrap`; requested `gpt-6-astra`,
  xhigh; actual `model not exposed by runtime`; `effort not exposed`.
- Trigger: third-loop independent semantic oracle bootstrap, interacting
  source/persisted-identity/evidence/ordinal/selection invariants.
- Disjoint literal 3B author:
  `/root/v4_s4b_semantic_oracle_bootstrap/slice3b_literal_corpus`; requested
  `gpt-6-astra`, xhigh; actual `model not exposed by runtime`; `effort not exposed`.
- Separate controlled schema exporter: `/root/v4_s4b_schema_exporter`;
  requested `gpt-6-astra`, high; actual `model not exposed by runtime`;
  `effort not exposed`. No fallback claimed for any assignment.
- Reviewer: not assigned or attested by this builder. The coordinator owns
  independent review and disposition; adversarial-review boundaries were used
  to preserve builder/reviewer separation and keep production paused.

## Authorship and freeze boundary

The actual validator-2 schema was exported separately from
`app.services.ad_v4_candidates._v4_schema('paprnav-ad-v4-validator-2')`.
The exporter owns that file; this builder did not overwrite it. Exact exporter
source and full runtime provenance are preserved below, including base-schema,
candidate-service overlay, command, exporter-source and output hashes.

Fixture and golden choices were authored from the frozen source schema,
retained human 3A/3B contracts and approved human invariants, before any read of
the current acceptance mapping. Every S/O/L/E/M/R/Ref record or child author
JSON tuple explicitly chose its node, owner, edge, mapping, evidence, target,
ordinal, representation, base/effective gate, reason and root role. The
one-time helpers only zipped declared columns, applied explicitly listed
assignments, rebound IDs, computed canonical hashes, counted existing literal
evidence arrays, copied the explicitly declared enclosing baseline, and sorted
presentation arrays. They did not enumerate source graphs, select semantic
occurrences, derive gates or consult mapping/production/interpreter output.

Integration independently caught and corrected, before freeze, the child
helper's initial 3A evidence preimage (3B's ordinal-bearing form was wrong),
and a coordinator helper's key-versus-ID substitution in a baseline reference.
These were mechanical expansion errors, not changes based on tested output.

The exact corpus was frozen and its hashes sent to the coordinator before the
first mapping read: fixtures
`0209d1b1227cb4a9d637fd265b8afdbb5183f3755f30618831ec6dfc9d9a5bb2`;
goldens `6fb91996d4b73cedb45742273ae537a1fc296670a65b24d174a6ea97dc9722e9`.
Neither was changed after the first mapping read. The interpreter has no
golden-write mode; its only patch outputs have fixed mutation/result filenames.
An audit guard permits only fixed inputs/self/stdlib reads, prohibits writes,
process/network effects, and prohibits golden bytes until all actual strict
construction attempts have ended. Operator construction never receives a
golden; comparison happens afterwards. Missing-AST attempts end explicitly as
unexecutable rather than fabricating a graph.

## Counts and disposition

The 20 complete source-valid fixture/golden pairs contain 2,136 literal nodes
and typed owners, 2,080 edges, and 1,495 evidence links. Main context also
contains one complete 136-node alternate projection for the same proposal and
source, with same keys but distinct node/projection identities; it is not part
of the bound expected output. Four source-validation-only controls cover the
three non-graph definitions authoritativeCorrection, changedSemanticRef, and
submissionRelationship (both relation variants), as explicitly authorized.
They make no semantic/persistence/admission/lineage claim.

Machine evidence records all 29 union alternatives, all discriminator values
that divide those alternatives, all 28 slice-qualified node families, all 40
literal edge rules, all 8 identity selectors, all optional masks, E13/I01
presence branches, six external fixtures, root roles and literal propagation
witnesses. The expressible policy operand audit executes all 53 branch cases.
Inventory/literal coverage is distinguished from full graph execution.

- Source mutation checks: 407 exact named outcomes; no survivors or generic
  exceptions. This includes all 203 required-field declarations, all 54 closed
  object sites and all 29 alternatives' overlap/removal/discriminator/closed
  constraint probes. A further 21 literal assertion-conformance checks pass.
- Mapping/context probes: 252 named operator/context failures, 145 explicitly
  unexecutable graph probes, no executable-probe survivors or generic exceptions.
  There are 10 additional unexecutable architecture mutation contracts.
  **Full graph semantic mutation kills: zero; the full gate has not passed.**
- Persistence shape, resource widths/pending copies, resource AST scope, and
  forbidden indirect payload/query-spy probes are explicitly externally owned,
  unexecuted, and not PASS.

Current mapping baselines have 176 missing source/target-selector or anchor
diagnostics per fixture (68 source + 68 anchor + 40 target). Further exact
diagnostics show the nonexistent 3B evidence `owner_kind` operand (the source
column is `field_code`), incoming zero-evidence versus required evidence, and
not-applicable representation/reason disagreements. The min-one termination
target policy conflicts with a source-valid empty `terminates` fixture, but
its full edge execution remains blocked by missing selectors.

Retained 3B source ordinals remain authoritative: document assertions 0/1/2,
requirement action/activation/branch/timing/recurrence/effect 0/1/2/3/4/5,
recurrence condition/timing 0/1, group timings 0/1. Current generic-zero 4B
prose is a preserved H-005 conflict; the persisted-ordinal manifest itself
does not erase these ordinals. Incoming change values remain exactly
`{sourceDependencyId,targetProjectionId}` with zero direct evidence; outgoing
supersession relations own supersession_clause evidence. No inheritance was
invented to make the current manifest pass.

## Mutation isolation

The coordinator authorized exact-const freshness bypass only for a disposable
test copy: first validate the original manifest against its original schema
and hashes; deep-copy; apply exactly one declared JSON pointer/old/new value;
preserve its JSON type; prove outside-pointer equality by restoring the old
value; skip only exact-const/freshness comparison on that copy; execute the
strict interpreter. Every result records the exact diff and bypass marker.
The repository mapping/schema and goldens are unchanged. Source mutations use
independently validated original controls. A generic exception never counts
as a kill, and a missing selector is never relabeled as a semantic kill.

## Reproduction and exit semantics

Run from `/Users/hostiletakeover/Projects/paprnav`:

```bash
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 backend/.venv/bin/python -B .ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-source-validator.py
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 backend/.venv/bin/python -B .ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-semantic-interpreter.py --mode mutations
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 backend/.venv/bin/python -B .ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-semantic-interpreter.py --mode results
```

Source inventory and mutation-contract emission exit 0. Results exit **2**
because the full mapping contract is blocked; stdout is the deterministic
complete report, not an approval. Harness failure exits 3. The report's input
hashes, explicit import/AST allowlists, actual AST/import inventory, full module
origin/hash inventory, Python version and read audit are durable in results.

Final replay command (executed twice, each report byte-identical to the stored
result; interpreter exit 2 and comparison exit 0 are required):

```bash
for oracle_run in 1 2; do
  PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 backend/.venv/bin/python -B .ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-semantic-interpreter.py --mode results | cmp - .ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-semantic-oracle-results.json
  oracle_status=("${PIPESTATUS[@]}")
  printf 'run=%s interpreter_exit=%s byte_compare_exit=%s\n' "$oracle_run" "${oracle_status[0]}" "${oracle_status[1]}"
  if [ "${oracle_status[0]}" != 2 ] || [ "${oracle_status[1]}" != 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
done
```

No production source, migration, contract, production test, current mapping,
resource/oracle artifact, persistence/source-catalog bootstrap, finding ledger,
review state, manifest or packet was edited. Only the eight assigned bootstrap
paths were created, with the schema created by its separate exporter.

### pack-authored-records.py

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mechanical packing/hashing ONLY of explicitly authored record arrays.

No source walk, graph traversal, gate evaluation, evidence inheritance, selector,
cardinality, or target/ordinal choice occurs here. Author files explicitly own
every record. Named source-pointer lookup supplies only the hash input for an
already declared node. This helper is not the semantic interpreter.
"""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy

HERE=Path(__file__).parent
SOURCE=runpy.run_path(str(HERE/"source-author.py"))
EXPECT=runpy.run_path(str(HERE/"expected-author.py"))
BASELINE=json.loads(Path("/private/tmp/slice3b-literal-pg4P9r/baseline-author.json").read_text())
DA=b"paprnav:ad_extraction_v4:applicability-row:2\0"
DB=b"paprnav:ad_extraction_v4:obligation-row:1\0"

def canonical(value):
    if type(value) is dict:
        return b"{"+b",".join(canonical(key)+b":"+canonical(value[key]) for key in sorted(value,key=lambda key:key.encode("utf-16-be")))+b"}"
    if type(value) is list:
        return b"["+b",".join(canonical(item) for item in value)+b"]"
    return json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":"),allow_nan=False).encode()

def digest(value): return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value)).hexdigest()
def row_hash(domain,table,identity): return hashlib.sha256(domain+canonical({"table":table,"identity":identity})).hexdigest()
def at(value,pointer):
    for part in pointer.strip("/").split("/"):
        key=part.replace("~1","/").replace("~0","~")
        value=value[int(key)] if isinstance(value,list) else value[key]
    return value
def replace(value,pointer,replacement):
    parent,_,key=pointer.rpartition("/")
    owner=at(value,parent)
    owner[int(key) if isinstance(owner,list) else key]=copy.deepcopy(replacement)
def zipped(columns,values):
    assert len(columns)==len(values),(columns,values)
    return dict(zip(columns,values,strict=True))

def pack(variant):
    fixture_id=variant["fixtureId"]
    envelope=copy.deepcopy(SOURCE["ENVELOPE"])
    for pointer,value in variant["patches"]: replace(envelope,pointer,value)
    proposal_id=variant.get("proposalIdOverride","pro_"+digest([fixture_id,"proposal"])[:32])
    projections={"slice_3a":"avp_"+digest([fixture_id,"slice_3a"])[:32],"slice_3b":"aox_"+digest([fixture_id,"slice_3b"])[:32]}
    binding_fixture_id=variant.get("evidenceBindingFixtureIdOverride",fixture_id)
    binding_ids={"ev-context":"bnd_"+digest([binding_fixture_id,"ev-context"])[:32],"ev-display":"bnd_"+digest([binding_fixture_id,"ev-display"])[:32],"ev-member":"bnd_"+digest([binding_fixture_id,"ev-member"])[:32],"ev-occurrence":"bnd_"+digest([binding_fixture_id,"ev-occurrence"])[:32],"ev-official":"bnd_"+digest([binding_fixture_id,"ev-official"])[:32]}
    ids={}; nodes=[]; node_by_alias={}
    # Every iteration consumes exactly one literal S(...) record.
    for alias,typ,ptr,key,parent,ordinal,reason,base,effective,role,rep,recipe,prefix,slice_name,kind in EXPECT["NODES"]:
        projection_id=projections[slice_name]
        key=ids[key[1:]] if key.startswith("@") else key
        value=at(envelope["proposal"],ptr)
        # Recipe was explicitly declared by the record author.
        identities={
          "semantic-node":{"projectionId":projection_id,"nodeType":typ,"nodeKey":key,"pointer":ptr},
          "designation-value":{"projectionId":projection_id,"pointer":ptr,"value":value},
          "identity-mapping":{"projectionId":projection_id,"kind":kind,"occurrence":ids.get(parent)}
        }
        identity_hash=row_hash(DA,recipe,identities[recipe])
        ids[alias]=prefix+"_"+identity_hash[:32]
        node={"slice":slice_name,"projectionId":projection_id,"proposalId":proposal_id,"id":ids[alias],"identityHash":identity_hash,"nodeType":typ,"nodeKey":key,"sourcePointer":ptr,"parentNodeId":ids[parent] if parent is not None else None,"canonicalOrdinal":ordinal,"canonicalNodeHash":digest(value),"createdAt":"2026-09-14T00:00:00.000000Z","representationStatus":rep,"baseGate":base,"effectiveGate":effective,"rootRole":role,"reasonCode":reason,"evidence":[]}
        nodes.append(node); node_by_alias[alias]=node
    def resolve(value):
        return ids[value[1:]] if type(value) is str and value.startswith("@") else value
    owners=[]
    owner_by_alias={}
    for alias,table,values in EXPECT["OWNERS"]:
        row={"table":"ad_v4_candidate_"+table,"semantic_node_id":ids[alias],"projection_id":projections["slice_3a"],"proposal_id":proposal_id,**zipped(EXPECT["OWNER_COLUMNS"][table],[resolve(value) for value in values])}
        owners.append(row); owner_by_alias[alias]=row
    for alias,column,value in EXPECT["EXPECTED_VARIANTS"][fixture_id]:
        owner_by_alias[alias][column]=resolve(value)
    mappings=[]
    for alias,source,context,kind,value,origin,state,nvalue,reason,temporal,namespace,version,selector,rule,parent,slot in EXPECT["MAPPINGS"]:
        row={"table":"ad_v4_candidate_app_identity_mappings","id":ids[alias],"semantic_node_id":ids[alias],"projection_id":projections["slice_3a"],"proposal_id":proposal_id,"source_occurrence_node_id":ids[source],"evidence_parent_node_id":ids[context],"identity_kind":kind,"source_value":value,"normalization_origin":origin,"normalized_state":state,"normalized_value":nvalue,"reason":reason,"temporal_scope":temporal,"normalization_namespace":namespace,"normalization_version":version,"review_state":"unreviewed_candidate","identity_hash":node_by_alias[alias]["identityHash"]}
        owners.append(row)
        mappings.append({**row,"selectorId":selector,"consumer":{"ruleId":rule,"parentSlice":"slice_3a","parentNodeId":ids[parent],"canonicalOrdinal":slot,"childSlice":"slice_3a","childNodeId":ids[alias]}})
    evidence=[]
    for alias,purpose,key,ordinal in EXPECT["LINKS"]:
        identity={"projectionId":projections["slice_3a"],"nodeId":ids[alias],"purpose":purpose,"evidenceKey":key}
        link_hash=row_hash(DA,"evidence-link",identity)
        row={"slice":"slice_3a","projectionId":projections["slice_3a"],"proposalId":proposal_id,"id":"avl_"+link_hash[:32],"nodeId":ids[alias],"purpose":purpose,"canonicalOrdinal":ordinal,"evidenceKey":key,"candidateBindingId":binding_ids[key],"linkHash":link_hash}
        evidence.append(row)
        node_by_alias[alias]["evidence"].append([purpose,ordinal,key,binding_ids[key],link_hash])
    edges=[]
    for rule,parent,kind,ordinal,child,propagates in EXPECT["EDGES"]:
        edges.append({"ruleId":rule,"parentSlice":"slice_3a","parentNodeId":ids[parent],"edgeKind":kind,"canonicalOrdinal":ordinal,"childSlice":"slice_3a","childNodeId":ids[child],"propagatesGate":propagates})
    relations=[]
    for table,values in EXPECT["RELATIONS"]:
        relations.append({"table":"ad_v4_candidate_"+table,"projection_id":projections["slice_3a"],"proposal_id":proposal_id,**zipped(EXPECT["RELATION_COLUMNS"][table],[resolve(value) for value in values])})
    references=[]
    for source,kind,target,typ,key in EXPECT["REFERENCES"]:
        references.append({"sourceSlice":"slice_3a","sourceNodeId":ids[source],"targetSlice":"slice_3a","targetProjectionId":projections["slice_3a"],"targetNodeId":ids[target],"targetNodeType":typ,"targetKey":key,"referenceKind":kind})
    # A separately authored seven-node enclosing requirement is copied exactly.
    baseline_ids={"P":proposal_id,"A":projections["slice_3a"],"B":projections["slice_3b"],"scope-a":ids["pa"],"e":"ev-context","ev-a":"ev-context","binding-e":binding_ids["ev-context"],"binding-ev-a":binding_ids["ev-context"]}
    baseline_nodes={}
    for record in BASELINE["nodes"]:
        raw=zipped(BASELINE["nodeColumns"],record)
        alias=raw["id"]; projection_id=projections["slice_3b"]
        identity_hash=row_hash(DB,"semantic-node",{"projectionId":projection_id,"nodeType":raw["nodeType"],"nodeKey":raw["nodeKey"],"pointer":raw["sourcePointer"]})
        baseline_ids[alias]="aon_"+identity_hash[:32]
        node={key:copy.deepcopy(value) for key,value in raw.items() if key!="evidenceIds"}
        node.update(id=baseline_ids[alias],projectionId=projection_id,proposalId=proposal_id,parentNodeId=baseline_ids[raw["parentNodeId"]] if raw["parentNodeId"] is not None else None,identityHash=identity_hash,canonicalNodeHash=digest(at(envelope["proposal"],raw["sourcePointer"])),createdAt="2026-09-14T00:00:00.000000Z",evidence=[])
        nodes.append(node); baseline_nodes[alias]=node
    def baseline_resolve(value):
        return baseline_ids.get(value,value) if type(value) is str else value
    for table in BASELINE["ownerTables"]:
        for values in table["rows"]:
            owners.append({"table":table["table"],**zipped(table["columns"],[baseline_resolve(value) for value in values])})
    for values in BASELINE["evidence"]:
        raw=zipped(BASELINE["evidenceColumns"],values)
        record={key:baseline_resolve(value) for key,value in raw.items()}
        identity={"projectionId":record["projectionId"],"semanticNodeId":record["nodeId"],"purpose":record["purpose"],"evidenceKey":record["evidenceKey"],"ordinal":record["canonicalOrdinal"]}
        link_hash=row_hash(DB,"evidence-link",identity)
        record.update(id="aoe_"+link_hash[:32],linkHash=link_hash)
        evidence.append(record)
        baseline_nodes[raw["nodeId"]]["evidence"].append([record["purpose"],record["canonicalOrdinal"],record["evidenceKey"],record["candidateBindingId"],link_hash])
    for values in BASELINE["edges"]:
        edges.append({key:baseline_resolve(value) for key,value in zipped(BASELINE["edgeColumns"],values).items()})
    for raw in BASELINE["references"]:
        references.append({key:value if key=="targetKey" else baseline_resolve(value) for key,value in raw.items()})
    for node in nodes:
        node["evidence"].sort(key=lambda item:(item[0],item[1],item[2]))
        node["evidenceSetHash"]=digest(node["evidence"]); node["evidenceCount"]=len(node["evidence"])
    # Sorting changes tuple array presentation only; recorded ordinals survive.
    nodes.sort(key=lambda node:(node["slice"],node["sourcePointer"],node["nodeType"],node["nodeKey"],node["id"]))
    edges.sort(key=lambda edge:(edge["parentSlice"],edge["parentNodeId"],edge["edgeKind"],edge["canonicalOrdinal"],edge["childSlice"],edge["childNodeId"]))
    evidence.sort(key=lambda row:(row["slice"],row["nodeId"],row["purpose"],row["canonicalOrdinal"],row["evidenceKey"]))
    owners.sort(key=lambda row:(row["table"],row["semantic_node_id"]))
    relations.sort(key=canonical); references.sort(key=canonical); mappings.sort(key=lambda row:row["semantic_node_id"])
    source_fields="slice projectionId proposalId id identityHash nodeType nodeKey sourcePointer parentNodeId canonicalOrdinal canonicalNodeHash createdAt".split()
    evidence_bindings=[]
    evidence_targets=[]
    for key,source_binding in envelope["proposal"]["evidenceBindings"].items():
        admission_id="adm_"+digest([binding_fixture_id,key,"admission"])[:32]
        admission_hash=digest([binding_fixture_id,key,"synthetic-admission-metadata"])
        evidence_bindings.append({"table":"ad_v4_candidate_evidence_bindings","id":binding_ids[key],"proposal_id":proposal_id,"directive_id":"oracle-directive-main","evidence_key":key,"fragment_id":source_binding["fragmentId"],"fragment_hash":source_binding["fragmentHash"],"admitted_event_id":admission_id,"admitted_event_hash":admission_hash,"validator_version":"paprnav-ad-v4-validator-2","canonicalization_version":"paprnav-ad-v4-c14n-2","created_at":"2026-09-14T00:00:00.000000Z"})
        evidence_targets.append({"id":source_binding["fragmentId"],"kind":"synthetic_fragment_metadata","hash":source_binding["fragmentHash"],"directiveId":"oracle-directive-main","sourceDocumentId":"source-main","sourceContentHash":"1"*64})
        evidence_targets.append({"id":admission_id,"kind":"synthetic_admission_metadata","hash":admission_hash,"fragmentId":source_binding["fragmentId"]})
    fixture={"fixtureId":fixture_id,"envelope":envelope,"context":{"contextKind":"portable_source_projection_rows","binding":{"proposalId":proposal_id,"slice3aProjectionId":projections["slice_3a"],"slice3bProjectionId":projections["slice_3b"],"sourceSchemaVersion":"ad_extraction_v4","sourceValidatorVersion":"paprnav-ad-v4-validator-2","canonicalizationVersion":"paprnav-ad-v4-c14n-2"},"semanticNodes":[{key:node[key] for key in source_fields} for node in nodes],"typedOwners":owners,"evidenceLinks":evidence,"relations":relations,"externalDependencies":[],"externalMetadata":[],"evidenceBindings":[{"id":binding_ids[key],"proposalId":proposal_id,"evidenceKey":key,**value} for key,value in envelope["proposal"]["evidenceBindings"].items()]},"authorAliasToNodeId":{**ids,**{alias:node["id"] for alias,node in baseline_nodes.items()}},"sourceAnnotations":{"optionalScopeMasks":[{"sourcePointer":"/productScopes/0","mask":"000"},{"sourcePointer":"/productScopes/1","mask":"001"},{"sourcePointer":"/productScopes/2","mask":"010"},{"sourcePointer":"/productScopes/3","mask":"011"},{"sourcePointer":"/productScopes/4","mask":"100"},{"sourcePointer":"/productScopes/5","mask":"101"},{"sourcePointer":"/productScopes/6","mask":"110"},{"sourcePointer":"/productScopes/7","mask":"111"}]}}
    golden={"fixtureId":fixture_id,"nodes":nodes,"edges":edges,"identityMappings":mappings,"evidence":evidence,"references":references,"externalDependencies":[],"aggregateReadiness":"human_determination_required","retentionClassification":"candidate_only"}
    fixture["context"]["evidenceBindings"]=evidence_bindings
    fixture["context"]["declaredEvidenceTargets"]=evidence_targets
    return fixture,golden

fixtures=[]; goldens=[]
for variant in SOURCE["VARIANTS"]:

output={"author":"/root/v4_s4b_semantic_oracle_bootstrap","idConvention":"Deterministic row IDs expanded from independently authored source-relative synthetic projection/proposal bindings; these rows are portable fixture context and do not attest persisted authorization or signoff.","fixtures":fixtures,"goldens":goldens,"inputs":{str(path):hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in [HERE/"source-author.py",HERE/"expected-author.py",HERE/"pack-authored-records.py",Path("/private/tmp/slice3b-literal-pg4P9r/baseline-author.json")]}}
(HERE/"packed-3a.json").write_text(json.dumps(output,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"fixtures":len(fixtures),"nodesPerFixture":[len(g["nodes"]) for g in goldens],"edgesPerFixture":[len(g["edges"]) for g in goldens],"path":str(HERE/"packed-3a.json"),"sha256":hashlib.sha256((HERE/"packed-3a.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2))
```
