| PVC / PCV | PERSISTENCE_CHECKER_SOURCE / PERSISTENCE_CHECKER_CATALOG |

For prefix D, target p and ordered slot i: D_MISSING:p, D_SUBSTITUTION:i
(ordered) or :p (other), D_HASH_MISMATCH:p for each of the two distinct stale
probes, D_ORDER_MISMATCH, D_DUPLICATE:p,
D_EXTRA:.ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/unapproved-authority.md,
D_EMPTY, D_ENTRY_SHAPE_MISMATCH:p and D_TARGET_MISSING:p.
Use strict shape, empty, duplicate, unequal-cardinality missing/extra,
equal-cardinality substitution, order, expected-digest equality, target
identity/existence, actual-byte precedence within a registry. Missing scalar
uses MISSING. For n=1 ordered removal, EMPTY wins as in the approved checker;
do not expect MISSING and count an unrelated failure as success.

Semantic historical resolver errors in §4 are exercised before ordinary
HS/HSS per-record freshness dispatch; freshness harnesses mutate only their
designated registry occurrence with a valid explicit resolver and no earlier
scope fault. Document the diagnostic surface in each mutation record.

Emit each inventory's count/shape, every actual logical pointer and target,
original/mutated operand digests, expected and actual exact diagnostic, and
per-registry totals. Result fields include authorityInventoryCount=55,
authorityOccurrenceCount=1926, orderedInventoryCount=31,
orderedAuthorityEntryCount=1581, freshnessProbeCount=10961,
freshnessKillCount=10961 and zero freshnessSurvivorCount,
freshnessWrongDiagnosticCount and freshnessGenericExceptionKillCount.
These are future acceptance requirements, **not claimed executed results**.
Count any additional implementation-discovered occurrence explicitly; never
omit it to meet a target or silently change this closed specification.

## 7. Source preservation, topology and implementation sequence

The inherited extraction remains exactly 347 statements and 292 exclusions,
639 nonoverlapping units covering all 1459 lines/89171 source bytes.
The 292 exclusions remain 273 markup, 14 model metadata and 5 historical
descriptions. Owner totals remain 134/69/46/80/18 in the §3 owner order.
All 29 decision invariant IDs and seven AR invariants remain. Source hash,
line endpoint, byte slice, literal text/hash, ordered IDs, zero-gap/overlap,
closed owner enum, inheritance expansion and all target sections must be
independently rechecked. No classification, requirement, source line or approval
boolean is rewritten merely to make a current binding pass.

The physical and semantic contracts are not changed by this decision:
9 families/201 fields; 77 selections; 74 relations/983 columns/28 owners;
89 resource families/1639 fields; exact source unions, aliases, semantic
52-destination coverage, materializers/canonicalizers/validators/authorization
versions, full resource limits, trusted owner, ACL/event/transaction/read/
rollback/mixed-binary rules, canonical hash domains and mapping goldens stay
as already independently approved.

After independent design approval and a separate bounded implementation grant:

1. Freeze this final revision4 and unchanged v1 map/schema, source documents,
   leaf, subjects/results/provenance and detached component reports. Verify
   their current hashes against §§1–5; any drift is a new gate, not auto-update.
   Capture a recoverable exact snapshot of the narrowly affected downstream
   matrix/integration files. Do not roll back the approved components.
2. Materialize only the two verified historical byte copies, check their
   manifest hashes/sizes, and make the historical resolver fail closed.
   Validate v1 with its original schema and independent full-source scanner.
3. Author v2 wrapper and schema2 from these closed constants. Validate strict
   JSON/schema/version and both namespaces; use independent F expectations
   rather than candidate-derived values. Run deterministic two-pass generation
   and byte equality for these new artifacts. Retain builder-only status.
4. Reverify the already approved persistence/mapping/resource results and every
   mirror. No component regeneration is required or authorized by this
   proposal. Current detached reports remain immutable evidence for the exact
   current hashes; any changed component needs its own new review first.
5. Preserve calibration CI/CB and topology TB exactly. Perform the already
   specified independent calibration two-pass byte replay and separately
   authorized isolated PostgreSQL topology replay with its deterministic
   assertion projection; never overwrite saved topology output. Missing
   runtime/replay is NOT_RUN, not inherited PASS.
6. Reconcile only the authorized downstream matrix statements, naming v2 as
   current and v1 as historical. Preserve semantic sections/current reviewed
   constants. Finalize matrix before freezing its exact F/FR/FM hash.
7. Implement the integrator's closed63 F, all55 registries, scoped resolver,
   schema checks and full10961 freshness suite plus separate semantic/gate
   controls. Run twice; persist results/provenance only from current exact
   inputs. Historical source hashes are distinguished from current authority
   status in output; no “skip stale audit” switch exists.
8. Construct a fresh packet of actual final bytes and request independent
   read-only audit/integration review. That new report is downstream of the
   frozen reviewed packet and never inserted into the same F or v2 subject.
   Coordinator records decisions and ledger/state changes separately.

Topological order in step3 can author map/schema as sibling files: neither
hashes the other; the reviewed schema constants constrain the map, and the
integrator freezes both. No self-hash fixed point is needed. The matrix may
consume their finalized hashes because neither consumes matrix bytes.
The integrator result binds inputs, not itself. Provenance/review must not
create a feedback hash into an earlier node.

## 8. Rollback, later versions and remaining gates

For a failed downstream implementation, retain all new audit/history files as
unapproved evidence, restore the complete authorized matrix/integration bundle
from its verified snapshot, invalidate any generated downstream PASS and return
to the honest stale integrator failure. Never restore old persistence/resource
over independently approved current components just to satisfy v1. Never alter
immutable v1, component reviews or source partition. Do not delete history,
patch only hashes, rewrite golden data, turn NOT_RUN into PASS, or mark this
design self-approved. All unrelated dirty-tree work is preserved.

A future refresh is append-only at the audit-version boundary:

- Advance to `decision-authority-map-v3.json` and
  `decision-authority-map-v3.schema.json`, version map-3/schema-3, then similarly
  explicit monotonically numbered pairs. Never rewrite v2 once frozen/reviewed.
- Before changing a path serving a frozen active authority, preserve its exact
  old bytes under `RUN/authority-history/decision-authority-map-v2/<basename>`
  for that v2 generation. Any non-RUN nested authority must use its complete
  repository-relative path beneath that generation directory, not a basename.
  Preserve all old report/result/schema inputs needed for its declared scope.
- A future versioning proposal must enumerate the finite complete predecessor
  chain, exact historical resolver overrides, active seven (or explicitly
  justified revised count), detached current component reviews, and every F/
  FR/occurrence/mirror count. No dynamic recursive directory crawl or implicit
  “all older versions” wildcard is allowed. The reviewer must independently
  approve that explicit new registry before activation.
- If source documents or statement classification change, make a separately
  named new extraction and closed schema with full old-to-new stable-ID
  migration, source hashes and gap/overlap proof. Do not pretend the 347/292
  invariant is preserved when it is not. Component-only refresh retains v1
  extraction and advances only the active wrapper/approval bindings.
- New component review reports receive new immutable names (never overwrite the
  three reports here). They may replace the current-role entries of a new
  wrapper only after their independent bounded review completes. Old reports
  retain historical roles where the closed chain needs them. Active selection
  is one explicit pair in a new finalized integrator; old packets remain
  reproducible against their snapshots.
- A review of an earlier integration generation may be audit-only history for
  a later generation, but never approval of the later subject and never an input
  to the generation it reviews. Any addition changes counts and needs a reviewed
  successor. No future-report placeholder, circular review condition or
  implicit reapproval is accepted.

Remaining gates: independent review of this revision4 architecture; separately
authorized successor/history/integration implementation; independent verification
of exact schema/source/resolver/approval scopes and all new freshness coverage;
required calibration/topology replay (or honest NOT_RUN); fresh independent
overall Slice-4B design review; required external critic/coordinator disposition
and closure; every still-unimplemented production schema/migration/permission/
transaction/resource/read/response/mixed-binary gate. Existing component PASSes
are preserved at their exact scoped hashes and do not waive these gates.

## 9. Focused design-only verification

The author independently scanned live JSON and Python literal ASTs to resolve
the old/new subject hashes, current report digests, F composition and mirrors.
The 63-entry composition and 55/1926/31/1581/10961 arithmetic were computed from
the explicit tables, not copied from an old report. Strict schema/source
coverage checks against the immutable v1, exact historical-byte recovery checks,
all embedded complete JSON examples, and final file/hash preservation checks
are the bounded verification for this document. No successor artifact, component
replay result or future10961-probe PASS is asserted by those checks.

The existing stale integrator's failure was independently reproduced read-only.
Focused checks executed successfully with Python 3.11.15 and jsonschema 4.26.0:
strict duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON parsing and Draft202012Validator check_schema
plus validation for immutable v1; independent 639-unit line/byte/text/hash
partition verification (347/292, 1459 lines, 89171 bytes, zero uncovered,
overlapping or duplicate IDs); strict parsing of all four complete JSON examples
(4/2/7/5 records); actual-byte verification of every existing example/F target
and both recovered historical subjects; independent AST extraction and equality
of the four new 25-binding mirrors, 49 source pins and two catalog pins; and
independent parsing/summing of this persisted document's 63-entry F table and
55-registry table to reproduce 1926/31/1581/10961. The shape-only resource-schema
mirror was checked to have 25 type-string properties and no digest constants.
All 75 pre-existing top-level run files retain their exact captured hashes;
the only added run file is this document. git diff --check passes. No v2 map,
schema or historical repository snapshot was created. These are design-author
checks, not independent review or execution of the proposed successor suite.

No database/container, dependency install, production change, staging, commit,
matrix/result update or finding/state/review mutation occurred in this pass.
The proposal is implementation-complete as a specification but remains
`DESIGN_PROPOSAL_ONLY_AWAITING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW`.

    {
      "id": "DEC-L0075-L0076",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 75,
      "lineEnd": 76,
      "byteStart": 3451,
      "byteEnd": 3562,
      "text": "Any implementation change in an excluded consumer is a scope finding and stops\nthe slice for design amendment.\n",
      "textSha256": "252dc71805013c4e87c49f2f0afe6be59cd9da16ff352ccd684dd3ffcb82e818",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "top_level_integration_review",
      "targetAuthority": {

        "section": "source line 75"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "integration_or_production_gate_not_implemented_or_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0080-L0081",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 80,
      "lineEnd": 81,
      "byteStart": 3601,
      "byteEnd": 3695,
      "text": "These are falsifiable gates. An implementation or closure claim fails if any\none is unproved.\n",
      "textSha256": "416a1b06ee7b61596f5624aec39bf74db7e617e01c57b2e912e7ff579f6bfb95",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "top_level_integration_review",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/decision.md",
        "section": "source line 80"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "integration_or_production_gate_not_implemented_or_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0085-L0088",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 85,
      "lineEnd": 88,
      "byteStart": 3734,
      "byteEnd": 3983,
      "text": "- **S4B-I01:** The only affirmative state representable by this contract is\n  `candidate_only`. No table, enum, event, route, flag, or serializer introduced\n  here can represent actionable, released, selected, current, published, or V3\n  authority.\n",
      "textSha256": "04cb6f743a06d4e699b8c3f21b5529b3737c21971a2124f1c31e733ee0f14abc",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0089-L0091",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 89,
      "lineEnd": 91,
      "byteStart": 3983,
      "byteEnd": 4183,
      "text": "- **S4B-I02:** Every accepted response and historical decision carries\n  `releaseBlocked=true`, `authorityEffect=none`, and\n  `releaseBlocker=candidate_only_not_release_authority` in canonical bytes.\n",
      "textSha256": "0b364d9d5d27670f62a3e6545a39626e6728e14d279398a156b1a62ffe338662",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0092-L0094",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 92,
      "lineEnd": 94,
      "byteStart": 4183,
      "byteEnd": 4378,
      "text": "- **S4B-I03:** A successful acceptance transaction leaves all V1/V2/V3 rows and\n  every released/search/match/coverage/compliance/due row byte- and state-equal\n  to its pre-transaction snapshot.\n",
      "textSha256": "ae8ebafca4176825da9256c8687a5237a174560bc5d57af81032060b40fd0a64",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "later_production_enforcement",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/decision.md",
        "section": "source line 92"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "integration_or_production_gate_not_implemented_or_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0095-L0099",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 95,
      "lineEnd": 99,
      "byteStart": 4378,
      "byteEnd": 4774,
      "text": "- **S4B-I04:** No existing released reader imports, joins, selects, or falls back\n  to a 4B table. IDs are interpreted only through a typed, table-scoped lookup:\n  a candidate-decision identifier presented to a released-authority endpoint is\n  looked up only in that endpoint's released table and a miss is final. The\n  design does not claim that opaque scalar identifier domains cannot collide.\n",
      "textSha256": "2a12486b49611bd2c41472053a5e2c1aa1becff90fafe0098bee7c9fe97a05a7",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "later_production_enforcement",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/decision.md",
        "section": "source line 95"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "integration_or_production_gate_not_implemented_or_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0103-L0106",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 103,
      "lineEnd": 106,
      "byteStart": 4814,
      "byteEnd": 5088,
      "text": "- **S4B-I05:** Acceptance binds exactly one 0029 case in `pending_review`, its\n  one frozen review request, and the exact latest event hash. The request's\n  stable input identity and the newly observed stable input identity are equal;\n  observation times/hashes may differ.\n",
      "textSha256": "8bdb44d64282cacce962355ba743e8d144fbd7a396304d71d89e884d4507ba10",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0107-L0110",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 107,
      "lineEnd": 110,
      "byteStart": 5088,
      "byteEnd": 5360,
      "text": "- **S4B-I06:** Every observation component is `verified`: candidate proposal,\n  evidence, current Slice-3A projection, and current Slice-3B projection. A\n  missing, stale, unsupported, integrity-error, differently hashed, or\n  cross-boundary component cannot be accepted.\n",
      "textSha256": "ffe9eed2ac06fa07e2e3aa21b7e0d7fb803ca4d41de4361d6082bd1340896428",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0111-L0115",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 111,
      "lineEnd": 115,
      "byteStart": 5360,
      "byteEnd": 5693,
      "text": "- **S4B-I07:** The accepted decision binds directive/proposal IDs, proposal and\n  evidence-binding hashes, validator/canonicalization versions, both projection\n  IDs/hashes/materializer versions/event-head hashes, Slice-3B mapping\n  version/digest, cutoff hash, authorship-set hash/count, and requested/current\n  observation hashes.\n",
      "textSha256": "7c6ec15f34cf6bc791ce0e7e496e86fbd080518c591a066a0adce662ea286605",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P08 — Closed field and relation facts"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0116-L0120",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 116,
      "lineEnd": 120,
      "byteStart": 5693,
      "byteEnd": 6029,
      "text": "- **S4B-I08:** Candidate, evidence lifecycle, retained bytes, candidate\n  submission/relationship cutoff, projection events, relational\n  reconstructions, typed-owner reconstructions, counts, references, correction\n  bindings, and mapping digests are reverified inside the acceptance\n  transaction. Page-load results are not authority.\n",
      "textSha256": "b682ed546033fb5e5d2912f73a071a410499ea622e1d4c611920d084df4c8653",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0121-L0124",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 121,
      "lineEnd": 124,
      "byteStart": 6029,
      "byteEnd": 6338,
      "text": "- **S4B-I09:** Historical integrity verifies the frozen input and graph under the\n  recorded versions. Current eligibility separately compares live heads and\n  current authorization facts. Later staleness never rewrites history, and\n  current data is never substituted for an unavailable historical verifier.\n",
      "textSha256": "7ba888c0572c9e6193353c7e15a4d08570efdb234dcf9fa3c0cf7fe17bf21fde",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0128-L0131",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 128,
      "lineEnd": 131,
      "byteStart": 6378,
      "byteEnd": 6633,
      "text": "- **S4B-I10:** Every semantic node in the bound 3A projection and every semantic\n  node in the bound 3B projection has exactly one decision-node row. No extra,\n  missing, duplicate, reordered, cross-projection, or differently described\n  node can commit.\n",
      "textSha256": "7e90889b1cde2ffe45e7087229a3050b1dcf0a10131739e4730b8c9a8c917ad9",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",

    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0132-L0135",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 132,
      "lineEnd": 135,
      "byteStart": 6633,
      "byteEnd": 6928,
      "text": "- **S4B-I11:** Each node row repeats and hashes the authoritative slice,\n  projection/node identity, node type/key, source pointer, parent, ordinal,\n  canonical node hash, exact evidence-link-set hash/count, representation\n  status, base gate, effective gate, controlling role, and reason code.\n",
      "textSha256": "0cbddc39382c3e6ba97539eb2dd0e97705f724974d1b432fc94714356236ee96",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P08 — Closed field and relation facts"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0136-L0138",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 136,
      "lineEnd": 138,
      "byteStart": 6928,
      "byteEnd": 7146,
      "text": "- **S4B-I12:** Gate values are closed to `candidate_only` and\n  `human_determination_required`. `actionable` is deliberately unrepresentable\n  in 4B. Source-faithful representation never upgrades automation authority.\n",
      "textSha256": "ad9822ec80fe4d32066a79e11c324e36e66e0d04f1992e32e081d4a860e83cfb",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0139-L0142",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 139,
      "lineEnd": 142,
      "byteStart": 7146,
      "byteEnd": 7430,
      "text": "- **S4B-I13:** The complete edge set is exactly the matrix-defined set from typed\n  owners and relationship rows. Endpoints, kinds, fixed/canonical ordinals, and\n  propagation flags are deterministic. Every 3A identity mapping is consumed\n  exactly once by an allowed owner selector.\n",
      "textSha256": "3b9dd8b6f8aef3c64a03d8f3786d55b1a474083063dbb090fdeb8f08229d39e4",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "semantic_mapping",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-mapping-v1.json",
        "section": "/typedAst and /executionContract"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "semantic_bootstrap",
      "approvalScope": "reference_inputs_approved_current_mapping_subject_not_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0143-L0149",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 143,
      "lineEnd": 149,
      "byteStart": 7430,
      "byteEnd": 7941,
      "text": "- **S4B-I14:** The semantic-readiness lattice is ordered\n  `candidate_only < human_determination_required`; the effective gate is the\n  **maximum** (most restrictive) of a node's base gate and every propagating\n  child's effective gate. The propagating graph is acyclic. Integrity-only\n  edges resolve exactly but do not propagate. Noncontrolling roots are verified\n  but do not enter the aggregate. The separate fixed retention classification\n  is always `candidate_only`; it is never computed from readiness.\n",
      "textSha256": "b98118f94824851c606524b01875b8e7e1045f5792c169c7bf081eaead0ab939",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "semantic_mapping",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-mapping-v1.json",
        "section": "/typedAst and /executionContract"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "semantic_bootstrap",
      "approvalScope": "reference_inputs_approved_current_mapping_subject_not_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0150-L0155",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 150,
      "lineEnd": 155,
      "byteStart": 7941,
      "byteEnd": 8353,
      "text": "- **S4B-I15:** Every change-dependency node has exactly one frozen external\n  dependency row in the exact `resolved_candidate|unresolved|ambiguous` union.\n  A resolved outgoing row binds the target projection/head and its exact\n  reciprocal incoming row; resolved incoming rows bind their source dependency.\n  Unresolved and ambiguous rows forbid target/source fields and retain their\n  exact controlled reason.\n",
      "textSha256": "3fc528f031cf998dbdaa76e0cfc620895f0b3adbd3d8d5a90bafbaeda89b62b9",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0156-L0159",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 156,
      "lineEnd": 159,
      "byteStart": 8353,
      "byteEnd": 8658,
      "text": "- **S4B-I16:** Aggregate retention classification is fixed to `candidate_only`\n  only after every integrity prerequisite passes. Semantic readiness is\n  separately the maximum effective gate over controlling roots and may be\n  `human_determination_required`; neither value represents release eligibility.\n",
      "textSha256": "bb2f9e574aabe6878e136ee8cecb6324de96dc23f1120e42abc9cab977bb3b85",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "semantic_mapping",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-mapping-v1.json",
        "section": "/typedAst and /executionContract"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "semantic_bootstrap",
      "approvalScope": "reference_inputs_approved_current_mapping_subject_not_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0163-L0166",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 163,
      "lineEnd": 166,
      "byteStart": 8703,
      "byteEnd": 8982,
      "text": "- **S4B-I17:** The acceptance route performs fresh server-side authorization,\n  then repeats it after actor/membership locks and at the deferred commit\n  boundary. The required relationship is active user + active matching\n  membership + `platform_admin` under `status_only_v1`.\n",
      "textSha256": "d84088792b1f652c86a307b1aafdaa61e2b5fe3e7d3555a17442e4b7096b40ce",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0167-L0171",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 167,
      "lineEnd": 171,
      "byteStart": 8982,
      "byteEnd": 9343,
      "text": "- **S4B-I18:** The accepting signer is absent from the complete frozen authorship\n  source set: every proposal submission actor, every bound fragment creator,\n  and every bound fragment admission actor. SQL derives the same set\n  independently. Draft authors and review requesters are not semantic authors\n  unless they also occur in one of those source roles.\n",
      "textSha256": "6b57e765e23a83b1a627c29d38c525b1c71e98ce6bd71698fde71260a02fa899",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0172-L0174",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 172,
      "lineEnd": 174,
      "byteStart": 9343,
      "byteEnd": 9556,
      "text": "- **S4B-I19:** One independent human signoff is necessary and sufficient for\n  candidate-only retention. No self-review override, second-signature shortcut,\n  machine-author inference, or UI authorization exists.\n",
      "textSha256": "7b663eb4210d63f9c43e39ef348c10dd502fdaa19d0730c564668253b5c3e511",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0175-L0179",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 175,
      "lineEnd": 179,
      "byteStart": 9556,
      "byteEnd": 9877,
      "text": "- **S4B-I20:** The decision and signoff retain the exact actor, membership,\n  organization, role/status, policy/action/version, claims hash, authorization\n  observation, decision time, request hash, and domain-separated signature\n  hash. The signature is an internal integrity digest, not PKI or legal\n  non-repudiation.\n",
      "textSha256": "9b3a9dc2e82068e416771b5daad533c1327aa4f901a5295e7ea7fc2137043c6d",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0183-L0187",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 183,
      "lineEnd": 187,
      "byteStart": 9923,
      "byteEnd": 10264,
      "text": "- **S4B-I21:** The only new transition is\n  `pending_review -> candidate_only_accepted/candidate_only`. It atomically\n  creates one decision, its complete graph, one accepting signoff, and one case\n  event. An accepted case is terminal under 4B and cannot acquire drafts,\n  rejection, a second acceptance, or a same-proposal successor case.\n",
      "textSha256": "2ce9d766cb041cd0c70fc30a107942b492ece965d4025c108c845dda8db97ac9",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0188-L0190",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 188,
      "lineEnd": 190,
      "byteStart": 10264,
      "byteEnd": 10501,
      "text": "- **S4B-I22:** Rejected cases retain the existing successor behavior. Semantic\n  correction produces a new candidate and its own review case; future release\n  review uses a later contract rather than altering or promoting a 4B decision.\n",
      "textSha256": "3ffd98154fe3aeaed75bb3826c4270ac06f6e10081eed1d8a621794814c8a8f6",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0191-L0194",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 191,
      "lineEnd": 194,
      "byteStart": 10501,
      "byteEnd": 10768,
      "text": "- **S4B-I23:** Exact idempotent retry returns the original accepted result.\n  Reuse of the key with different canonical request bytes conflicts. Concurrent\n  reject/accept or accept/accept transactions commit at most one terminal branch\n  and leave no partial graph.\n",
      "textSha256": "df6ebae21f2fbf756f6bc0f1e41029ff0fadcbf47b638ed384c80c220ba06e28",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0195-L0200",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 195,
      "lineEnd": 200,
      "byteStart": 10768,
      "byteEnd": 11196,
      "text": "- **S4B-I24:** All participants, including Slice-3A materialization that creates\n  reciprocal external rows, obey one global stable lock order covering the\n  complete transitive external-target projection set. Every target head is\n  preflighted, locked, hash-bound, and rechecked at commit. Deadlock and\n  serialization victims return the existing stable retry/conflict class; they\n  never trigger a second uncoordinated write.\n",
      "textSha256": "7dc53a653e2b22a4b6200546c6ec57510cee8ea8ada499eb241cdb12751c583c",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0204-L0220",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 204,
      "lineEnd": 220,
      "byteStart": 11245,
      "byteEnd": 12553,
      "text": "- **S4B-I25:** Every accepted decision owns one internal validation sentinel.\n  Statement-level transition-table triggers on every authority child increment\n  its bounded generation and reject writes once it is sealed. A deferred\n  constraint trigger performs at most one full aggregate validation over the\n  transaction's final graph and seals the sentinel; later callbacks are\n  constant-time, including after `SET CONSTRAINTS ... IMMEDIATE`. The validator\n  independently derives expected nodes, edges, external dependencies,\n  authorship, lifecycle, hashes, counts, and closed states from trusted typed\n  projection/review rows. Catalog tests prove trigger coverage for every table;\n  caller-supplied JSON or aggregate hashes never prove their own correctness.\n  The authority relations and three `SECURITY DEFINER` trigger functions are\n  owned by a non-login, non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS role. Each function has a\n  fixed hardened search path and schema-qualified relation access. PUBLIC and\n  runtime EXECUTE are revoked; runtime has only the named authority INSERT and\n  read privileges needed for normal writes. Runtime has no ownership, DDL,\n  sentinel DML, role membership, or sequence escape. Catalog assertions and a\n  true runtime login prove the boundary before and after adversarial writes.\n",
      "textSha256": "93b9c89252a59896a15eb922cabfa18391304f08ab1d3b51d80d39ae616efcfb",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0221-L0223",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 221,
      "lineEnd": 223,
      "byteStart": 12553,
      "byteEnd": 12790,
      "text": "- **S4B-I26:** Acceptance and decision GETs fail closed on decision, node, edge,\n  evidence, identity, hash, reference, cardinality, lifecycle, signoff, or\n  version drift. GETs are read-only, repeatable-read, bounded, and never repair.\n",
      "textSha256": "8df3f56e0fdb7df3ecc47bd94276700a72aee6e73346066f14ab68eece7b5182",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0224-L0230",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 224,
      "lineEnd": 230,
      "byteStart": 12790,
      "byteEnd": 13255,
      "text": "- **S4B-I27:** Count and exact UTF-8/octet preflights run before graph/source\n  payload loading. Python pending structures, PostgreSQL derivation, stored row\n  envelopes, canonical set frames, external target metadata, and response pages\n  use the same manifest formulas and ceilings. A schema-valid but over-budget\n  candidate remains pending/rejectable and receives\n  `acceptance_capacity_exceeded`, never partial acceptance or an indirect target\n  payload load.\n",
      "textSha256": "c555701ab776b8c23b98dc16daf556e68a4bd1923a2341db39aefca2c652f84f",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "resource_accounting",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/resource-accounting-v2.json",
        "section": "/rowFamilies, /limits, /phaseLedgers, /pending and /history"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "resource_subject_has_builder_evidence_only",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0231-L0234",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 231,
      "lineEnd": 234,
      "byteStart": 13255,
      "byteEnd": 13553,
      "text": "- **S4B-I28:** All five canonical calibration packets accept candidate-only with\n  exact candidate/3A/3B reconstruction, exact golden node/edge/reason counts,\n  immutable signoff, verified historical GET, and unchanged V3/released state.\n  One-bit corruption in each authority family fails closed.\n",
      "textSha256": "f083358e522fb1782eaeee033e5b02d0186fae10d88f9d6a0e6f4a0fe68fff3e",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "later_production_enforcement",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/decision.md",
        "section": "source line 231"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "integration_or_production_gate_not_implemented_or_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0235-L0237",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 235,
      "lineEnd": 237,
      "byteStart": 13553,
      "byteEnd": 13744,
      "text": "- **S4B-I29:** Clean-host and freshly migrated disposable PostgreSQL suites,\n  upgrade/rollback tests, independent implementation review, and independent\n  closure review pass before commit.\n",
      "textSha256": "44ddfc73418dfdc77dc196e5ef604c22ee60a0f081c5cbd9b62d62a6120e7e8d",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "later_production_enforcement",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/decision.md",
        "section": "source line 235"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "integration_or_production_gate_not_implemented_or_approved",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0263-L0265",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 263,
      "lineEnd": 265,
      "byteStart": 15099,
      "byteEnd": 15257,
      "text": "Legacy V3 approval is a materially different release path. It publishes and\nchanges downstream state and must not be imported, called, or generalized for\n4B.\n",

      "byteEnd": 16373,
      "text": "The pre-implementation design packet includes the schema-validated\n[`acceptance-mapping-v1.json`](acceptance-mapping-v1.json), validated by\n[`acceptance-mapping.schema.json`](acceptance-mapping.schema.json) and the\nstdlib-only [`acceptance-design-validator.py`](acceptance-design-validator.py).\nThe validator requires exact ordered IDs, closed discriminators, referential\nintegrity, unknown-key rejection, source-contract enum/union/optional-property\nparity, and current resource-contract hashes before any generator may consume\nthe manifest.       "text": "The generator verifies its own source hash, JSON Schema, stable ordering,\nselector uniqueness, exact coverage of the 28 current node types, 40 edge\nconstructions, eight identity selectors, six external branches, and generated-file freshness.       "text": "Migration 0030 adds six V4-only insert-only authority tables and one internal\nvalidation-sentinel table. Names may be shortened only for PostgreSQL\nidentifier limits, without changing meaning.\n",

      "text": "Migration 0030 adds nullable `candidate_decision_id` and\n`acceptance_signoff_id` to `ad_v4_review_case_events`, expands event/state checks\nto one exact acceptance branch, and preserves the old rejection branch\nunchanged.     {
      "id": "DEC-L0354-L0358",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 354,
      "lineEnd": 358,
      "byteStart": 20454,
      "byteEnd": 20829,
      "text": "The migration does **not** change draft `intended_action`; it remains exactly\n`undecided|reject`. Candidate acceptance has no draft intent. A frozen `reject`\nintent blocks acceptance as `review_intent_conflict`; no draft or an undecided\ndraft is merely non-authoritative annotation. This preserves exact 0029 row\ncompatibility while 4B is disabled and on physical downgrade.\n",
      "textSha256": "d5d231cc14d0170332eea9759bfcfa9a369f2611865fbd2fc2cb912b8dbc1291",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {

    },

      "lineEnd": 361,
      "byteStart": 20830,
      "byteEnd": 20978,
      "text": "All new rows reject UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE. Decision rows have no FK or ORM\nrelationship to V3 or released/current tables and no cascade into them.\n",

      "lineEnd": 410,
      "byteStart": 22679,
      "byteEnd": 23076,
      "text": "The new authorization action is `accept_ad_v4_candidate_only`, policy name\n`paprnav-ad-v4-candidate-acceptance-1`, version `1`. The stable auth snapshot\nuses the existing 19-key `status_only_v1` shape with the new action and its own\ndomains. Service and SQL select actor first and membership second `FOR UPDATE`,\nrequire exact active/matching/platform-admin fields, and hold locks through\ncommit.\n",

    },

      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 412,
      "lineEnd": 415,
      "byteStart": 23077,
      "byteEnd": 23390,
      "text": "At acceptance, Python and SQL each recompute the current authorship/cutoff,\nrequire exact equality to the request, then materialize one authorship row per\nbinding. The signer must not occur in any binding. Later user deactivation does\nnot invalidate historical authorization; it changes only current eligibility.\n",

      "owner": "foundational_persistence",

        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0425-L0430",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 425,
      "lineEnd": 430,
      "byteStart": 23623,
      "byteEnd": 24065,
      "text": "Only `draft_saved` repeats. Rejection and acceptance are mutually exclusive.\nAcceptance requires new decision/signoff IDs and forbids rejection IDs; the\nrejection branch is the inverse. Object/event completeness is bidirectional.\nDraft intent remains the 0029 `undecided|reject` annotation, not authority: a\nreject-intent draft blocks the affirmative branch, while no draft or undecided\nintent does not fabricate a prior acceptance decision.\n",
      "textSha256": "c20935bc07335e0dfb18698a76ae557acd496f49b3f1551360b6daa95ea91273",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0432-L0435",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 432,
      "lineEnd": 435,
      "byteStart": 24066,
      "byteEnd": 24351,
      "text": "Same-proposal successor cases remain permitted only after `rejected`. A 4B\naccepted proposal cannot be reopened. Semantic correction creates a new\ncandidate, projections, and case. Future release review uses a later contract;\nit cannot mutate, promote, or reinterpret the 4B decision.\n",
      "textSha256": "3137ff3812243f650d840de30066f4341958b0d422d01ae61df398a6d2fc5db0",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0439-L0445",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 439,
      "lineEnd": 445,
      "byteStart": 24385,
      "byteEnd": 24898,
      "text": "Preflight first derives the complete set of directly bound 3A/3B projections\nand all resolved external target projections by selecting identifiers,\nprojection hashes, materializer versions, and event-head hashes only. It does\nnot load target candidate JSON, datum rows, typed owners, or evidence payloads.\nAll participants then lock the same globally sorted projection-ID set; this is\nalso the required order for Slice-3A materialization when it appends reciprocal\nincoming dependencies. Every 4B writer follows:\n",
      "textSha256": "2249c0eb8e446ad87a8256acc9c7494528600ac8742bb623c06ba7b3eeed7972",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {

        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"

    },

      "lineEnd": 447,
      "byteStart": 24899,
      "byteEnd": 24937,
      "text": "1. actor user, then exact membership;\n",

      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",

      "text": "No participant may acquire an earlier lock after a later lock.       "text": "The existing case serializer gains optional candidate-decision and acceptance-\nsignoff summaries plus fixed non-authority fields. Queue reads stay summary-only.\n",
      "textSha256": "c8495a55a74ecc5dac507a55665e4e455679a2417c208735c11b0f2127a919f6",

      "lineStart": 487,
      "lineEnd": 491,
      "byteStart": 26908,
      "byteEnd": 27300,
      "text": "Historical verification dispatches candidate validator/canonicalizer, 3A and\n3B materializer/mapping, acceptance mapping/gate/dependency, lifecycle, and auth\nversions. It verifies frozen hashes, full event chain, object bijection, both\ntyped projection reconstructions, every graph set, and historical source/event\nexistence. Unsupported historical versions fail closed without substitution.\n",

      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {

      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {

      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 493,
      "lineEnd": 494,
      "byteStart": 27301,
      "byteEnd": 27447,
      "text": "Current eligibility is a separate fresh observation and current signer-status\nresult. Neither historical nor current status is release authority.\n",

      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",

      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0498-L0504",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 498,
      "lineEnd": 504,
      "byteStart": 27493,
      "byteEnd": 27987,
      "text": "The reviewed manifest reduces the unbenchmarked proposal to at most **20,000\ncombined semantic nodes**, **40,000 dependency rows**, **2,000 external rows**,\n**2,000 authorship rows**, and **64 MiB total graph work**. Existing 1 MiB\ncanonical-column and 40 MiB case-history limits remain. A calibration benchmark\nand its limits are frozen in\n[`sql-topology-benchmark.md`](sql-topology-benchmark.md); closure may lower a\nlimit after measured evidence but may not raise one without design review.\n",
      "textSha256": "4843cc74d354bc7b87889cc6b3a3a4d56f01b5579051ac5cfd3049a65d3fc984",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "resource_accounting",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/resource-accounting-v2.json",
        "section": "/rowFamilies, /limits, /phaseLedgers, /pending and /history"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "resource_subject_has_builder_evidence_only",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0506-L0512",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 506,
      "lineEnd": 512,
      "byteStart": 27988,
      "byteEnd": 28421,
      "text": "The schema-validated\n[`resource-accounting-v2.json`](resource-accounting-v2.json) is the complete\nfield/type inventory for 48 source and nine output/pending families (740 named\nfields). Strict UTF-8 identifiers/text, 64-byte lowercase hashes, raw bytes,\none-byte booleans, signed big-endian int64/timestamp-microseconds, normalized\ndecimal UTF-8, and nullable presence tags are closed types. For family `f` the\nexact binary work is:\n",
      "textSha256": "f8bb6d8f108e4cd50dac58578441e1bdc7c0343d5683f930c1b1f6c024182804",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "resource_accounting",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/resource-accounting-v2.json",
        "section": "/rowFamilies, /limits, /phaseLedgers, /pending and /history"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "resource_subject_has_builder_evidence_only",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0514-L0521",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 514,
      "lineEnd": 521,
      "byteStart": 28422,
      "byteEnd": 28766,
      "text": "```text\nfield(v) = u16(name_octets) || UTF8(name)\n           || nullable_tag_if_declared || u64(value_octets) || value_if_present\nrow_f    = u16(field_count) || each declared field(v)\nset_f    = u16(domain_octets) || UTF8(domain) || u64(row_count)\n           || each(u64(row_octets) || row_f)\nW_total  = SUM(set_f in declared family order)\n```\n",
      "textSha256": "ca5029cff77d9a58b1f3c85374b2ade063c50dfa7e7120b547a12a5d3efde39b",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "resource_accounting",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/resource-accounting-v2.json",
        "section": "/rowFamilies, /limits, /phaseLedgers, /pending and /history"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "resource_subject_has_builder_evidence_only",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0523-L0532",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 523,
      "lineEnd": 532,
      "byteStart": 28767,
      "byteEnd": 29519,
      "text": "`output:pending_copy` is the only pending-row accounting family, preventing\ndouble charging. Its row stores decision ID, family ID, ordinal, row-frame\nbytes, and row-frame hash. The JSON names every logical selector in order and\nis exact-`const` Draft-2020-12 validated; an independent AST check matches each\npersisted 3A/3B column/type/nullability and each of the 28 owner tables. SQL\nuses count cap+1 and aggregate scalar widths before payload fetch. External\ntargets contribute only the seven named ID/hash/version/head metadata fields;\nloading their candidate, evidence, datum, owner, or canonical payload is\nforbidden. The executable arithmetic vectors accept exactly 67,108,864 bytes\nand reject 67,108,865. Graph pages remain at most 1,000 rows.\n",
      "textSha256": "ba8ded372b7d3f84fc92e773ffde385c83e8a6a741b36bb22f4b9078d1f770a4",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "resource_accounting",

      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "resource_subject_has_builder_evidence_only",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0534-L0534",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 534,
      "lineEnd": 534,
      "byteStart": 29520,
      "byteEnd": 29592,
      "text": "Capacity failure leaves the case pending/rejectable and writes nothing.\n",
      "textSha256": "e4ca8e76e4404d5f6ec6429a64fe74733840e145a78923c508b684867498e4fc",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "resource_accounting",

      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "none",
      "approvalScope": "resource_subject_has_builder_evidence_only",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0538-L0541",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 538,
      "lineEnd": 541,
      "byteStart": 29635,
      "byteEnd": 29890,
      "text": "0030 is expand-only. It adds DB gate\n`reviewer4_candidate_acceptance_enabled=false` and application flag\n`PAPRNAV_AD_V4_SLICE4B_ACCEPTANCE_ENABLED=false`. Neither is enabled by the\nmigration. Existing 0029 rejection behavior remains valid while disabled.\n",
      "textSha256": "a52cc99e333a97d77ec53866fa3bbe09b8fa644484cccfad76b897a206941848",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": true,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "storage_shape_and_invariants_only_not_runtime_enforcement",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0543-L0550",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 543,
      "lineEnd": 550,
      "byteStart": 29891,
      "byteEnd": 30457,
      "text": "Disabled behavior is exact and testable: with the application flag false, the\naccept POST is absent as `404 capability_disabled` before DB mutation; with the\napplication flag true and DB gate false, it returns\n`409 reviewer4_candidate_acceptance_gate_disabled`; decision GET remains\navailable only for already-existing 4B rows and otherwise returns ordinary 404;\n0029 request/reject/draft/list/detail bytes and SQL behavior are unchanged in\nboth combinations. No 4B decision, sentinel, signoff, event, or 0030-only value\nmay appear while either write gate is false.\n",
      "textSha256": "934c20378b77171d721d34684f37e632576d8de05fa167c529a05ee0018f3da6",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0552-L0554",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 552,
      "lineEnd": 554,
      "byteStart": 30458,
      "byteEnd": 30647,
      "text": "Rollout: keep gates off; migrate all DBs; deploy 0030-aware replicas; run 0029\nregressions; enable application flag; enable DB gate; exercise one nonproduction\nacceptance and verified GET.\n",
      "textSha256": "b0e58a4546979ec610413557ad6285d1d703347c561c63536b4bea039ff9aae9",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P10 — Atomic acceptance, readers, rollout and preservation"
      },
      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0556-L0562",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 556,
      "lineEnd": 562,
      "byteStart": 30648,
      "byteEnd": 31173,
      "text": "Operational rollback disables DB then application acceptance gates and retains\n0030-aware readers. Physical downgrade uses bounded table-first locking and\nrefuses if the gate is enabled, any 4B authority or sentinel table is occupied, or\nan acceptance event exists. Because 0030 never expands draft intent or stores\nany 0030-only value in 0029 tables while disabled, empty disabled downgrade\nrestores byte-for-byte 0029 functions, checks, triggers, schemas, gate\ninventory, and row validity. It never deletes signed history.\n",
      "textSha256": "a80ab735e4e498d6bda3dc66bbf3d1328452fc40b64af60b5977218ea79bbed4",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {
        "path": ".ai/review-runs/T081-V4-SCHEMA-SLICE-4B/acceptance-persistence-requirements-v2.md",
        "section": "P05 — Trusted owner and transaction lifecycle"

      "alreadyRepresentedByApprovedContract": false,
      "approvalEvidenceId": "bootstrap_storage",
      "approvalScope": "specified_foundation_runtime_or_compatibility_proof_still_required",
      "classificationBasis": "manual_semantic_review_of_complete_source_unit; primary_owner_controls_requirement; enforcement_and_cross_layer_consumers_do_not_add_upstream_edges"
    },
    {
      "id": "DEC-L0564-L0565",
      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 564,
      "lineEnd": 565,
      "byteStart": 31174,
      "byteEnd": 31298,
      "text": "There is no mixed-version write period after enablement. A 0029 binary is\nallowed only while 4B is disabled and unoccupied.\n",
      "textSha256": "88942377c181f53eee124ad422b04543b84364030cf122761fdcbc06d0e80ac3",
      "normative": true,
      "owner": "foundational_persistence",
      "targetAuthority": {

    },
    {

      "sourceId": "DEC",
      "lineStart": 567,
      "lineEnd": 572,
      "byteStart": 31299,
      "byteEnd": 31768,
      "text": "Downgrade tests cover all four gate combinations, every occupied 4B table\nindividually, a forged acceptance event without a new root, an unsealed sentinel,\nand an empty disabled database. Only the last succeeds, after which schema,\nconstraint/trigger/function definitions and all retained 0029 rows are compared\nto a fresh 0029 database.       "text": "Must remain unchanged and be searched during review: legacy V3 review/approval,\n`app.services.ad_release`, catalog/detail/search, matching, coverage, compliance,\nrecurrence/termination credit, due state, providers, workers, CLI/startup/\nbackfill paths, current pointers/publication tables, and all frontend pages.\n",

      "lineEnd": 622,
      "byteStart": 33789,
      "byteEnd": 34524,
      "text": "Only the acceptance service/API writes the six authority tables, operational\nvalidation sentinel, and one acceptance event in one transaction. Gate\nadministration may toggle only the new gate through the existing protocol. Its\nrow records only latest-change attribution (`changed_at`, `changed_by`), not\nimmutable transition history. The named external audit owner is the **Paprnav\nproduction deployment/change-management system and its on-call operator**,\nwhich must retain the immutable enable/disable approval and rollout record. 4B\nclosure must link that record and must not call the DB row a complete audit log.\nNo CRUD, ORM cascade, seed, fixture\nloader, worker, CLI, repair, provider, GET, or legacy route may write these rows.\n",
      "textSha256": "123e3381f69677dcedd4793ac02f1c5c8a025562a106f652bb4a7427478fa874",

      "text": "The linked direct-SQL matrix is mandatory for every node family and edge kind.\nPositive SQL/Python parity covers every closed branch. Clean upgrade, disabled\ngates, auth races, lifecycle/object bijection, rollback, and prior 0029 suites\nmust pass.\n",

      "byteEnd": 36416,
      "text": "For `1998-17-11`, `2002-13-04`, `2008-26-10`, `2011-10-09`, and `2024-14-03`:\nuse real evidence/candidate/3A/3B materializers; request with one admin; accept\nwith another; compare every graph/hash/count to hand-approved goldens; roundtrip\ncandidate/projection bytes; verify GET; assert release blocked and V3/released\ndigests unchanged; then corrupt each authority family and fail closed.\n",

                "text": "- **S4B-I24:** All participants, including Slice-3A materialization that creates\n  reciprocal external rows, obey one global stable lock order covering the\n  complete transitive external-target projection set.                 "lineEnd": 220,
                "byteStart": 11245,
                "byteEnd": 12553,
                "text": "- **S4B-I25:** Every accepted decision owns one internal validation sentinel.\n  Statement-level transition-table triggers on every authority child increment\n  its bounded generation and reject writes once it is sealed. A deferred\n  constraint trigger performs at most one full aggregate validation over the\n  transaction's final graph and seals the sentinel; later callbacks are\n  constant-time, including after `SET CONSTRAINTS ... IMMEDIATE`. The validator\n  independently derives expected nodes, edges, external dependencies,\n  authorship, lifecycle, hashes, counts, and closed states from trusted typed\n  projection/review rows. Catalog tests prove trigger coverage for every table;\n  caller-supplied JSON or aggregate hashes never prove their own correctness.\n  The authority relations and three `SECURITY DEFINER` trigger functions are\n  owned by a non-login, non-superuser, non-BYPASSRLS role. Each function has a\n  fixed hardened search path and schema-qualified relation access. PUBLIC and\n  runtime EXECUTE are revoked; runtime has only the named authority INSERT and\n  read privileges needed for normal writes. Runtime has no ownership, DDL,\n  sentinel DML, role membership, or sequence escape. Catalog assertions and a\n  true runtime login prove the boundary before and after adversarial writes.\n",

                "lineEnd": 352,
                "byteStart": 19985,
                "byteEnd": 20453,
                "text": "Migration 0030 adds nullable `candidate_decision_id` and\n`acceptance_signoff_id` to `ad_v4_review_case_events`, expands event/state checks\nto one exact acceptance branch, and preserves the old rejection branch\nunchanged. Acceptance events use contract\n`paprnav-ad-v4-candidate-acceptance-1`; earlier event kinds retain\n`paprnav-ad-v4-candidate-review-1`. Deferred composite FKs bind event, decision,\nsignoff, case, request, proposal, and directive in both directions.\n",
                "textSha256": "8284af1f7417b19195f96a69384c78191bfa8d0ff821a279408ebcc6e66d4249",
                "normative": true,
                "owner": "foundational_persistence",

                "lineEnd": 358,
                "byteStart": 20454,
                "byteEnd": 20829,
                "text": "The migration does **not** change draft `intended_action`; it remains exactly\n`undecided|reject`. Candidate acceptance has no draft intent. A frozen `reject`\nintent blocks acceptance as `review_intent_conflict`; no draft or an undecided\ndraft is merely non-authoritative annotation. This preserves exact 0029 row\ncompatibility while 4B is disabled and on physical downgrade.\n",
