def literal_selection_graph(base, node, owner, links, original_golden_node, root):
    graph = copy.deepcopy(base)
    added = copy.deepcopy(node)
    for field in ("representationStatus", "baseGate", "reasonCode", "canonicalOrdinal"):
        added[field] = copy.deepcopy(original_golden_node[field])
    compact = [[row[field] for field in ("purpose", "canonicalOrdinal", "evidenceKey", "candidateBindingId", "linkHash")] for row in links]
    added.update(
        rootRole=root, effectiveGate=original_golden_node["baseGate"],
        evidence=compact, evidenceCount=len(compact),
        evidenceSetHash=sha256(literal_canonical_bytes(compact)),
    )
    graph["nodes"].append(added)
    graph["nodes"].sort(key=lambda row: (row["slice"], row["sourcePointer"], row["nodeType"], row["nodeKey"], row["id"]))
    graph["evidence"].extend(copy.deepcopy(links))
    graph["evidence"].sort(key=lambda row: (row["slice"], row["nodeId"], row["purpose"], row["canonicalOrdinal"], row["evidenceKey"]))
    return graph


def materialize_selection_case(family_index, operation, direction, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    """Mechanical expansion of one approved literal trap, before subject runs."""
    require(type(family_index) is int and 0 <= family_index < len(SELECTION_FAMILIES), "SELECTION_FAMILY_INDEX")
    require(operation in SELECTION_PATHS and direction in ("I", "E"), "SELECTION_TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN")
    require(operation not in ("M", "MC") or direction == "I", "SELECTION_OMIT_DIRECTION")
    rid, pointer, business_key, detach, root, link_count, lower_rules = SELECTION_FAMILIES[family_index]
    rule = mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"][family_index]
    exact_record(rule["id"], rid, "SELECTION_FAMILY_BINDING")
    fixture_id = "external-outgoing-resolved" if rid == "A15" else ("3a-main" if rid.startswith("A") else "slice3b-complete-candidate")
    base_fixture = fixtures[fixture_id]
    base_graph = goldens[fixture_id]
    original_node = matching_rows(base_fixture["context"]["semanticNodes"], {"slice": rule["slice"], "nodeType": rule["nodeType"], "sourcePointer": pointer})[0]
    original_owner = matching_rows(base_fixture["context"]["typedOwners"], {"table": rule["ownerTable"], "semantic_node_id": original_node["id"]})[0]
    original_golden = matching_rows(base_graph["nodes"], {"id": original_node["id"]})[0]
    original_links = matching_rows(base_fixture["context"]["evidenceLinks"], {"slice": original_node["slice"], "nodeId": original_node["id"]}, link_count)
    node, owner = copy.deepcopy(original_node), copy.deepcopy(original_owner)
    token = rid if operation == "T" else rid + "-" + operation + "-" + direction
    if rid == "A11" and operation == "T":
        token = "rule"
    node["nodeKey"] = "oracle-trap-" + token
    node["parentNodeId"] = None
    if business_key:
        owner[business_key] = node["nodeKey"]
    for field in detach.split(",") if detach else []:
        owner[field] = "oracle-detached-" + rid + "-" + field
    if operation == "T" and direction == "E":
        node["nodeType"] = "oracle_trap_" + ("rule" if rid == "A11" else rid)
    if rid == "A05":
        node["sourcePointer"] = "/applicabilityRules/0/ruleKey"
        owner["source_value"] = "rule-a"
        node["canonicalNodeHash"] = sha256(literal_canonical_bytes("rule-a"))
    mismatch = "oracle-mismatch-" + rid + "-" + operation + "-" + direction
    if operation == "Q1":
        mismatch = "slice_3b" if rule["slice"] == "slice_3a" else "slice_3a"
    if direction == "E":
        if operation == "Q1":
            node["slice"] = mismatch
        elif operation == "Q2":
            node["projectionId"] = mismatch
            owner["projection_id"] = mismatch
        elif operation == "Q3":
            node["proposalId"] = mismatch
        elif operation == "Q4":
            owner["table"] = mismatch
        elif operation == "Q5":
            owner["proposal_id"] = mismatch
        elif operation == "Q6":
            owner["projection_id"] = mismatch
    identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "nodeType": node["nodeType"], "nodeKey": node["nodeKey"], "pointer": node["sourcePointer"]}
    table = "semantic-node"
    prefix = "avn_" if node["slice"] == "slice_3a" else "aon_"
    if node["nodeType"] == "identity_mapping":
        identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "kind": owner["identity_kind"], "occurrence": owner["source_occurrence_node_id"]}
        table, prefix = "identity-mapping", "avi_"
    elif node["nodeType"] == "designation_value":
        identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "pointer": node["sourcePointer"], "value": "rule-a"}
        table = "designation-value"
    full_hash = literal_row_hash(node["slice"], table, identity)
    node["identityHash"] = full_hash
    node["id"] = prefix + full_hash[:32]
    owner["semantic_node_id"] = node["id"]
    if rid == "A04":
        owner["id"], owner["identity_hash"] = node["id"], full_hash
    sentinel = "oracle-unjoined-" + rid + "-" + operation + "-" + direction
    if operation in ("J1", "J2") and direction == "E":
        owner["semantic_node_id"] = sentinel
    links = []
    for original_link in [] if operation == "Q3" and direction == "E" else original_links:
        link = copy.deepcopy(original_link)
        for field in ("slice", "projectionId", "proposalId"):
            link[field] = node[field]
        link["nodeId"] = node["id"]
        if node["slice"] == "slice_3a":
            link_identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "nodeId": node["id"], "purpose": link["purpose"], "evidenceKey": link["evidenceKey"]}
            link_prefix = "avl_"
        else:
            link_identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "semanticNodeId": node["id"], "purpose": link["purpose"], "evidenceKey": link["evidenceKey"], "ordinal": link["canonicalOrdinal"]}
            link_prefix = "aoe_"
        link["linkHash"] = literal_row_hash(node["slice"], "evidence-link", link_identity)
        link["id"] = link_prefix + link["linkHash"][:32]
        links.append(link)
    require(all(row["id"] != node["id"] for row in base_graph["nodes"]), "SELECTION_ID_NOT_FRESH")
    fixture = copy.deepcopy(base_fixture)
    auxiliary = {"semanticNodes": [node], "typedOwners": [owner], "relations": []}
    fixture["context"].setdefault("unboundProjectionContexts", []).append(auxiliary)
    fixture["context"]["evidenceLinks"].extend(links)
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    plus = literal_selection_graph(base_graph, node, owner, links, original_golden, root)
    case_id = "selection." + rid + "." + operation + "." + direction
    selected = {"node": node, "owner": owner}
    conditions = []

    def condition(atom, code, detail):
        conditions.append({"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code, "detail": copy.deepcopy(detail)})

    cardinality = {"selected": len(base_graph["nodes"]) + 1, "expected": len(base_fixture["context"]["semanticNodes"]), "owners": len(base_fixture["context"]["typedOwners"])}
    condition("selection.members.extra", "SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", {**cardinality, "extra": [node["id"]]})
    condition("selection.owner_count", "SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", cardinality)
    for edge_id in lower_rules.split(",") if lower_rules else []:
        edge_rule = matching_rows(mapping["typedAst"]["edges"], {"id": edge_id})[0]
        condition("edge.cardinality.lower", "CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:" + edge_id, {"parent": node["id"], "actual": 0, "bounds": edge_rule["cardinality"]})
    if rid == "A04" and not (operation == "T" and direction == "E"):
        condition("identity.remaining", "IDENTITY_UNCONSUMED", [node["id"]])
    if rid == "A15" and not (operation == "T" and direction == "E"):
        actual_ids = sorted(row["sourceNodeId"] for row in base_graph["externalDependencies"])
        condition("external.members.missing", "EXTERNAL_SET_MISMATCH", {"actual": actual_ids, "expected": sorted(actual_ids + [node["id"]]), "member": node["id"], "occurrence": 1})
    if direction == "E":
        if operation == "T":
            condition("selection.node.type", "SELECTION_NODE_TYPE_MISMATCH", selected)
        elif operation == "Q1":
            condition("selection.node.projection", "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", node)
            condition("selection.node.slice", "SELECTION_NODE_TYPE_MISMATCH", selected)
        elif operation == "Q2":
            condition("selection.node.projection", "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", node)
        elif operation == "Q3":
            condition("selection.node.proposal", "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", node)
            condition("selection.owner.proposal", "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", owner)
            for original_link in original_links:
                condition("evidence.binding.count", "EVIDENCE_BINDING_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", {"nodeId": node["id"], "key": original_link["evidenceKey"], "count": 0, "proposalId": node["proposalId"]})
        elif operation == "Q4":
            condition("selection.owner.table", "SELECTION_TYPED_OWNER_MISMATCH", selected)
        elif operation == "Q5":
            condition("selection.owner.proposal", "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", owner)
        elif operation == "Q6":
            condition("selection.owner.projection", "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", owner)
        elif operation in ("J1", "J2"):
            condition("selection.owner.self_id", "SELECTION_TYPED_OWNER_MISMATCH", selected)
    query_path = "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(family_index)
    path = query_path + SELECTION_PATHS[operation]
    if operation in ("M", "MC"):
        hook_operation = "selected_row" if operation == "M" else "consumer_row"
        environment = {"n": node, "o": owner} if operation == "M" else selected
        before, after = selected, None
    elif operation == "J2":
        hook_operation, environment = "join_index", {"o": owner}
        before = owner["semantic_node_id"]
        after = sentinel if direction == "I" else node["id"]
    else:
        hook_operation = "value"
        expression = locate(mapping, path)
        alias, field = expression["alias"], expression["name"]
        row = node if alias == "n" else owner
        environment = {alias: row}
        if operation == "Q6":
            environment = {"n": node, "o": owner}
        before = row[field]
        if operation == "T":
            after = "oracle_fault_absent_node_type" if direction == "I" else rule["nodeType"]
        elif operation == "J1":
            after = sentinel
        else:
            original_row = original_node if alias == "n" else original_owner
            after = mismatch if direction == "I" else original_row[field]
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": hook_operation, "path": path, "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": copy.deepcopy(environment), "before": copy.deepcopy(before), "after": copy.deepcopy(after)}
    original = plus if direction == "I" else base_graph
    changed = base_graph if direction == "I" else plus
    return {
        "id": case_id, "family": rid, "operation": operation, "direction": direction,
        "fixtureId": fixture_id, "inputSha256": input_hash,
        "extraContext": auxiliary, "extraLinks": links,
        "originalSourceNode": original_node, "originalSourceOwner": original_owner,
        "identityPreimage": {"slice": node["slice"], "table": table, "identity": identity},
        "addedGoldenNode": matching_rows(plus["nodes"], {"id": node["id"]})[0],
        "fault": fault, "conditions": conditions,
        "intactExpectedSha256": sha256(json_bytes(original)),
        "faultExpectedSha256": sha256(json_bytes(changed)),
        "delta": literal_difference(changed, original),
        "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "restorationExpected": [{"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": item["atom"], "code": item["code"], "detail": item["detail"]} for item in conditions],
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "familyIndex": family_index, "sourcePointer": pointer, "mappingPath": path},
    }


def expand_selection_input(case, fixtures):
    fixture = copy.deepcopy(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]])
    fixture["context"].setdefault("unboundProjectionContexts", []).append(copy.deepcopy(case["extraContext"]))
    fixture["context"]["evidenceLinks"].extend(copy.deepcopy(case["extraLinks"]))
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(fixture)), case["inputSha256"], "SELECTION_INPUT_BINDING")
    return fixture


def expand_selection_expected(case, goldens, faulted):
    graph = copy.deepcopy(goldens[case["fixtureId"]])
    add_trap = (case["direction"] == "I") != faulted
    if add_trap:
        graph["nodes"].append(copy.deepcopy(case["addedGoldenNode"]))
        graph["nodes"].sort(key=lambda row: (row["slice"], row["sourcePointer"], row["nodeType"], row["nodeKey"], row["id"]))
        graph["evidence"].extend(copy.deepcopy(case["extraLinks"]))
        graph["evidence"].sort(key=lambda row: (row["slice"], row["nodeId"], row["purpose"], row["canonicalOrdinal"], row["evidenceKey"]))
    expected_hash = case["faultExpectedSha256"] if faulted else case["intactExpectedSha256"]
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(graph)), expected_hash, "SELECTION_EXPECTED_BINDING")
    return graph


SELECTION_CASE_FIELDS = frozenset({
    "id", "family", "operation", "direction", "fixtureId", "inputSha256",
    "extraContext", "extraLinks", "originalSourceNode", "originalSourceOwner",
    "identityPreimage", "addedGoldenNode", "fault", "conditions",
    "intactExpectedSha256", "faultExpectedSha256", "deltaSha256", "deltaCount",
    "deltaRecipe", "expectedHits", "restorationExpected", "authority",
})


def admit_selection_record(candidate, frozen):
    closed_object(candidate, SELECTION_CASE_FIELDS, "selection case")
    # The independently frozen whole record is the authority. Hashes never
    # replace this exact typed comparison and a caller cannot enlarge masks.
    exact_record(candidate, frozen, "SELECTION_FROZEN_RECORD_MISMATCH")
    closed_object(candidate["fault"], {"id", "operation", "path", "inputSha256", "environment", "before", "after"}, "selection fault")
    require(candidate["fault"]["id"] == candidate["id"], "SELECTION_FAULT_ID")
    require(candidate["fault"]["inputSha256"] == candidate["inputSha256"], "SELECTION_FAULT_INPUT")
    exact_record(candidate["expectedHits"], [0, 1, 0], "SELECTION_HIT_CONTRACT")
    require(type(candidate["conditions"]) is list, "SELECTION_CONDITIONS_TYPE")
    seen = []
    for item in candidate["conditions"]:
        closed_object(item, {"atom", "inputSha256", "code", "detail"}, "selection condition")
        require(item["atom"] in kernel.ATOMIC_CHECKS, "SELECTION_CONDITION_ATOM")
        require(item["inputSha256"] == candidate["inputSha256"], "SELECTION_CONDITION_INPUT")
        require(not any(typed_equal(item, other) for other in seen), "SELECTION_CONDITION_DUPLICATE")
        seen.append(item)
    require(type(candidate["deltaCount"]) is int and candidate["deltaCount"] > 0, "SELECTION_NONEMPTY_EFFECT")
    return True


def capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, fault, conditions):
    subject = kernel.SemanticKernel(fixture, mapping, source_schema, hook_plan={"fault": fault, "conditions": conditions})
    try:
        graph, coverage = subject.construct()
    except kernel.DefensiveBoundary as boundary:
        outcome = {"kind": "boundary", "record": boundary.record}
    except kernel.SemanticError as error:
        outcome = {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": error.check_id, "code": error.code, "detail": error.detail}
    else:
        outcome = {"kind": "graph", "graph": graph}
    return {"outcome": outcome, "edits": subject.hooks.edits, "conditionHits": subject.hooks.condition_hits, "choiceTraces": subject.hooks.choice_traces}


def admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation, case, expected_hits):
    require(type(observation) is list, "EDIT_TRANSCRIPT_LIST")
    require(type(expected_hits) is int and expected_hits in (0, 1), "EDIT_TRANSCRIPT_EXPECTED_COUNT")
    require(len(observation) == expected_hits, "EDIT_TRANSCRIPT_COUNT", {"expected": expected_hits, "actual": len(observation)})
    if expected_hits:
        expected = {key: case["fault"][key] for key in ("id", "operation", "path", "environment", "before", "after", "inputSha256")}
        exact_record(observation[0], expected, "EDIT_TRANSCRIPT_EXACT_RECORD")


def admit_condition_hit_multiset(observed, expected):
    require(type(observed) is list and type(expected) is list, "CONDITION_HIT_LIST")
    exact_record(sorted(observed, key=json_bytes), sorted(expected, key=json_bytes), "CONDITION_HIT_EXACT_MULTISET")


def run_selection_triple(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    fixture = expand_selection_input(case, fixtures)
    expected_graphs = [expand_selection_expected(case, goldens, faulted) for faulted in (False, True, False)]
    expected_delta = literal_difference(expected_graphs[1], expected_graphs[0])
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(expected_delta)), case["deltaSha256"], "SELECTION_DELTA_BINDING")
    exact_record(len(expected_delta), case["deltaCount"], "SELECTION_DELTA_COUNT")
    runs = []
    for index in range(3):
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, case["conditions"])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected_graphs[index]})
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, case["expectedHits"][index])
        runs.append({
            "outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])),
            "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"],
        })
    restorations = []
    for index, condition in enumerate(case["conditions"]):
        observation = capture_construction(
            fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if case["direction"] == "E" else None,
            [item for other_index, item in enumerate(case["conditions"]) if other_index != index],
        )
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], case["restorationExpected"][index])
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if case["direction"] == "E" else 0)
        restorations.append({
            "condition": condition, "outcome": observation["outcome"],
            "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"],
        })
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": runs, "restorations": restorations, "deltaSha256": case["deltaSha256"]}


def run_selection_grid(operators, columns, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens, baseline_cache):
    """Visit and classify each cell; inactive subjects may reuse a byte-bound run.

    The zero-applicability test executes the actual controller input fence.
    Cache identity excludes only a proven inapplicable hook, not conditions,
    source, runtime, input, or active edits. No grid cell is inferred by count.
    """
    rows = []
    for operator in operators:
        encoded = ""
        effects = []
        fresh = reused = 0
        for column in columns:
            fixture = expand_selection_input(column, fixtures) if column.get("operation") else fixtures[column["fixtureId"]]
            conditions = column["conditions"] if column.get("operation") else []
            input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
            controller = kernel.OracleHooks(fixture, {"fault": operator["fault"], "conditions": conditions})
            bound = operator["fault"]["inputSha256"] == input_hash
            if not bound:
                # Directly apply the purported target under its otherwise exact
                # path/environment/preimage. The actual full input fence must
                # still return the original operand and record zero edits.
                old = operator["fault"]["before"]
                result = controller.apply(operator["fault"]["operation"], operator["fault"]["path"], operator["fault"]["environment"], old)
                exact_record(result, old, "GRID_ZERO_APPLICABILITY_VALUE")
                exact_record(controller.edits, [], "GRID_ZERO_APPLICABILITY_HITS")
                cache_key = column["id"]
                require(cache_key in baseline_cache, "GRID_CACHE_ENTRY_MISSING", cache_key)
                observation = baseline_cache[cache_key]
                reused += 1
                code = "0"
            else:
                observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, operator["fault"], conditions)
                fresh += 1
                code = "1"
            # Expected sets are predeclared exact input-row bindings, not
            # reconstructed from the observations or fault ownership.
            expected_effect = column["id"] in operator["expectedEffects"]
            require(bound == expected_effect, "GRID_DECLARED_APPLICABILITY", {"operator": operator["id"], "column": column["id"]})
            if column.get("operation"):
                expected_graph = expand_selection_expected(column, goldens, expected_effect)
            else:
                expected_graph = goldens[column["fixtureId"]]
            admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected_graph})
            if bound:
                admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], operator, 1)
                effects.append(column["id"])
            encoded += code
        exact_record(effects, operator["expectedEffects"], "GRID_EFFECT_SET")
        rows.append({
            "operatorId": operator["id"], "visitedCells": len(encoded), "cells": encoded,
            "freshExecutions": fresh, "provenInactiveCacheReuses": reused,
            "observedEffects": effects, "observedSurvivors": [],
        })
    return rows


REFERENCE_ATOMS = {
    "sourceNodeId": "reference.source.present", "targetNodeId": "reference.target.present",
    "sourceSlice": "reference.source.slice", "sourceProjectionId": "reference.source.projection",
    "targetSlice": "reference.target.slice", "targetProjectionId": "reference.target.projection",
    "targetNodeType": "reference.target.type", "targetNodeKey": "reference.target.key",
}
EDGE_ATOMS = {
    "parentNodeId": "edge.parent.present", "childNodeId": "edge.child.present",
    "parentSlice": "edge.parent.slice", "childSlice": "edge.child.slice",
}


def literal_reference_envelope(row):
    rename = {"kind": "referenceKind", "requirementState": "requiredState", "targetNodeKey": "targetKey"}
    labels = {"action_document": "approved_data_document", "requirement_prerequisite": "prerequisite", "termination_target": "termination"}
    result = {rename.get(key, key): copy.deepcopy(value) for key, value in row.items() if key != "sourceProjectionId"}
    result["referenceKind"] = labels.get(result["referenceKind"], result["referenceKind"])
    return result


def literal_replace_row(graph, collection, old, new):
    result = copy.deepcopy(graph)
    positions = [index for index, row in enumerate(result[collection]) if typed_equal(row, old)]
    require(len(positions) == 1, "LITERAL_ROW_PREIMAGE_COUNT", {"collection": collection, "count": len(positions)})
    result[collection][positions[0]] = copy.deepcopy(new)
    if collection == "references":
        result[collection].sort(key=literal_canonical_bytes)
    elif collection == "edges":
        result[collection].sort(key=lambda edge: (edge["parentSlice"], edge["parentNodeId"], edge["edgeKind"], edge["canonicalOrdinal"], edge["childSlice"], edge["childNodeId"]))
        for identity in result["identityMappings"]:
            if all(typed_equal(identity["consumer"][key], old[key]) for key in identity["consumer"]):
                identity["consumer"] = {key: copy.deepcopy(new[key]) for key in identity["consumer"]}
    else:
        raise AdmissionError("LITERAL_ROW_COLLECTION", collection)
    return result


def materialize_coordinate_guard(seed, field, fixtures, mapping, goldens, domain):
    fixture_id = seed["fixtureId"]
    fixture, golden = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id]
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    if domain == "reference":
        query_index = seed["queryIndex"]
        raw = copy.deepcopy(seed["rawLiteralRow"])
        old = literal_reference_envelope(raw)
        matching_rows(golden["references"], old)
        bad_raw = copy.deepcopy(raw)
        bad_raw[field] = "oracle-bad-" + field
        bad_row = literal_reference_envelope(bad_raw)
        expected_graph = literal_replace_row(golden, "references", old, bad_row)
        path = "/typedAst/references/" + str(query_index) + "/select"
        query_id = "reference:" + str(query_index)
        atom = REFERENCE_ATOMS[field]
        diagnostic = "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH"
        bad_detail = bad_raw
        horizon = "S"
        expected = {"kind": "graph", "graphRecipe": {"collection": "references", "before": old, "after": bad_row}, "graphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected_graph))}
    else:
        rule_id = seed["ruleId"]
        rule_index = next(index for index, rule in enumerate(mapping["typedAst"]["edges"]) if rule["id"] == rule_id)
        rule = mapping["typedAst"]["edges"][rule_index]
        old = copy.deepcopy(seed["sourceRow"])
        matching_rows(golden["edges"], old)
        query_index = seed.get("queryIndex", 1 if rule_id in ("E11", "E16") else 0)
        query = rule["queries"][query_index]
        raw = {key: copy.deepcopy(old[key]) for key in query["select"]}
        bad_raw = copy.deepcopy(raw)
        bad_raw[field] = "oracle-missing-" + field if field.endswith("NodeId") else "oracle_bad_slice"
        bad_detail = {**old, field: bad_raw[field]}
        path = "/typedAst/edges/" + str(rule_index) + "/queries/" + str(query_index) + "/select"
        query_id = rule_id + ":" + str(query_index)
        atom = EDGE_ATOMS[field]
        diagnostic = "REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:" + rule_id
        horizon = "D" if field.endswith("NodeId") and rule["propagates"] else "S"
        if horizon == "S":
            expected_graph = literal_replace_row(golden, "edges", old, bad_detail)
            expected = {"kind": "graph", "graphRecipe": {"collection": "edges", "before": old, "after": bad_detail}, "graphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected_graph))}
        else:
            opposite = "childNodeId" if field == "parentNodeId" else "parentNodeId"
            present = copy.deepcopy(matching_rows(golden["nodes"], {"id": old[opposite]})[0])
            present = {key: value for key, value in present.items() if key not in ("effectiveGate", "rootRole")}
            truth = {
                "edge.parent.present": field != "parentNodeId",
                "edge.child.present": field != "childNodeId",
                "edge.parent.slice": "not_evaluated/domain_unavailable" if field == "parentNodeId" else True,
                "edge.child.slice": "not_evaluated/domain_unavailable" if field == "childNodeId" else True,
                "edge.child.rule": "not_evaluated/domain_unavailable" if field == "childNodeId" else True,
            }
            expected = {"kind": "boundary", "record": {
                "phase": "edge.target", "ruleId": rule_id, "edge": bad_detail,
                "missingLookup": field, "presentEndpoint": present,
                "actualAtomTrace": [{"atom": name, "truth": value, "detail": bad_detail} for name, value in truth.items()],
                "nextForbiddenOperation": "propagate",
            }}
    case_id = domain + "." + query_id + "." + field
    corruption = {"id": case_id + ".corruption", "operation": "query_row", "path": path, "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"queryId": query_id}, "before": raw, "after": bad_raw}
    neutralization = {"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": diagnostic, "detail": bad_detail}
    output = {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": horizon, "fixtureId": fixture_id,
        "inputSha256": input_hash, "corruption": corruption, "neutralization": neutralization,
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": atom, "code": diagnostic, "detail": bad_detail},
        "faultExpected": expected, "baselineExpectedSha256": sha256(json_bytes(golden)),
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "mappingPath": path, "seed": seed},
        "expectedCorruptionHits": 1, "expectedNeutralizationHits": 1,
    }
    if horizon == "S":
        delta = literal_difference(expected_graph, golden)
        output["deltaSha256"] = sha256(json_bytes(delta))
        output["deltaCount"] = len(delta)
    return output


def expand_coordinate_guard_expected(case, goldens):
    expected = case["faultExpected"]
    if expected["kind"] == "boundary":
        return copy.deepcopy(expected)
    recipe = expected["graphRecipe"]
    graph = literal_replace_row(goldens[case["fixtureId"]], recipe["collection"], recipe["before"], recipe["after"])
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(graph)), expected["graphSha256"], "GUARD_EXPECTED_GRAPH_BINDING")
    return {"kind": "graph", "graph": graph}


def run_coordinate_guard(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    fixture = fixtures[case["fixtureId"]]
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(fixture)), case["inputSha256"], "GUARD_INPUT_BINDING")
    observations = []
    for mode in ("intact", "neutralized", "restored", "operand_substituted"):
        fault = None if mode == "operand_substituted" else case["corruption"]
        conditions = [case["neutralization"]] if mode == "neutralized" else []
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, fault, conditions)
        if mode == "neutralized":
            expected = expand_coordinate_guard_expected(case, goldens)
        elif mode == "operand_substituted":
            expected = {"kind": "graph", "graph": goldens[case["fixtureId"]]}
        else:
            expected = case["intactExpected"]
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], expected)
        expected_edits = [] if mode == "operand_substituted" else [case["corruption"]]
        exact_record(observation["edits"], expected_edits, "GUARD_CORRUPTION_EDIT_TRANSCRIPT")
        exact_record(observation["conditionHits"], conditions, "GUARD_NEUTRALIZATION_HITS")
        observations.append({"mode": mode, "outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"]})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def literal_readiness(graph):
    """Independent two-rank descendant-closure formula for acyclic literals."""
    output = copy.deepcopy(graph)
    ranks = {"candidate_only": 0, "human_determination_required": 1}
    bases = {node["id"]: node["baseGate"] for node in output["nodes"]}
    children = {node_id: [] for node_id in bases}
    for edge in output["edges"]:
        if edge["propagatesGate"]:
            children[edge["parentNodeId"]].append(edge["childNodeId"])
    for node in output["nodes"]:
        seen, work = set(), [node["id"]]
        while work:
            current = work.pop()
            if current not in seen:
                seen.add(current)
                work.extend(children[current])
        node["effectiveGate"] = max([bases[node_id] for node_id in seen], key=lambda gate: ranks[gate])
    controlling = [node["effectiveGate"] for node in output["nodes"] if node["rootRole"] == "controlling_root"]
    output["aggregateReadiness"] = max(controlling, key=lambda gate: ranks[gate]) if controlling else "candidate_only"
    return output


def materialize_case_field(seed, field, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture_id, node_id = seed["fixtureId"], seed["sourceNodeId"]
    fixture, graph = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id]
    rule_index = next(index for index, rule in enumerate(mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]) if rule["id"] == seed["ruleId"])
    case_index = seed["index"]
    case = mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"][rule_index]["cases"][case_index]
    output_field = {"representation": "representationStatus", "baseGate": "baseGate", "reason": "reasonCode"}[field]
    old = case[field]
    if field == "representation":
        new = "explicit_unknown" if old == "exact" else "exact"
    elif field == "baseGate":
        new = "human_determination_required" if old == "candidate_only" else "candidate_only"
    else:
        new = "oracle_case_reason"
    expected = copy.deepcopy(graph)
    node = matching_rows(expected["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0]
    exact_record(node[output_field], old, "CASE_LITERAL_FIELD_BINDING")
    node[output_field] = new
    if field == "baseGate":
        expected = literal_readiness(expected)
    case_id = "case.field." + seed["ruleId"] + "." + str(case_index) + "." + field
    fault = {
        "id": case_id, "operation": "case_field",
        "path": "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/cases/" + str(case_index) + "/" + field,
        "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(fixture)),
        "environment": {"ruleId": seed["ruleId"], "caseIndex": case_index, "nodeId": node_id},
        "before": old, "after": new,
    }
    delta = literal_difference(expected, graph)
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": fixture_id,
        "nodeId": node_id, "field": output_field, "before": old, "after": new,
        "fault": fault, "conditions": [], "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected)),
        "expectedDeltaSha256": sha256(json_bytes(delta)), "expectedDeltaCount": len(delta),
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "mappingPath": fault["path"], "seed": seed},
    }


def expand_case_field_expected(case, goldens):
    graph = copy.deepcopy(goldens[case["fixtureId"]])
    node = matching_rows(graph["nodes"], {"id": case["nodeId"]})[0]
    exact_record(node[case["field"]], case["before"], "CASE_FIELD_PREIMAGE")
    node[case["field"]] = copy.deepcopy(case["after"])
    if case["field"] == "baseGate":
        graph = literal_readiness(graph)
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(graph)), case["expectedGraphSha256"], "CASE_FIELD_EXPECTED_BINDING")
    return graph


def materialize_case_absence(seed, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture = fixtures[seed["fixtureId"]]
    node = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["semanticNodes"], {"id": seed["sourceNodeId"]})[0]
    owner = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["typedOwners"], {"semantic_node_id": seed["sourceNodeId"]})[0]
    case_id = "case.absence." + seed["ruleId"] + "." + str(seed["index"])
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    fault = {"id": case_id + ".corruption", "operation": "predicate", "path": seed["path"], "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"n": node, "o": owner}, "before": True, "after": False}
    detail = {"nodeId": node["id"], "matches": 0}
    code = "UNION_SELECTION_NONE:" + seed["ruleId"]
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "D", "fixtureId": seed["fixtureId"],
        "inputSha256": input_hash, "corruption": fault,
        "neutralization": {"atom": "case.nonempty", "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code, "detail": detail},
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": "case.nonempty", "code": code, "detail": detail},
        "faultExpected": {"kind": "boundary", "record": {"phase": "node.case.choice", "ruleId": seed["ruleId"], "nodeId": node["id"], "matchingIndices": [], "nextForbiddenOperation": "cases[0]"}},
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "seed": seed}, "expectedCorruptionHits": 1, "expectedNeutralizationHits": 1,
    }


def run_case_field(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    expected = expand_case_field_expected(case, goldens)
    fixture = fixtures[case["fixtureId"]]
    records = []
    for index in range(3):
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, [])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected if index == 1 else goldens[case["fixtureId"]]})
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if index == 1 else 0)
        records.append({"outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"]})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": records}


def literal_generated_evidence(node, keys, purpose, bindings):
    links = []
    for ordinal, key in enumerate(keys):
        binding = matching_rows(bindings, {"proposal_id": node["proposalId"], "evidence_key": key})[0]
        if node["slice"] == "slice_3a":
            identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "nodeId": node["id"], "purpose": purpose, "evidenceKey": key}
            prefix = "avl_"
        else:
            identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "semanticNodeId": node["id"], "purpose": purpose, "evidenceKey": key, "ordinal": ordinal}
            prefix = "aoe_"
        full_hash = literal_row_hash(node["slice"], "evidence-link", identity)
        links.append({
            "slice": node["slice"], "projectionId": node["projectionId"], "proposalId": node["proposalId"],
            "id": prefix + full_hash[:32], "nodeId": node["id"], "purpose": purpose,
            "canonicalOrdinal": ordinal, "evidenceKey": key, "candidateBindingId": binding["id"], "linkHash": full_hash,
        })
    return links


def literal_evidence_graph(base, node_id, links):
    graph = copy.deepcopy(base)
    graph["evidence"] = [row for row in graph["evidence"] if row["nodeId"] != node_id] + copy.deepcopy(links)
    graph["evidence"].sort(key=lambda row: (row["slice"], row["nodeId"], row["purpose"], row["canonicalOrdinal"], row["evidenceKey"]))
    node = matching_rows(graph["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0]
    compact = [[row[field] for field in ("purpose", "canonicalOrdinal", "evidenceKey", "candidateBindingId", "linkHash")] for row in links]
    node["evidence"], node["evidenceCount"], node["evidenceSetHash"] = compact, len(compact), sha256(literal_canonical_bytes(compact))
    return graph


def declared_evidence_conditions(input_hash, node_id, source, keys, purpose, generated, retained):
    conditions = []

    def add(atom, code, detail):
        conditions.append({"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code + ":" + node_id, "detail": copy.deepcopy(detail)})

    if source != "none" and not keys:
        add("evidence.keys.required", "EVIDENCE_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH", {"expected": "one_or_more", "actual": 0})
    for row in retained:
        if not typed_equal(row["purpose"], purpose):
            add("evidence.purpose", "EVIDENCE_PURPOSE_MISMATCH", row)
    if len(generated) != len(retained):
        add("evidence.link.count", "EVIDENCE_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH", {"generated": len(generated), "retained": len(retained)})
    for atom, rows, other in (("evidence.members.missing", generated, retained), ("evidence.members.extra", retained, generated)):
        for index, member in enumerate(rows):
            occurrence = sum(typed_equal(member, item) for item in rows[:index + 1])
            available = sum(typed_equal(member, item) for item in other)
            if occurrence > available:
                add(atom, "EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH", {"nodeId": node_id, "member": member, "occurrence": occurrence, "generated": generated, "retained": retained})
    return conditions


def materialize_policy_formula(seed, operation, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture, graph = fixtures[seed["fixtureId"]], goldens[seed["fixtureId"]]
    node = matching_rows(graph["nodes"], {"id": seed["sourceNodeId"]})[0]
    index = next(i for i, rule in enumerate(mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]) if rule["id"] == seed["ruleId"])
    policy_index = seed["index"]
    policy = mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"][index]["evidence"][policy_index]
    retained = [row for row in fixture["context"]["evidenceLinks"] if row["slice"] == node["slice"] and row["nodeId"] == node["id"]]
    original_links = sorted([row for row in graph["evidence"] if row["nodeId"] == node["id"]], key=lambda row: row["canonicalOrdinal"])
    original_keys = [row["evidenceKey"] for row in original_links]
    if operation == "keys":
        new_keys = [] if policy["source"] != "none" else ["ev-a" if seed["fixtureId"].startswith("slice3b-") else "ev-context"]
        new_purpose = policy["purpose"]
        before, after = original_keys, new_keys
        operation_name, field = "policy_keys", "source"
    else:
        require(policy["source"] != "none" and bool(original_keys), "POLICY_PURPOSE_NONEMPTY_WITNESS")
        new_keys, new_purpose = original_keys, "oracle_evidence_purpose"
        before, after = policy["purpose"], new_purpose
        operation_name, field = "policy_purpose", "purpose"
    generated = literal_generated_evidence(node, new_keys, new_purpose, fixture["context"]["evidenceBindings"])
    expected = literal_evidence_graph(graph, node["id"], generated)
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    case_id = "policy.formula." + seed["ruleId"] + "." + str(policy_index) + "." + operation
    fault = {
        "id": case_id, "operation": operation_name, "path": "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(index) + "/evidence/" + str(policy_index) + "/" + field,
        "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"ruleId": seed["ruleId"], "policyIndex": policy_index, "nodeId": node["id"]},
        "before": before, "after": after,
    }
    conditions = declared_evidence_conditions(input_hash, node["id"], policy["source"], new_keys, new_purpose, generated, retained)
    delta = literal_difference(expected, graph)
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": seed["fixtureId"], "nodeId": node["id"],
        "fault": fault, "conditions": conditions, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "expectedLinks": generated, "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected)),
        "expectedDeltaSha256": sha256(json_bytes(delta)), "expectedDeltaCount": len(delta),
        "restorationExpected": [{"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": item["atom"], "code": item["code"], "detail": item["detail"]} for item in conditions],
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "seed": seed, "mappingPath": fault["path"]},
    }


def materialize_evidence_binding(seed, operation, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture, golden = fixtures[seed["fixtureId"]], goldens[seed["fixtureId"]]
    node_id = seed["sourceNodeId"]
    node = matching_rows(golden["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0]
    pre_node = literal_pre_evidence_node(node)
    rule_index = next(index for index, rule in enumerate(mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]) if rule["id"] == seed["ruleId"])
    policy_index = seed["index"]
    policy = mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"][rule_index]["evidence"][policy_index]
    path = "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/evidence/" + str(policy_index)
    original = sorted([row for row in golden["evidence"] if row["nodeId"] == node_id], key=lambda row: row["canonicalOrdinal"])
    require(bool(original) and policy["source"] != "none", "EVIDENCE_BINDING_NONEMPTY_WITNESS")
    key = original[0]["evidenceKey"]
    binding = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["evidenceBindings"], {"proposal_id": node["proposalId"], "evidence_key": key})[0]
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    case_id = "evidence.binding." + seed["ruleId"] + "." + str(policy_index) + "." + operation
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "evidence_bindings", "path": path + "/bindings", "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"nodeId": node_id, "key": key}, "before": [binding], "after": None}
    generated, target, conditions = copy.deepcopy(original), None, []
    count_detail = {"nodeId": node_id, "key": key, "count": 0, "proposalId": node["proposalId"]}
    count_atom = {"atom": "evidence.binding.count", "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "EVIDENCE_BINDING_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", "detail": count_detail}
    if operation in ("proposal", "key", "count_zero"):
        generated = [row for row in generated if row["evidenceKey"] != key]
        if operation == "count_zero":
            fault["after"], target = [], count_atom
        else:
            fault.update(operation="predicate", path=path + "/binding/" + operation, environment={"node": pre_node, "key": key, "binding": binding}, before=True, after=False)
            conditions.append(count_atom)
    elif operation in ("count_many_same", "count_many_distinct_second", "count_many_new_first"):
        changed = {**binding, "id": "oracle_binding_" + case_id}
        fault["after"] = [binding, binding] if operation == "count_many_same" else [binding, changed] if operation == "count_many_distinct_second" else [changed, binding]
        count_detail["count"] = 2
        target = count_atom
        if operation == "count_many_new_first":
            generated[0]["candidateBindingId"] = changed["id"]
    else:
        require(operation in ("fragment_id", "fragment_hash", "binding_id"), "EVIDENCE_BINDING_OPERATION")
        field = "id" if operation == "binding_id" else operation
        changed = {**binding, field: "oracle_binding_" + case_id}
        fault.update(operation="evidence_binding", path=path + "/binding/selected", before=binding, after=changed)
        if operation == "binding_id":
            generated[0]["candidateBindingId"] = changed["id"]
        else:
            target = {"atom": "evidence.fragment." + ("id" if field == "fragment_id" else "hash"), "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "EVIDENCE_FRAGMENT_BINDING_MISMATCH", "detail": changed}
    retained = [row for row in fixture["context"]["evidenceLinks"] if row["slice"] == node["slice"] and row["nodeId"] == node_id]
    conditions.extend(declared_evidence_conditions(input_hash, node_id, policy["source"], [row["evidenceKey"] for row in original], policy["purpose"], generated, retained))
    expected = literal_evidence_graph(golden, node_id, generated)
    return {"id": case_id, "fixtureId": seed["fixtureId"], "contract": "G" if target else "F", "tier": "S", "fault": fault, "conditions": conditions, "target": target, "expectedGraph": expected, "expectedDelta": literal_difference(expected, golden), "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "seed": seed, "mappingPath": path, "literalBinding": binding, "literalGeneratedLinks": original, "originalOrdinalsPreserved": True}}


def materialize_evidence_link(seed, operation, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture, golden = fixtures[seed["fixtureId"]], goldens[seed["fixtureId"]]
    node_id = seed["sourceNodeId"]
    node = matching_rows(golden["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0]
    rule_index = next(index for index, rule in enumerate(mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]) if rule["id"] == seed["ruleId"])
    policy_index = seed["index"]
    policy = mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"][rule_index]["evidence"][policy_index]
    path = "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/evidence/" + str(policy_index)
    original = sorted([row for row in golden["evidence"] if row["nodeId"] == node_id], key=lambda row: row["canonicalOrdinal"])
    require(bool(original), "EVIDENCE_LINK_NONEMPTY_WITNESS")
    retained = [row for row in fixture["context"]["evidenceLinks"] if row["slice"] == node["slice"] and row["nodeId"] == node_id]
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    case_id = "evidence.link." + seed["ruleId"] + "." + str(policy_index) + "." + operation
    generated, edited_retained = copy.deepcopy(original), copy.deepcopy(retained)
    target = None
    if operation.startswith("generated."):
        field = operation.removeprefix("generated.")
        require(field in original[0], "EVIDENCE_LINK_FIELD")
        old = original[0][field]
        new = 1 + max(row["canonicalOrdinal"] for row in golden["evidence"]) if field == "canonicalOrdinal" else "oracle_link_" + field
        generated[0][field] = new
        fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "evidence_generated_field", "path": path + "/generated/" + field, "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"nodeId": node_id, "key": original[0]["evidenceKey"], "ordinal": original[0]["canonicalOrdinal"]}, "before": old, "after": new}
    else:
        require(operation in ("owner_projection", "owner_proposal", "purpose", "count_missing", "count_extra", "members_missing", "members_extra"), "EVIDENCE_RETAINED_OPERATION")
        if operation == "count_missing":
            edited_retained = edited_retained[1:]
        elif operation == "count_extra":
            edited_retained.append(copy.deepcopy(retained[0]))
        else:
            field = {"owner_projection": "projectionId", "owner_proposal": "proposalId", "purpose": "purpose"}.get(operation, "id")
            edited_retained[0][field] = "oracle_retained_" + field
        fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "evidence_retained", "path": path + "/retained", "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"nodeId": node_id}, "before": retained, "after": edited_retained}
        if operation in ("owner_projection", "owner_proposal", "purpose"):
            atom = {"owner_projection": "evidence.owner.projection", "owner_proposal": "evidence.owner.proposal", "purpose": "evidence.purpose"}[operation]
            code = "EVIDENCE_PURPOSE_MISMATCH" if operation == "purpose" else "EVIDENCE_OWNER_MISMATCH"
            target = {"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code + ":" + node_id, "detail": edited_retained[0]}
    conditions = declared_evidence_conditions(input_hash, node_id, policy["source"], [row["evidenceKey"] for row in original], policy["purpose"], generated, edited_retained)
    if not operation.startswith("generated."):
        if target is None:
            atom = "evidence.link.count" if operation.startswith("count_") else "evidence.members." + operation.removeprefix("members_")
            target = next(row for row in conditions if row["atom"] == atom)
        conditions = [row for row in conditions if not typed_equal(row, target)]
    expected = literal_evidence_graph(golden, node_id, generated)
    return {"id": case_id, "fixtureId": seed["fixtureId"], "contract": "G" if target else "F", "tier": "S", "fault": fault, "conditions": conditions, "target": target, "expectedGraph": expected, "expectedDelta": literal_difference(expected, golden), "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "seed": seed, "mappingPath": path, "literalRetainedLinks": retained, "literalGeneratedLinks": original}}


def run_policy_formula(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    fixture = fixtures[case["fixtureId"]]
    expected = literal_evidence_graph(goldens[case["fixtureId"]], case["nodeId"], case["expectedLinks"])
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(expected)), case["expectedGraphSha256"], "POLICY_EXPECTED_BINDING")
    runs = []
    for index in range(3):
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, case["conditions"])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected if index == 1 else goldens[case["fixtureId"]]})
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if index == 1 else 0)
        runs.append({"outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"]})
    restorations = []
    for index in range(len(case["conditions"])):
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"], [item for i, item in enumerate(case["conditions"]) if i != index])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], case["restorationExpected"][index])
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1)
        restorations.append(observation)
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": runs, "restorations": restorations}


def capture_schema_phase(phase_input, fault=None):
    hooks = kernel.OracleHooks(phase_input, {"fault": fault, "conditions": []})
    try:
        validator = kernel.JsonSchemaValidator(phase_input["schema"], hooks)
        if phase_input["phase"] == "validate":
            validator.validate(phase_input["value"], phase_input.get("schemaLocation", "#"))
        elif phase_input["phase"] != "inspect":
            raise AdmissionError("SCHEMA_PHASE_UNKNOWN", phase_input["phase"])
    except kernel.DefensiveBoundary as boundary:
        outcome = {"kind": "boundary", "record": boundary.record}
    except kernel.SemanticError as error:
        outcome = {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": error.check_id, "code": error.code, "detail": error.detail}
    else:
        outcome = {"kind": "admission", "accepted": True}
    return {"outcome": outcome, "edits": hooks.edits}


def run_schema_micro(case):
    fault = {
        "id": case["id"], "operation": "schema_guard", "path": case["atom"],
        "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(case["input"])), "environment": case["environment"],
        "before": False, "after": True,
    }
    records = []
    for mode in ("intact", "neutralized", "restored", "valid_operand"):
        phase_input = case["positiveInput"] if mode == "valid_operand" else case["input"]
        observation = capture_schema_phase(phase_input, fault if mode == "neutralized" else None)
        expected = {"kind": "admission", "accepted": True} if mode == "valid_operand" else case["faultExpected"] if mode == "neutralized" else case["intactExpected"]
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], expected)
        exact_record(observation["edits"], [fault] if mode == "neutralized" else [], "SCHEMA_EXACT_ONE_HIT")
        records.append({"mode": mode, **observation})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": records}


def literal_pre_evidence_node(golden_node):
    fields = ("slice", "projectionId", "proposalId", "id", "identityHash", "nodeType", "nodeKey", "sourcePointer", "parentNodeId", "canonicalOrdinal", "canonicalNodeHash", "createdAt", "representationStatus", "baseGate", "reasonCode")
    return {field: copy.deepcopy(golden_node[field]) for field in fields}


def materialize_policy_root(seed, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture, golden = fixtures[seed["fixtureId"]], goldens[seed["fixtureId"]]
    node_id = seed["sourceNodeId"]
    golden_node = matching_rows(golden["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0]
    node = literal_pre_evidence_node(golden_node)
    owner = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["typedOwners"], {"semantic_node_id": node_id})[0]
    rule_index = next(i for i, rule in enumerate(mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]) if rule["id"] == seed["ruleId"])
    rule, policy_index = mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"][rule_index], seed["index"]
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    case_id = "policy.root." + seed["ruleId"] + "." + str(policy_index)
    corruption = {"id": case_id + ".corruption", "operation": "predicate", "path": seed["path"], "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"n": node, "o": owner}, "before": True, "after": False}
    if seed["ruleId"] == "A03" and policy_index < 3:
        selected_index = 3
        policy = rule["evidence"][selected_index]
        retained = [row for row in fixture["context"]["evidenceLinks"] if row["slice"] == node["slice"] and row["nodeId"] == node_id]
        keys = [] if policy_index == 0 else [row["evidenceKey"] for row in sorted(retained, key=lambda row: row["canonicalOrdinal"])]
        generated = literal_generated_evidence(node, keys, policy["purpose"], fixture["context"]["evidenceBindings"])
        expected = literal_evidence_graph(golden, node_id, generated)
        conditions = declared_evidence_conditions(input_hash, node_id, policy["source"], keys, policy["purpose"], generated, retained)
        return {
            "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": seed["fixtureId"], "nodeId": node_id,
            "fault": corruption, "conditions": conditions, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
            "expectedLinks": generated, "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected)),
            "expectedDeltaSha256": sha256(json_bytes(literal_difference(expected, golden))), "expectedDeltaCount": len(literal_difference(expected, golden)),
            "restorationExpected": [{"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": item["atom"], "code": item["code"], "detail": item["detail"]} for item in conditions],
            "expectedSelectedIndex": selected_index, "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "seed": seed},
        }
    if seed["ruleId"] == "A15" and policy_index == 0:
        code = "EVIDENCE_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:" + node_id
        return {
            "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": "D", "fixtureId": seed["fixtureId"], "nodeId": node_id,
            "fault": corruption, "conditions": [],
            "faultExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": "evidence.keys.required", "code": code, "detail": {"expected": "one_or_more", "actual": 0}},
            "expectedSelectedIndex": 1, "emptyKeyGuard": {"atom": "evidence.keys.required", "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code, "detail": {"expected": "one_or_more", "actual": 0}},
            "guardEscapeExpectedSha256": sha256(json_bytes(golden)),
            "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "seed": seed},
        }
    code = "EVIDENCE_POLICY_UNCOVERED"
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "D", "fixtureId": seed["fixtureId"], "inputSha256": input_hash,
        "corruption": corruption,
        "neutralization": {"atom": "evidence.policy.present", "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code, "detail": node_id},
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": "evidence.policy.present", "code": code, "detail": node_id},
        "faultExpected": {"kind": "boundary", "record": {"phase": "node.evidence.choice", "ruleId": seed["ruleId"], "nodeId": node_id, "selectedIndex": None, "nextForbiddenOperation": "policy[source]"}},
        "expectedSelectedIndex": None, "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "seed": seed},
        "expectedCorruptionHits": 1, "expectedNeutralizationHits": 1,
    }


def run_policy_root(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    if case["contract"] == "G":
        return run_coordinate_guard(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens)
    if case["tier"] == "S":
        record = run_policy_formula(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens)
        observation = capture_construction(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema, case["fault"], case["conditions"])
    else:
        observation = capture_construction(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema, case["fault"], [])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], case["faultExpected"])
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1)
        escape = capture_construction(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema, case["fault"], [case["emptyKeyGuard"]])
        admit_outcome(escape["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": goldens[case["fixtureId"]]})
        exact_record(escape["conditionHits"], [case["emptyKeyGuard"]], "INCOMING_EMPTY_KEY_GUARD_ONE_HIT")
        restored = capture_construction(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema, None, [])
        admit_outcome(restored["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": goldens[case["fixtureId"]]})
        record = {"id": case["id"], "faulted": observation, "guardEscape": {"outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(escape["outcome"])), "edits": escape["edits"], "conditionHits": escape["conditionHits"]}, "restoredSha256": sha256(json_bytes(restored["outcome"]))}
    traces = matching_rows(observation["choiceTraces"], {"phase": "evidence", "nodeId": case["nodeId"]})
    exact_record(traces[0]["selectedIndex"], case["expectedSelectedIndex"], "POLICY_FALLTHROUGH_INDEX")
    return record


SCHEMA_INVENTORY_VOCABULARY = frozenset({
    "$schema", "$id", "title", "description", "$comment", "$defs", "$ref",
    "type", "required", "properties", "patternProperties", "additionalProperties",
    "minProperties", "const", "enum", "oneOf", "items", "minItems", "uniqueItems",
    "minLength", "maxLength", "pattern", "x-paprnav-array-kind", "x-paprnav-sort-key",
})
MAPPING_EXPRESSION_OPS = frozenset({"literal", "param", "row", "field", "add", "concat"})
MAPPING_PREDICATE_OPS = frozenset({"true", "false", "and", "or", "not", "eq", "in", "is_null", "starts_with", "ends_with", "contains"})


def extract_schema_inventory(document, filename):
    declarations, references = [], []

    def walk(schema, path):
        require(type(schema) in (dict, bool), "SCHEMA_INVENTORY_NODE_TYPE", path)
        if type(schema) is bool:
            declarations.append({"path": path, "keyword": "booleanSchema", "value": schema, "sha256": sha256(json_bytes(schema)), "alternatives": [True, False]})
            return
        require(not set(schema) - SCHEMA_INVENTORY_VOCABULARY, "SCHEMA_INVENTORY_UNKNOWN_KEYWORD", {"path": path, "keys": sorted(set(schema) - SCHEMA_INVENTORY_VOCABULARY)})
        for keyword, value in schema.items():
            location = escaped_path(path, keyword)
            row = {"path": location, "keyword": keyword, "value": copy.deepcopy(value), "sha256": sha256(json_bytes(value)), "alternatives": []}
            if keyword in ("required", "enum", "type"):
                row["alternatives"] = copy.deepcopy(value if type(value) is list else [value])
            elif keyword == "oneOf":
                row["alternatives"] = [escaped_path(location, index) for index in range(len(value))]
            elif keyword in ("properties", "patternProperties", "$defs"):
                row["alternatives"] = [escaped_path(location, key) for key in value]
            declarations.append(row)
            if keyword == "$ref":
                require(type(value) is str and value.startswith("#/"), "SCHEMA_INVENTORY_REFERENCE_LOCAL", location)
                target = locate(document, value[1:])
                require(type(target) in (dict, bool), "SCHEMA_INVENTORY_REFERENCE_TYPE", location)
                references.append({"usePath": path, "referencePath": location, "definitionPath": value[1:], "definitionSha256": sha256(json_bytes(target))})
            elif keyword in ("properties", "patternProperties", "$defs"):
                for name, child in value.items():
                    walk(child, escaped_path(location, name))
            elif keyword in ("items", "additionalProperties"):
                walk(value, location)
            elif keyword == "oneOf":
                for index, child in enumerate(value):
                    walk(child, escaped_path(location, index))

    walk(document, "")
    # Physical declarations are enumerated once. Reference edges retain all
    # use/definition pairs; recursive definitions do not produce infinite IDs.
    return {
        "file": filename, "sha256": sha256(json_bytes(document)), "declarations": declarations,
        "references": references,
        "referenceTraversal": "physical-declarations-once; every use-to-definition edge retained; repeated definitions retain original occurrence IDs",
    }


def extract_mapping_inventory(mapping):
    occurrences = []

    def walk(value, path, literal=False):
        if type(value) is dict:
            if "op" in value and not literal:
                op = value["op"]
                require(op in MAPPING_EXPRESSION_OPS | MAPPING_PREDICATE_OPS, "MAPPING_INVENTORY_UNKNOWN_OPERATION", {"path": path, "op": op})
                role = "predicate" if op in MAPPING_PREDICATE_OPS else "expression"
            elif not literal and set(value) == {"from", "joins", "where", "select"}:
                role = "query"
            else:
                role = "composition"
            children = [escaped_path(path, key) for key in value]
            occurrences.append({"path": path, "role": role, "sha256": sha256(json_bytes(value)), "children": children, "value": copy.deepcopy(value) if role in ("predicate", "expression") and value.get("op") in ("true", "false", "literal", "param", "field", "row") else None})
            for key, child in value.items():
                walk(child, escaped_path(path, key), literal or (value.get("op") == "literal" and key == "value"))
        elif type(value) is list:
            occurrences.append({"path": path, "role": "ordered_domain", "sha256": sha256(json_bytes(value)), "children": [escaped_path(path, index) for index in range(len(value))], "value": None})
            for index, child in enumerate(value):
                walk(child, escaped_path(path, index), literal)
        else:
            occurrences.append({"path": path, "role": "literal", "sha256": sha256(json_bytes(value)), "children": [], "value": value})

    walk(mapping["typedAst"], "/typedAst")
    return {"authority": "acceptance-mapping-v1.json", "occurrences": occurrences}


EXTERNAL_FIXTURES = (
    "external-outgoing-resolved", "external-outgoing-identity-unknown",
    "external-outgoing-not-this-proposal", "external-outgoing-target-unresolved",
    "external-outgoing-ambiguous", "external-incoming-resolved",
)


def declared_external_conditions(input_hash, actual, expected):
    conditions = []
    for atom, rows, other in (("external.members.missing", expected, actual), ("external.members.extra", actual, expected)):
        for index, member in enumerate(rows):
            occurrence = sum(item == member for item in rows[:index + 1])
            available = sum(item == member for item in other)
            if occurrence > available:
                conditions.append({
                    "atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "EXTERNAL_SET_MISMATCH",
                    "detail": {"actual": actual, "expected": expected, "member": member, "occurrence": occurrence},
                })
    return conditions


def materialize_external_case(branch_index, operation, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture_id = EXTERNAL_FIXTURES[branch_index]
    fixture, golden = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id]
    branch = mapping["typedAst"]["externalBranches"][branch_index]
    require(len(branch["queries"]) == 1, "EXTERNAL_QUERY_DOMAIN")
    require(len(golden["externalDependencies"]) == 1, "EXTERNAL_LITERAL_DOMAIN")
    row = copy.deepcopy(golden["externalDependencies"][0])
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    case_id = "external." + branch["id"] + "." + operation
    if operation in ("omit", "duplicate"):
        before, after = [row], [] if operation == "omit" else [row, row]
        hook_operation = "query_row_batch"
        changed_rows = copy.deepcopy(after)
    else:
        require(operation in row and type(row[operation]) is str, "EXTERNAL_FIELD_DOMAIN", operation)
        before, after = row, copy.deepcopy(row)
        after[operation] = "oracle_external_" + branch["id"] + "_" + operation
        hook_operation = "query_row"
        changed_rows = [copy.deepcopy(after)]
    expected_graph = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    expected_graph["externalDependencies"] = sorted(changed_rows, key=lambda item: item["sourceNodeId"])
    actual = sorted(item["sourceNodeId"] for item in changed_rows)
    expected = [row["sourceNodeId"]]
    conditions = declared_external_conditions(input_hash, actual, expected)
    fault = {
        "id": case_id, "operation": hook_operation,
        "path": "/typedAst/externalBranches/" + str(branch_index) + "/queries/0/select",
        "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"queryId": branch["id"] + ":0"},
        "before": before, "after": after,
    }
    delta = literal_difference(expected_graph, golden)
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": fixture_id,
        "fault": fault, "conditions": conditions, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "expectedRows": changed_rows, "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected_graph)),
        "expectedDeltaSha256": sha256(json_bytes(delta)), "expectedDeltaCount": len(delta),
        "restorationExpected": [{"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": item["atom"], "code": item["code"], "detail": item["detail"]} for item in conditions],
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "branchId": branch["id"], "mappingPath": fault["path"], "literalRow": row},
    }


def run_external_case(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    expected = copy.deepcopy(goldens[case["fixtureId"]])
    expected["externalDependencies"] = sorted(copy.deepcopy(case["expectedRows"]), key=lambda row: row["sourceNodeId"])
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(expected)), case["expectedGraphSha256"], "EXTERNAL_EXPECTED_BINDING")
    runs = []
    fixture = fixtures[case["fixtureId"]]
    for index in range(3):
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, case["conditions"])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected if index == 1 else goldens[case["fixtureId"]]})
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if index == 1 else 0)
        runs.append({"outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"]})
    restorations = []
    for index in range(len(case["conditions"])):
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"], [item for i, item in enumerate(case["conditions"]) if i != index])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], case["restorationExpected"][index])
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1)
        restorations.append(observation)
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": runs, "restorations": restorations}
