def materialize_identity_case(seed, operation, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    selector_index, query_index, node_id, source_id = seed
    fixture_id = "3a-main"
    fixture, golden = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id]
    selector = mapping["typedAst"]["identitySelectors"][selector_index]
    selector_id = selector["id"]
    raw = {"mappingNodeId": node_id, "sourceNodeId": source_id}
    original = matching_rows(golden["identityMappings"], {"semantic_node_id": node_id, "selectorId": selector_id})[0]
    owner = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["typedOwners"], {"semantic_node_id": node_id})[0]
    exact_record(owner["source_occurrence_node_id"], source_id, "IDENTITY_LITERAL_SOURCE")
    edges = [copy.deepcopy(edge) for edge in golden["edges"] if edge["childNodeId"] == node_id and edge["ruleId"] == selector["edgeRule"]]
    require(len(edges) == 1, "IDENTITY_LITERAL_CONSUMER")
    exact_record({key: edges[0][key] for key in original["consumer"]}, original["consumer"], "IDENTITY_LITERAL_EDGE")
    expected_set = sorted({edge["childNodeId"] for edge in golden["edges"] if edge["ruleId"] == selector["edgeRule"]})
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    case_id = "identity." + selector_id + ".q" + str(query_index) + "." + operation
    path = "/typedAst/identitySelectors/" + str(selector_index)
    environment = {"selectorId": selector_id, "row": raw}
    conditions = []
    replacements = [copy.deepcopy(original)]
    boundary = None

    def condition(atom, code, detail):
        conditions.append({"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code, "detail": copy.deepcopy(detail)})

    if operation in ("omit", "duplicate"):
        hook_operation, hook_path = "query_row_batch", path + "/queries/" + str(query_index) + "/select"
        environment = {"queryId": selector_id + ":" + str(query_index)}
        before, after = [raw], [] if operation == "omit" else [raw, raw]
        if operation == "omit":
            selected = [member for member in expected_set if member != node_id]
            condition("identity.members.missing", "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector_id, {"selected": selected, "expected": expected_set, "member": node_id})
            replacements = []
        else:
            condition("identity.consumer.unique", "IDENTITY_DOUBLE_CONSUMPTION:" + selector_id, raw)
            replacements = [copy.deepcopy(original), copy.deepcopy(original)]
    elif operation in ("owner_absent", "source_occurrence"):
        hook_operation, hook_path, before = "identity_owner", path + "/owner", owner
        if operation == "owner_absent":
            after, replacements = None, []
            condition("identity.owner.present", "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector_id, raw)
        else:
            after = copy.deepcopy(owner)
            after["source_occurrence_node_id"] = "oracle-identity-source-" + selector_id
            replacements[0]["source_occurrence_node_id"] = after["source_occurrence_node_id"]
            condition("identity.source.occurrence", "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector_id, raw)
    elif operation in ("node_absent", "node_type"):
        hook_operation, hook_path = "identity_node", path + "/node"
        before = copy.deepcopy(matching_rows(golden["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0])
        before = {key: value for key, value in before.items() if key not in ("rootRole", "effectiveGate")}
        if operation == "node_absent":
            after = None
            condition("identity.node.present", "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector_id, raw)
            boundary = {"phase": "identity.node.domain", "selectorId": selector_id, "row": raw, "nextForbiddenOperation": "node[nodeType]"}
        else:
            after = copy.deepcopy(before)
            after["nodeType"] = "oracle_wrong_identity_type"
            condition("identity.node.type", "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector_id, raw)
    elif operation in ("consumers_zero", "consumers_two"):
        hook_operation, hook_path, before = "identity_consumers", path + "/consumers", edges
        after = [] if operation == "consumers_zero" else edges + edges
        condition("identity.consumer.count", "IDENTITY_CONSUMPTION_MISMATCH:" + selector_id, {"row": raw, "consumers": after})
        if operation == "consumers_zero":
            replacements = []
    else:
        require(operation.startswith("output/"), "IDENTITY_OPERATION", operation)
        hook_operation, hook_path, before = "identity_output", path + "/output", original
        after = copy.deepcopy(original)
        field_path = "/" + operation[7:]
        old = locate(after, field_path)
        require(type(old) in (str, int) or old is None, "IDENTITY_OUTPUT_LITERAL_DOMAIN", field_path)
        new = old + 1 if type(old) is int else "oracle_identity_" + selector_id + "_" + operation[7:]
        after, edit_count = patch_value(after, {"path": field_path, "before": old, "after": new})
        require(edit_count == 1, "IDENTITY_OUTPUT_EDIT_COUNT")
        replacements = [after]
    if not replacements:
        condition("identity.remaining", "IDENTITY_UNCONSUMED", [node_id])
    expected_graph = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    expected_graph["identityMappings"] = sorted(
        [copy.deepcopy(row) for row in golden["identityMappings"] if row["semantic_node_id"] != node_id] + replacements,
        key=lambda row: row["semantic_node_id"],
    )
    expected = {"kind": "boundary", "record": boundary} if boundary is not None else {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected_graph}
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": hook_operation, "path": hook_path, "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": environment, "before": before, "after": after}
    contract = "F" if operation == "omit" or operation.startswith("output/") else "G"
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": contract, "tier": "D" if boundary is not None else "S",
        "fixtureId": fixture_id, "fault": fault, "conditions": conditions, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "targetAtom": conditions[0] if contract == "G" else None,
        "conditioningAtoms": conditions[1:] if contract == "G" else conditions,
        "expectedIdentityRows": replacements, "expectedBoundary": boundary, "expectedOutcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected)),
        "expectedDelta": literal_difference(expected_graph, golden) if boundary is None else [],
        "restorationExpected": [{"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": item["atom"], "code": item["code"], "detail": item["detail"]} for item in conditions],
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "selectorId": selector_id, "queryIndex": query_index, "mappingPath": path, "literalRow": original, "rawRow": raw},
    }


def run_identity_case(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    exact_record(case["conditions"], ([case["targetAtom"]] if case["targetAtom"] is not None else []) + case["conditioningAtoms"], "IDENTITY_TARGET_CONDITION_PARTITION")
    golden = goldens[case["fixtureId"]]
    expected_graph = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    node_id = case["authority"]["rawRow"]["mappingNodeId"]
    expected_graph["identityMappings"] = sorted([copy.deepcopy(row) for row in golden["identityMappings"] if row["semantic_node_id"] != node_id] + copy.deepcopy(case["expectedIdentityRows"]), key=lambda row: row["semantic_node_id"])
    expected = {"kind": "boundary", "record": case["expectedBoundary"]} if case["tier"] == "D" else {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected_graph}
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(expected)), case["expectedOutcomeSha256"], "IDENTITY_EXPECTED_BINDING")
    runs = []
    fixture = fixtures[case["fixtureId"]]
    for index in range(3):
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, case["conditions"])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], expected if index == 1 else {"kind": "graph", "graph": golden})
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if index == 1 else 0)
        runs.append({"outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"]})
    restorations = []
    for index in range(len(case["conditions"])):
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, case["fault"], [item for i, item in enumerate(case["conditions"]) if i != index])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], case["restorationExpected"][index])
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1)
        restorations.append(observation)
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": runs, "restorations": restorations}


def materialize_cardinality_case(seed, coordinate, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    require(coordinate in ("min", "max"), "CARDINALITY_BOUND_COORDINATE")
    fixture_id, rule_id, edge = seed["fixtureId"], seed["ruleId"], seed["sourceRow"]
    golden = goldens[fixture_id]
    matching_rows(golden["edges"], edge)
    rule_index = next(i for i, rule in enumerate(mapping["typedAst"]["edges"]) if rule["id"] == rule_id)
    rule = mapping["typedAst"]["edges"][rule_index]
    parent_id = edge["parentNodeId"]
    count = sum(row["ruleId"] == rule_id and row["parentNodeId"] == parent_id for row in golden["edges"])
    require(count > 0, "CARDINALITY_LITERAL_POSITIVE_PARENT")
    before = rule["cardinality"][coordinate]
    after = count + 1 if coordinate == "min" else count - 1
    bounds = copy.deepcopy(rule["cardinality"])
    bounds[coordinate] = after
    atom = "edge.cardinality.lower" if coordinate == "min" else "edge.cardinality.upper"
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixtures[fixture_id]))
    detail = {"parent": parent_id, "actual": count, "bounds": bounds}
    code = "CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:" + rule_id
    case_id = "cardinality." + rule_id + "." + coordinate
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "edge_bound", "path": "/typedAst/edges/" + str(rule_index) + "/cardinality/" + coordinate, "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"ruleId": rule_id, "parentNodeId": parent_id, "count": count}, "before": before, "after": after}
    condition = {"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code, "detail": detail}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": fixture_id,
        "fault": fault, "conditions": [condition], "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": atom, "code": code, "detail": detail},
        "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(golden)), "expectedDelta": [],
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "ruleId": rule_id, "sourceRow": edge, "bounds": rule["cardinality"], "scope": "one evaluated parent-bound operand; not a global mapping edit"},
    }


def run_cardinality_case(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    golden, fixture = goldens[case["fixtureId"]], fixtures[case["fixtureId"]]
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(golden)), case["expectedGraphSha256"], "CARDINALITY_LITERAL_BINDING")
    runs = []
    for mode in ("baseline", "intact_corruption", "neutralized", "restored_guard", "restored_operand"):
        fault = case["fault"] if mode in ("intact_corruption", "neutralized", "restored_guard") else None
        conditions = case["conditions"] if mode == "neutralized" else []
        observation = capture_construction(fixture, mapping, source_schema, fault, conditions)
        expected = case["intactExpected"] if mode in ("intact_corruption", "restored_guard") else {"kind": "graph", "graph": golden}
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], expected)
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if fault is not None else 0)
        exact_record(observation["conditionHits"], conditions, "CARDINALITY_EXACT_CONDITION_HIT")
        runs.append({"mode": mode, "outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"]})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": runs}


def decode_primitive_input(phase_input):
    encoding, value = phase_input.get("encoding", "json"), phase_input["value"]
    if encoding == "json":
        return copy.deepcopy(value)
    if encoding == "json_text":
        return json.loads(value)
    if encoding == "tuple":
        return tuple(value)
    if encoding == "surrogate":
        return chr(value)
    if encoding == "nonstring_key":
        return {value["key"]: value["value"]}
    raise AdmissionError("PRIMITIVE_INPUT_ENCODING", encoding)


def capture_primitive_phase(phase_input, fault=None):
    hooks = kernel.OracleHooks(phase_input, {"fault": fault, "conditions": []})
    try:
        value = decode_primitive_input(phase_input)
        phase = phase_input["phase"]
        if phase == "json":
            result = kernel.strict_loads(value, hooks)
        elif phase == "canonical":
            result = list(kernel.canonical_bytes(value, hooks))
        elif phase == "row_hash":
            result = kernel.row_hash(value["slice"], value["table"], value["identity"], hooks)
        elif phase == "pointer":
            result = kernel.pointer(value["document"], value["path"], hooks)
        elif phase == "child_pointer":
            result = kernel.child_pointer(value["path"], value["key"], hooks)
        elif phase == "equal":
            result = kernel.exact_equal(value[0], value[1])
        elif phase == "digest":
            result = kernel.digest(value, hooks)
        else:
            raise AdmissionError("PRIMITIVE_PHASE_UNKNOWN", phase)
        outcome = {"kind": "value", "value": result}
    except kernel.DefensiveBoundary as boundary:
        outcome = {"kind": "boundary", "record": boundary.record}
    except kernel.SemanticError as error:
        outcome = {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": error.check_id, "code": error.code, "detail": error.detail}
    return {"outcome": outcome, "edits": hooks.edits}


def materialize_primitive_guard(case_id, invalid, valid, atom, code, detail, path, valid_expected, escaped_value=None, continuation=False):
    environment = {"path": path, "code": code, "detail": detail}
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "primitive_guard", "path": atom, "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(invalid)), "environment": environment, "before": False, "after": True}
    escaped = {"kind": "value", "value": escaped_value} if continuation else {"kind": "boundary", "record": {"phase": "primitive.domain", "atom": atom, "environment": environment, "nextForbiddenOperation": "consume-invalid-primitive-domain"}}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "D", "phaseInput": invalid, "validInput": valid,
        "fault": fault, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": atom, "code": code, "detail": detail},
        "faultExpected": escaped, "validExpected": {"kind": "value", "value": valid_expected},
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "sourceAtom": atom, "phase": invalid["phase"]},
    }


def run_primitive_case(case):
    observations = []
    for mode in ("valid", "intact", "neutralized", "restored", "substituted"):
        phase_input = case["validInput"] if mode in ("valid", "substituted") else case["phaseInput"]
        fault = case["fault"] if mode == "neutralized" else None
        expected = case["validExpected"] if mode in ("valid", "substituted") else case["faultExpected"] if mode == "neutralized" else case["intactExpected"]
        observation = capture_primitive_phase(phase_input, fault)
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], expected)
        exact_record(observation["edits"], [fault] if fault is not None else [], "PRIMITIVE_EXACT_HIT")
        observations.append({"mode": mode, **observation})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def run_primitive_formula(case):
    fault = {"id": case["id"], "operation": "primitive_output", "path": case["atom"], "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(case["input"])), "environment": case["environment"], "before": case["before"], "after": case["after"]}
    records = []
    for mode in ("baseline", "fault", "restored", "wrong_path", "zero_hit"):
        active = fault if mode == "fault" else {**fault, "path": "oracle_wrong_occurrence"} if mode == "wrong_path" else {**fault, "inputSha256": "0" * 64} if mode == "zero_hit" else None
        observation = capture_primitive_phase(case["input"], active)
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "value", "value": case["expectedFaultValue"] if mode == "fault" else case["expectedValue"]})
        exact_record(observation["edits"], [fault] if mode == "fault" else [], "PRIMITIVE_FORMULA_EXACT_HIT")
        records.append({"mode": mode, **observation})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": records}


def choice_terminals(expression, path):
    op = expression["op"]
    if op in ("and", "or"):
        result = []
        for index, term in enumerate(expression["terms"]):
            result.extend(choice_terminals(term, path + "/terms/" + str(index)))
        return result
    if op == "not":
        return choice_terminals(expression["term"], path + "/term")
    require(op in ("true", "false", "eq", "in", "is_null", "starts_with", "ends_with", "contains"), "CHOICE_TERMINAL_OPERATION", op)
    return [(path, copy.deepcopy(expression))]


def materialize_choice_terminal(seed, leaf_path, desired, alternative, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    phase = seed["phase"]
    rule_index = next(i for i, rule in enumerate(mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]) if rule["id"] == seed["ruleId"])
    root_path = "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + ("/cases/" if phase == "case" else "/evidence/") + str(seed["index"]) + "/when"
    require(leaf_path == root_path or leaf_path.startswith(root_path + "/"), "CHOICE_TERMINAL_AUTHORITY")
    expression = copy.deepcopy(locate(mapping, leaf_path))
    fixture_id, node_id = seed["fixtureId"], seed["sourceNodeId"]
    fixture = fixtures[fixture_id]
    node = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["semanticNodes"], {"id": node_id})[0]
    owner = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["typedOwners"], {"semantic_node_id": node_id})[0]
    if phase == "evidence":
        node = literal_pre_evidence_node(matching_rows(goldens[fixture_id]["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0])
    original_environment = {"n": copy.deepcopy(node), "o": copy.deepcopy(owner)}
    environment = copy.deepcopy(original_environment)
    op = expression["op"]
    if op in ("true", "false"):
        require(desired == (op == "true") and alternative == 0, "CHOICE_CONSTANT_DOMAIN")
    else:
        field = expression["left"] if op == "eq" else expression["value"]
        require(field["op"] == "field", "CHOICE_TERMINAL_FIELD_DOMAIN")
        alias, key = field["alias"], field["name"]
        if op == "eq":
            require(expression["right"]["op"] == "literal", "CHOICE_TERMINAL_LITERAL_DOMAIN")
            value = copy.deepcopy(expression["right"]["value"]) if desired else "oracle_choice_mismatch"
        elif op == "in":
            require(0 <= alternative < len(expression["values"]), "CHOICE_TERMINAL_ALTERNATIVE")
            value = copy.deepcopy(expression["values"][alternative]) if desired else "oracle_choice_mismatch"
            require("oracle_choice_mismatch" not in expression["values"], "CHOICE_SENTINEL_FRESH")
        elif op == "is_null":
            value = None if desired else "oracle_choice_nonnull"
        elif op == "starts_with":
            value = expression["text"] + "oracle_tail" if desired else "oracle_mismatch"
        elif op == "ends_with":
            value = "oracle_head" + expression["text"] if desired else "oracle_mismatch"
        else:
            value = "oracle_head" + expression["text"] + "oracle_tail" if desired else "oracle_mismatch"
        environment[alias][key] = value
    phase_input = {"fixtureId": fixture_id, "mappingPath": leaf_path, "expression": expression, "environment": environment}
    case_id = "choice.terminal." + seed["ruleId"] + "." + phase + "." + str(seed["index"]) + "." + leaf_path.removeprefix(root_path).replace("/", "_") + "." + str(alternative) + "." + ("true" if desired else "false")
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "predicate", "path": leaf_path, "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(phase_input)), "environment": environment, "before": desired, "after": not desired}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": "D", "phaseInput": phase_input, "fault": fault,
        "baselineExpected": {"kind": "value", "value": desired}, "faultExpected": {"kind": "value", "value": not desired}, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "rootPath": root_path, "sourceEnvironment": original_environment, "caller": seed, "microenvironment": "terminal domain only; not a retained projection", "semanticBridge": ("case.absence." if phase == "case" else "policy.root.") + seed["ruleId"] + "." + str(seed["index"])},
    }


def run_choice_terminal(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema):
    phase_input = case["phaseInput"]
    exact_record(locate(mapping, phase_input["mappingPath"]), phase_input["expression"], "CHOICE_TERMINAL_SOURCE_BINDING")
    observations = []
    for index in range(3):
        subject = kernel.SemanticKernel(fixtures[phase_input["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema)
        subject.hooks = kernel.OracleHooks(phase_input, {"fault": case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, "conditions": []})
        value = subject.test(phase_input["expression"], phase_input["environment"], phase_input["mappingPath"])
        outcome = {"kind": "value", "value": value}
        admit_outcome(outcome, case["faultExpected"] if index == 1 else case["baselineExpected"])
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(subject.hooks.edits, case, 1 if index == 1 else 0)
        observations.append({"outcome": outcome, "edits": subject.hooks.edits})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def choice_constraints(expression, path, desired):
    op = expression["op"]
    if op == "not":
        return choice_constraints(expression["term"], path + "/term", not desired)
    if op in ("and", "or"):
        result = []
        for index, term in enumerate(expression["terms"]):
            child_truth = desired if index == 0 else op == "and"
            result.extend(choice_constraints(term, path + "/terms/" + str(index), child_truth))
        return result
    require(op not in ("true", "false") or desired == (op == "true"), "CHOICE_CONSTRAINT_CONSTANT")
    return [{"path": path, "expression": expression, "truth": desired}]


def literal_choice_leaf(value, expression):
    op = expression["op"]
    if op == "eq":
        return typed_equal(value, expression["right"]["value"])
    if op == "in":
        return any(typed_equal(value, item) for item in expression["values"])
    if op == "is_null":
        return value is None
    require(type(value) is str, "CHOICE_STRING_DOMAIN")
    if op == "starts_with":
        return value.startswith(expression["text"])
    if op == "ends_with":
        return value.endswith(expression["text"])
    require(op == "contains", "CHOICE_LITERAL_OPERATION")
    return expression["text"] in value


def materialize_choice_environment(original, constraints):
    environment = copy.deepcopy(original)
    fields = {}
    for constraint in constraints:
        expression = constraint["expression"]
        if expression["op"] in ("true", "false"):
            continue
        field = expression["left"] if expression["op"] == "eq" else expression["value"]
        require(field["op"] == "field", "CHOICE_CONSTRAINT_FIELD")
        fields.setdefault((field["alias"], field["name"]), []).append(constraint)
    for (alias, name), items in fields.items():
        prefixes, suffixes, interiors = ["", "oracle_head"], ["", "oracle_tail"], ["", "oracle_middle"]
        candidates = [environment[alias].get(name), None, 0, False, "", "oracle_mismatch"]
        string_only = False
        for item in items:
            expression = item["expression"]
            op = expression["op"]
            if op == "eq":
                candidates.append(copy.deepcopy(expression["right"]["value"]))
            elif op == "in":
                candidates.extend(copy.deepcopy(expression["values"]))
            elif op in ("starts_with", "ends_with", "contains"):
                string_only = True
                target = prefixes if op == "starts_with" else suffixes if op == "ends_with" else interiors
                target.append(expression["text"])
        candidates.extend(prefix + middle + suffix for prefix in prefixes for middle in interiors for suffix in suffixes)
        eligible = [candidate for candidate in candidates if (not string_only or type(candidate) is str) and all(literal_choice_leaf(candidate, item["expression"]) == item["truth"] for item in items)]
        require(bool(eligible), "CHOICE_MICROENVIRONMENT_UNSATISFIED", {"field": [alias, name], "constraints": items})
        environment[alias][name] = copy.deepcopy(eligible[0])
    return environment


def literal_choice_trace(expression, path, leaves, target=None):
    op, trace = expression["op"], []
    if op in ("and", "or"):
        value = op == "and"
        for index, child in enumerate(expression["terms"]):
            child_value, child_trace = literal_choice_trace(child, path + "/terms/" + str(index), leaves, target)
            trace.extend(child_trace)
            value = child_value
            if (op == "and" and not value) or (op == "or" and value):
                break
    elif op == "not":
        child_value, child_trace = literal_choice_trace(expression["term"], path + "/term", leaves, target)
        trace.extend(child_trace)
        value = not child_value
    else:
        value = leaves[path]
    changed = not value if target == path else value
    trace.append({"path": path, "before": value, "after": changed})
    return changed, trace


def materialize_choice_composition(seed, composition_path, child_index, desired, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    root_expression = copy.deepcopy(locate(mapping, composition_path))
    op = root_expression["op"]
    require(op in ("and", "or", "not"), "CHOICE_COMPOSITION_DOMAIN")
    child_expressions = root_expression["terms"] if op in ("and", "or") else [root_expression["term"]]
    require(0 <= child_index < len(child_expressions), "CHOICE_COMPOSITION_CHILD")
    constraints, child_paths = [], []
    for index, child in enumerate(child_expressions):
        child_path = composition_path + ("/terms/" + str(index) if op in ("and", "or") else "/term")
        child_paths.append(child_path)
        constraints.extend(choice_constraints(child, child_path, desired if index == child_index else op == "and"))
    template = materialize_choice_terminal(seed, constraints[0]["path"], constraints[0]["truth"], 0, fixtures, mapping, goldens)
    original_environment = template["authority"]["sourceEnvironment"]
    environment = materialize_choice_environment(original_environment, constraints)
    leaves = {item["path"]: item["truth"] for item in constraints}
    baseline_value, baseline_trace = literal_choice_trace(root_expression, composition_path, leaves)
    target = child_paths[child_index]
    changed_value, changed_trace = literal_choice_trace(root_expression, composition_path, leaves, target)
    require(baseline_value != changed_value, "CHOICE_COMPOSITION_DETERMINATIVE")
    phase_input = {"fixtureId": seed["fixtureId"], "mappingPath": composition_path, "expression": root_expression, "environment": environment}
    case_id = "choice.composition." + composition_path.replace("/", "_") + "." + str(child_index) + "." + ("true" if desired else "false")
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "predicate", "path": target, "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(phase_input)), "environment": environment, "before": desired, "after": not desired}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": "D", "phaseInput": phase_input, "fault": fault, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "baselineExpected": {"kind": "value", "value": baseline_value}, "faultExpected": {"kind": "value", "value": changed_value},
        "baselineTrace": baseline_trace, "faultTrace": changed_trace,
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "caller": seed, "sourceEnvironment": original_environment, "constraints": constraints, "microenvironment": "neutral sibling phase environment; not a retained projection"},
    }


def run_choice_composition(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema):
    phase_input = case["phaseInput"]
    exact_record(locate(mapping, phase_input["mappingPath"]), phase_input["expression"], "CHOICE_COMPOSITION_SOURCE_BINDING")
    observations = []
    for index in range(3):
        subject = kernel.SemanticKernel(fixtures[phase_input["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema)
        subject.hooks = kernel.OracleHooks(phase_input, {"fault": case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, "conditions": []})
        subject.hooks.trace_paths = sorted({row["path"] for row in case["baselineTrace"] + case["faultTrace"]})
        value = subject.test(phase_input["expression"], phase_input["environment"], phase_input["mappingPath"])
        outcome = {"kind": "value", "value": value}
        admit_outcome(outcome, case["faultExpected"] if index == 1 else case["baselineExpected"])
        exact_record(subject.hooks.predicate_traces, case["faultTrace"] if index == 1 else case["baselineTrace"], "CHOICE_COMPOSITION_EXACT_TRACE")
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(subject.hooks.edits, case, 1 if index == 1 else 0)
        observations.append({"outcome": outcome, "trace": subject.hooks.predicate_traces, "edits": subject.hooks.edits})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def materialize_case_multiple(rule_index, target_index, companion, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    rule = mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"][rule_index]
    fixture_id, node_id, selected_index = companion["fixtureId"], companion["sourceNodeId"], companion["index"]
    fixture, golden = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id]
    node = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["semanticNodes"], {"id": node_id})[0]
    owner = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["typedOwners"], {"semantic_node_id": node_id})[0]
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    if target_index is None:
        require(len(rule["cases"]) == 1 and selected_index == 0, "CASE_DUPLICATE_SINGLE_LITERAL")
        indices = [0, 0]
        case_id = "case.multiple." + rule["id"] + ".duplicate"
        fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "case_indices", "path": "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/cases", "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"ruleId": rule["id"], "nodeId": node_id}, "before": [0], "after": indices}
    else:
        require(target_index != selected_index and rule["cases"][target_index]["when"]["op"] != "true", "CASE_FALSE_ROOT_DOMAIN")
        indices = sorted([target_index, selected_index])
        case_id = "case.multiple." + rule["id"] + "." + str(target_index)
        fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "predicate", "path": "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/cases/" + str(target_index) + "/when", "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"n": node, "o": owner}, "before": False, "after": True}
    condition = {"atom": "case.unique", "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "UNION_SELECTION_MULTIPLE:" + rule["id"], "detail": {"nodeId": node_id, "matches": 2}}
    selected_case = rule["cases"][indices[0]]
    graph = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    selected_node = matching_rows(graph["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0]
    selected_node.update(representationStatus=selected_case["representation"], baseGate=selected_case["baseGate"], reasonCode=selected_case["reason"])
    graph = literal_readiness(graph)
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": fixture_id,
        "fault": fault, "conditions": [condition], "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "expectedNodeFields": {key: selected_node[key] for key in ("representationStatus", "baseGate", "reasonCode")},
        "expectedTrace": {"phase": "case", "ruleId": rule["id"], "nodeId": node_id, "matchingIndices": indices},
        "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(graph)), "expectedDelta": literal_difference(graph, golden),
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": condition["atom"], "code": condition["code"], "detail": condition["detail"]},
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "ruleId": rule["id"], "companion": companion, "firstMatchIndex": indices[0], "guardEscapeMayBeUnchanged": True},
    }


def run_case_multiple(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    golden = goldens[case["fixtureId"]]
    expected = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    node_id = case["expectedTrace"]["nodeId"]
    matching_rows(expected["nodes"], {"id": node_id})[0].update(copy.deepcopy(case["expectedNodeFields"]))
    expected = literal_readiness(expected)
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(expected)), case["expectedGraphSha256"], "CASE_MULTIPLE_EXPECTED_BINDING")
    observations = []
    for mode in ("baseline", "corruption", "neutralized", "restored_guard", "restored_fault"):
        active = mode in ("corruption", "neutralized", "restored_guard")
        observation = capture_construction(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if active else None, case["conditions"] if mode == "neutralized" else [])
        outcome = case["intactExpected"] if mode in ("corruption", "restored_guard") else {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected if mode == "neutralized" else golden}
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], outcome)
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if active else 0)
        if active:
            trace = matching_rows(observation["choiceTraces"], {"phase": "case", "ruleId": case["authority"]["ruleId"], "nodeId": node_id})[0]
            exact_record(trace, case["expectedTrace"], "CASE_MULTIPLE_EXACT_ORDER")
        observations.append({"mode": mode, "outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"]})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def schema_shape_parameters(document):
    parameters = []

    def walk(schema, path):
        parameters.append({"path": path, "variant": "container"})
        if type(schema) is bool:
            return
        parameters.append({"path": path, "variant": "vocabulary"})
        for keyword, value in schema.items():
            target = escaped_path(path, keyword)
            if keyword in ("$defs", "properties", "patternProperties"):
                parameters.append({"path": target, "variant": "members"})
                for name, child in value.items():
                    walk(child, escaped_path(target, name))
            elif keyword in ("items", "additionalProperties"):
                walk(value, target)
            elif keyword == "oneOf":
                parameters.extend({"path": target, "variant": variant} for variant in ("oneof_list", "oneof_empty"))
                for index, child in enumerate(value):
                    walk(child, escaped_path(target, index))
            elif keyword == "type":
                parameters.append({"path": target, "variant": "type_empty"})
                for index in range(len(value) if type(value) is list else 1):
                    parameters.extend({"path": target, "variant": variant, "index": index} for variant in ("type_entry", "type_unknown"))
            elif keyword == "required":
                parameters.append({"path": target, "variant": "required_list"})
                parameters.extend({"path": target, "variant": "required_entry", "index": index} for index in range(len(value)))
                if value:
                    parameters.append({"path": target, "variant": "required_duplicate"})
            elif keyword in ("minProperties", "minItems", "minLength", "maxLength"):
                parameters.extend({"path": target, "variant": variant} for variant in ("bound_type", "bound_negative"))
            elif keyword == "uniqueItems":
                parameters.append({"path": target, "variant": "unique_type"})
            elif keyword == "pattern":
                parameters.extend({"path": target, "variant": variant} for variant in ("pattern_type", "pattern_invalid"))
            elif keyword == "enum":
                parameters.extend({"path": target, "variant": variant} for variant in ("enum_list", "enum_empty"))
            elif keyword == "x-paprnav-array-kind":
                parameters.append({"path": target, "variant": "array_kind"})
            elif keyword == "x-paprnav-sort-key":
                parameters.append({"path": target, "variant": "sort_empty"})
                parameters.extend({"path": target, "variant": "sort_entry", "index": index} for index in range(len(value) if type(value) is list else 1))
            elif keyword == "$ref":
                parameters.extend({"path": target, "variant": variant} for variant in ("reference_type", "reference_remote", "reference_missing", "reference_nonschema"))
    walk(document, "")
    return parameters


def materialize_schema_shape(filename, document, parameter):
    path, variant, index = parameter["path"], parameter["variant"], parameter.get("index", 0)
    before, location = copy.deepcopy(locate(document, path)), "#" + path
    code, detail = "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", location
    schema_location = location
    if variant == "container":
        after, atom = 7, "schema.container.object"
    elif variant == "vocabulary":
        require("oracle_unknown_keyword" not in before, "SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_SENTINEL_FRESH")
        after, atom = {**before, "oracle_unknown_keyword": True}, "schema.vocabulary.known"
        code, detail = "SOURCE_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_KEYWORD", ["oracle_unknown_keyword"]
    elif variant == "members":
        after, atom = [], "schema.members.object"
    elif variant in ("oneof_list", "oneof_empty"):
        after = {} if variant == "oneof_list" else []
        atom = "schema.oneof.list" if variant == "oneof_list" else "schema.oneof.nonempty"
    elif variant in ("type_empty", "type_entry", "type_unknown"):
        after = [] if variant == "type_empty" else copy.deepcopy(before if type(before) is list else [before])
        atom = {"type_empty": "schema.type.nonempty", "type_entry": "schema.type.entry.string", "type_unknown": "schema.type.entry.known"}[variant]
        if variant != "type_empty":
            after[index] = 7 if variant == "type_entry" else "oracle_unknown_type"
            if type(before) is not list:
                after = after[0]
            schema_location += "/" + str(index)
    elif variant in ("required_list", "required_entry", "required_duplicate"):
        atom = {"required_list": "schema.required.list", "required_entry": "schema.required.entry.string", "required_duplicate": "schema.required.unique"}[variant]
        after = "oracle_not_list" if variant == "required_list" else copy.deepcopy(before)
        if variant == "required_entry":
            after[index] = 7
            schema_location += "/" + str(index)
        elif variant == "required_duplicate":
            after.append(before[0])
    elif variant in ("bound_type", "bound_negative"):
        after, atom = (True, "schema.bound.integer") if variant == "bound_type" else (-1, "schema.bound.nonnegative")
    elif variant == "unique_type":
        after, atom = 7, "schema.unique.boolean"
    elif variant in ("pattern_type", "pattern_invalid"):
        after, atom = (7, "schema.pattern.string") if variant == "pattern_type" else ("[", "schema.pattern.valid")
        code = "SOURCE_SCHEMA_PATTERN"
        if variant == "pattern_invalid":
            detail = {"location": location, "error": "unterminated character set at position 0"}
    elif variant in ("enum_list", "enum_empty"):
        after, atom = ({}, "schema.enum.list") if variant == "enum_list" else ([], "schema.enum.nonempty")
    elif variant == "array_kind":
        after, atom, code = "oracle_bad_kind", "schema.array_kind.known", "SOURCE_CANONICALIZATION_ANNOTATION"
    elif variant in ("sort_empty", "sort_entry"):
        after = [] if variant == "sort_empty" else copy.deepcopy(before if type(before) is list else [before])
        atom = "schema.sort_key.nonempty" if variant == "sort_empty" else "schema.sort_key.entry.string"
        code = "SOURCE_CANONICALIZATION_ANNOTATION"
        if variant == "sort_entry":
            after[index] = 7
            if type(before) is not list:
                after = after[0]
            schema_location += "/" + str(index)
    else:
        require(variant in ("reference_type", "reference_remote", "reference_missing", "reference_nonschema"), "SCHEMA_SHAPE_VARIANT")
        after = {"reference_type": 7, "reference_remote": "https://oracle.invalid/schema", "reference_missing": "#/$defs/oracle_missing", "reference_nonschema": "#/$id"}[variant]
        atom = {"reference_type": "schema.reference.string", "reference_remote": "schema.reference.local", "reference_missing": "schema.reference.present", "reference_nonschema": "schema.reference.schema"}[variant]
        schema_location = "#" + path.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
        code = "SOURCE_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_UNSUPPORTED" if variant in ("reference_type", "reference_remote") else "SOURCE_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_MISSING" if variant == "reference_missing" else "SOURCE_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_NOT_SCHEMA"
        detail = after if variant == "reference_nonschema" else {"location": schema_location, "reference": after}
    edit = {"path": path, "before": before, "after": after}
    changed, edit_count = patch_value(document, edit)
    require(edit_count == 1, "SCHEMA_SHAPE_EDIT_COUNT")
    operand = after
    if variant in ("type_empty", "sort_empty"):
        operand = after
    elif variant in ("type_entry", "type_unknown", "required_entry", "sort_entry"):
        operand = after[index] if type(after) is list else after
    elif variant == "reference_nonschema":
        operand = document["$id"]
    phase_input = {"phase": "inspect", "schema": changed}
    environment = {"schemaLocation": schema_location, "operand": operand, "diagnostic": code, "payload": detail}
    case_id = "schema.shape." + filename + "." + path.replace("/", "_") + "." + variant + "." + str(index)
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "schema_guard", "path": atom, "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(phase_input)), "environment": environment, "before": False, "after": True}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "D", "schemaFile": filename, "edit": edit, "fault": fault,
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": atom, "code": code, "detail": detail},
        "faultExpected": {"kind": "boundary", "record": {"phase": "schema.domain", "atom": atom, "environment": environment, "rejectionSuppressed": True, "nextForbiddenOperation": "consume-invalid-schema-domain"}},
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "schemaSha256": INPUT_HASHES[filename], "parameter": parameter},
    }


def run_schema_shape(case, schemas):
    document = schemas[case["schemaFile"]]
    changed, edit_count = patch_value(document, case["edit"])
    exact_record(edit_count, 1, "SCHEMA_SHAPE_EDIT_COUNT")
    observations = []
    for mode in ("valid", "intact", "neutralized", "restored", "substituted"):
        phase_input = {"phase": "inspect", "schema": document if mode in ("valid", "substituted") else changed}
        fault = case["fault"] if mode == "neutralized" else None
        expected = {"kind": "admission", "accepted": True} if mode in ("valid", "substituted") else case["faultExpected"] if mode == "neutralized" else case["intactExpected"]
        observation = capture_schema_phase(phase_input, fault)
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], expected)
        exact_record(observation["edits"], [fault] if fault is not None else [], "SCHEMA_SHAPE_EXACT_HIT")
        observations.append({"mode": mode, **observation})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def literal_schema_witness(document, schema, variant=0, stack=()):
    require(schema is not False, "SCHEMA_EMPTY_INSTANCE_DOMAIN")
    if schema is True:
        return None
    if "$ref" in schema:
        reference = schema["$ref"]
        require(reference not in stack, "SCHEMA_WITNESS_RECURSIVE_BRANCH", reference)
        return literal_schema_witness(document, locate(document, reference[1:]), variant, stack + (reference,))
    if "oneOf" in schema:
        alternatives = schema["oneOf"]
        order = [variant % len(alternatives)] + [i for i in range(len(alternatives)) if i != variant % len(alternatives)]
        for index in order:
            try:
                return literal_schema_witness(document, alternatives[index], variant, stack)
            except AdmissionError as error:
                if error.code not in ("SCHEMA_EMPTY_INSTANCE_DOMAIN", "SCHEMA_WITNESS_RECURSIVE_BRANCH"):
                    raise
        raise AdmissionError("SCHEMA_WITNESS_NO_FINITE_BRANCH")
    if "const" in schema:
        return copy.deepcopy(schema["const"])
    if "enum" in schema:
        return copy.deepcopy(schema["enum"][variant % len(schema["enum"])])
    kind = schema.get("type", "null")
    kind = kind[0] if type(kind) is list else kind
    if kind == "object":
        result = {}
        properties = schema.get("properties", {})
        for key in schema.get("required", []):
            result[key] = literal_schema_witness(document, properties.get(key, True), variant, stack)
        minimum = schema.get("minProperties", 0)
        if len(result) < minimum:
            for key, child in properties.items():
                if key not in result and len(result) < minimum:
                    result[key] = literal_schema_witness(document, child, variant, stack)
        if len(result) < minimum:
            patterns = schema.get("patternProperties", {})
            require(len(patterns) == 1, "SCHEMA_WITNESS_OBJECT_MINIMUM")
            key = "oracle" + str(variant)
            result[key] = literal_schema_witness(document, next(iter_value for iter_value in patterns.values()), variant, stack)
        require(len(result) >= minimum, "SCHEMA_WITNESS_OBJECT_CARDINALITY")
        return result
    if kind == "array":
        return [literal_schema_witness(document, schema.get("items", True), variant + index, stack) for index in range(schema.get("minItems", 0))]
    if kind == "string":
        pattern = schema.get("pattern")
        if pattern == "^[0-9a-f]{64}$":
            value = "a" * 64
        elif pattern in ("^[1-9][0-9]*$", "^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:\\.[0-9]*[1-9])?$"):
            value = str(variant + 1)
        elif pattern == "^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$":
            value = "oracle" + str(variant)
        else:
            require(pattern is None, "SCHEMA_WITNESS_PATTERN", pattern)
            value = "x" * schema.get("minLength", 0)
        require(len(value) <= schema.get("maxLength", len(value)), "SCHEMA_WITNESS_STRING_BOUNDS")
        return value
    if kind == "integer" or kind == "number":
        return variant
    if kind == "boolean":
        return variant % 2 == 0
    require(kind == "null", "SCHEMA_WITNESS_TYPE", kind)
    return None


def schema_instance_parameters(document):
    parameters = []
    inventory = extract_schema_inventory(document, "instance-authority")
    for row in inventory["declarations"]:
        keyword, declaration_path = row["keyword"], row["path"]
        path = declaration_path.rsplit("/", 1)[0]
        if keyword in ("type", "const", "enum", "minProperties", "minItems", "minLength", "maxLength", "pattern"):
            parameters.append({"path": path, "keyword": keyword, "variant": "invalid"})
        elif keyword == "required":
            parameters.extend({"path": path, "keyword": keyword, "variant": "missing", "member": member} for member in row["value"])
        elif keyword == "uniqueItems" and row["value"]:
            parameters.append({"path": path, "keyword": keyword, "variant": "duplicate"})
        elif keyword == "additionalProperties" and row["value"] is False:
            parameters.append({"path": path, "keyword": keyword, "variant": "unknown_member"})
    return parameters


def materialize_schema_instance(filename, document, parameter):
    path, keyword = parameter["path"], parameter["keyword"]
    schema = locate(document, path)
    valid = literal_schema_witness(document, schema)
    invalid = copy.deepcopy(valid)
    location, instance_pointer = "#" + path, ""
    if keyword == "type":
        names = schema["type"] if type(schema["type"]) is list else [schema["type"]]
        require(len(names) == 1, "SCHEMA_INSTANCE_SINGLE_TYPE_DOMAIN")
        invalid = {"object": [], "array": {}, "string": 0, "boolean": 0, "integer": True, "number": True, "null": 0}[names[0]]
        atom, code, detail = "schema.instance.type", "SOURCE_TYPE_MISMATCH", {"pointer": "", "expected": names}
    elif keyword == "required":
        member = parameter["member"]
        require(member in valid, "SCHEMA_REQUIRED_POSITIVE_MEMBER")
        invalid = {key: value for key, value in valid.items() if key != member}
        atom, code, detail = "schema.instance.required", "SOURCE_REQUIRED_MISSING", escaped_path("", member)
        location = escaped_path(location + "/required", member)
    elif keyword == "const":
        invalid = "oracle_wrong_constant" if type(valid) is str else not valid if type(valid) is bool else None if valid is not None else "oracle_nonnull"
        atom, code, detail = "schema.instance.const", "SOURCE_CONST_MISMATCH", ""
    elif keyword == "enum":
        invalid = "oracle_wrong_enum"
        require(invalid not in schema["enum"], "SCHEMA_ENUM_SENTINEL_FRESH")
        atom, code, detail = "schema.instance.enum", "SOURCE_ENUM_MISMATCH", ""
    elif keyword == "minProperties":
        require(schema[keyword] > 0 and not schema.get("required"), "SCHEMA_MIN_PROPERTIES_ISOLATION")
        invalid, atom, code, detail = {}, "schema.instance.min_properties", "SOURCE_OBJECT_CARDINALITY", ""
    elif keyword == "minItems":
        require(schema[keyword] > 0, "SCHEMA_MIN_ITEMS_DOMAIN")
        invalid, atom, code, detail = valid[:schema[keyword] - 1], "schema.instance.min_items", "SOURCE_ARRAY_CARDINALITY", ""
    elif keyword == "uniqueItems":
        item = literal_schema_witness(document, schema.get("items", True))
        valid = [copy.deepcopy(item)]
        require(schema.get("minItems", 0) <= 1, "SCHEMA_UNIQUE_MINIMUM_DOMAIN")
        invalid, atom, code, detail = [copy.deepcopy(item), copy.deepcopy(item)], "schema.instance.unique_item", "SOURCE_ARRAY_DUPLICATE", "/1"
    elif keyword in ("minLength", "maxLength"):
        if keyword == "minLength":
            require(schema[keyword] > 0, "SCHEMA_MIN_LENGTH_DOMAIN")
            invalid, atom = "x" * (schema[keyword] - 1), "schema.instance.min_length"
        else:
            invalid, atom = "x" * (schema[keyword] + 1), "schema.instance.max_length"
        code, detail = "SOURCE_STRING_LENGTH", ""
    elif keyword == "pattern":
        invalid = "!" * max(1, schema.get("minLength", 0))
        atom, code, detail = "schema.instance.pattern", "SOURCE_STRING_PATTERN", ""
    else:
        require(keyword == "additionalProperties" and type(valid) is dict, "SCHEMA_INSTANCE_KEYWORD")
        invalid["ORACLE_UNKNOWN"] = 7
        require("ORACLE_UNKNOWN" not in schema.get("properties", {}), "SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_KEY_FRESH")
        location += "/additionalProperties"
        atom, code, detail = "schema.instance.allowed", "SOURCE_FORBIDDEN_FIELD", "/ORACLE_UNKNOWN"
    operand = invalid[1] if keyword == "uniqueItems" else invalid["ORACLE_UNKNOWN"] if keyword == "additionalProperties" else invalid
    phase_input = {"phase": "validate", "schema": document, "schemaLocation": "#" + path, "value": invalid}
    environment = {"schemaLocation": location, "operand": operand, "diagnostic": code, "payload": detail}
    case_id = "schema.instance." + filename + "." + path.replace("/", "_") + "." + keyword + "." + parameter.get("member", parameter["variant"])
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "schema_guard", "path": atom, "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(phase_input)), "environment": environment, "before": False, "after": True}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "D", "schemaFile": filename, "schemaLocation": "#" + path, "invalidValue": invalid, "validValue": valid, "fault": fault,
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": atom, "code": code, "detail": detail},
        "faultExpected": {"kind": "boundary", "record": {"phase": "schema.domain", "atom": atom, "environment": environment, "rejectionSuppressed": True, "nextForbiddenOperation": "consume-invalid-schema-domain"}},
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "schemaSha256": INPUT_HASHES[filename], "parameter": parameter},
    }

def materialize_schema_union(filename, document, path, branch_index):
    schema = locate(document, path)
    branches = schema["oneOf"]
    valid = literal_schema_witness(document, branches[branch_index if branch_index is not None else 0])
    if branch_index is None:
        invalid, changed, schema_edit, matches = {}, document, None, []
        atom, code = "schema.union.nonempty", "SOURCE_ONEOF_NONE:#" + path
    else:
        invalid = copy.deepcopy(valid)
        schema_edit = {"path": path + "/oneOf", "before": branches, "after": branches + [copy.deepcopy(branches[branch_index])]}
        changed, count = patch_value(document, schema_edit)
        require(count == 1, "SCHEMA_UNION_PROGRAM_EDIT")
        matches = [branch_index, len(branches)]
        atom, code = "schema.union.unique", "SOURCE_ONEOF_MULTIPLE:#" + path
    detail = {"pointer": "", "matches": matches}
    environment = {"schemaLocation": "#" + path, "operand": invalid, "diagnostic": code, "payload": detail}
    phase_input = {"phase": "validate", "schema": changed, "schemaLocation": "#" + path, "value": invalid}
    case_id = "schema.union." + filename + "." + path.replace("/", "_") + "." + ("none" if branch_index is None else "duplicate." + str(branch_index))
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "schema_guard", "path": atom, "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(phase_input)), "environment": environment, "before": False, "after": True}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "D", "schemaFile": filename, "schemaLocation": "#" + path, "schemaEdit": schema_edit, "invalidValue": invalid, "validValue": valid, "fault": fault,
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": atom, "code": code, "detail": detail},
        "faultExpected": {"kind": "boundary", "record": {"phase": "schema.domain", "atom": atom, "environment": environment, "rejectionSuppressed": True, "nextForbiddenOperation": "consume-invalid-schema-domain"}},
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "schemaSha256": INPUT_HASHES[filename], "path": path, "branchIndex": branch_index, "multipleIsProgramSubject": branch_index is not None},
    }


def run_schema_union(case, schemas):
    original = schemas[case["schemaFile"]]
    changed = patch_value(original, case["schemaEdit"])[0] if case["schemaEdit"] is not None else original
    observations = []
    for mode in ("valid", "intact", "neutralized", "restored", "substituted"):
        valid_mode = mode in ("valid", "substituted")
        phase_input = {"phase": "validate", "schema": original if valid_mode else changed, "schemaLocation": case["schemaLocation"], "value": case["validValue"] if valid_mode else case["invalidValue"]}
        fault = case["fault"] if mode == "neutralized" else None
        expected = {"kind": "admission", "accepted": True} if valid_mode else case["faultExpected"] if mode == "neutralized" else case["intactExpected"]
        observation = capture_schema_phase(phase_input, fault)
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], expected)
        exact_record(observation["edits"], [fault] if fault is not None else [], "SCHEMA_UNION_EXACT_HIT")
        observations.append({"mode": mode, **observation})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def materialize_reference_effect(seed, operation, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture_id, query_index, raw = seed["fixtureId"], seed["queryIndex"], seed["rawLiteralRow"]
    golden = goldens[fixture_id]
    old = literal_reference_envelope(raw)
    matching_rows(golden["references"], old)
    case_id = "reference.effect." + str(query_index) + "." + operation
    if operation in ("omit", "duplicate"):
        hook_operation = "query_row_batch"
        path = "/typedAst/references/" + str(query_index) + "/select"
        environment, before = {"queryId": "reference:" + str(query_index)}, [raw]
        after = [] if operation == "omit" else [raw, raw]
        replacements = [] if operation == "omit" else [old, old]
    else:
        hook_operation, path, environment, before = "reference_output", "/typedAst/referenceEnvelope", raw, old
        after = copy.deepcopy(old)
        if operation == "retain_source_projection":
            after["sourceProjectionId"] = raw["sourceProjectionId"]
        elif operation == "undo_kind_label":
            require(old["referenceKind"] != raw["kind"], "REFERENCE_KIND_LABEL_NONTRIVIAL")
            after["referenceKind"] = raw["kind"]
        elif operation.startswith("drop/"):
            field = operation[5:]
            require(field in old, "REFERENCE_DROP_PRESENT")
            after = {key: value for key, value in after.items() if key != field}
        elif operation.startswith("undo_rename/"):
            field = operation[12:]
            rename = {"kind": "referenceKind", "requirementState": "requiredState", "targetNodeKey": "targetKey"}
            require(field in raw and field in rename, "REFERENCE_RENAME_DOMAIN")
            after = {key: value for key, value in after.items() if key != rename[field]}
            after[field] = raw[field]
        else:
            require(operation.startswith("field/"), "REFERENCE_EFFECT_OPERATION")
            field = operation[6:]
            require(field in old and type(old[field]) in (str, int), "REFERENCE_FIELD_DOMAIN")
            after[field] = old[field] + 1 if type(old[field]) is int else "oracle_reference_" + str(query_index) + "_" + field
        replacements = [after]
    expected = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    expected["references"] = sorted([copy.deepcopy(row) for row in golden["references"] if not typed_equal(row, old)] + copy.deepcopy(replacements), key=literal_canonical_bytes)
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": hook_operation, "path": path, "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(fixtures[fixture_id])), "environment": environment, "before": before, "after": after}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": fixture_id, "fault": fault, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "expectedReplacements": replacements, "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected)), "expectedDelta": literal_difference(expected, golden),
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "queryIndex": query_index, "rawRow": raw, "literalRow": old, "querySource": mapping["typedAst"]["references"][query_index]},
    }


def run_reference_effect(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    golden = goldens[case["fixtureId"]]
    expected = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    expected["references"] = sorted([copy.deepcopy(row) for row in golden["references"] if not typed_equal(row, case["authority"]["literalRow"])] + copy.deepcopy(case["expectedReplacements"]), key=literal_canonical_bytes)
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(expected)), case["expectedGraphSha256"], "REFERENCE_EFFECT_GRAPH_BINDING")
    exact_record(literal_difference(expected, golden), case["expectedDelta"], "REFERENCE_EFFECT_DELTA_BINDING")
    observations = []
    for index in range(3):
        observation = capture_construction(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, [])
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected if index == 1 else golden})
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if index == 1 else 0)
        observations.append({"outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"]})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


GRAPH_ORDER_FIELDS = {
    "nodes": ("slice", "sourcePointer", "nodeType", "nodeKey", "id"),
    "edges": ("parentSlice", "parentNodeId", "edgeKind", "canonicalOrdinal", "childSlice", "childNodeId"),
    "identityMappings": ("semantic_node_id",),
    "evidence": ("slice", "nodeId", "purpose", "canonicalOrdinal", "evidenceKey"),
    "externalDependencies": ("sourceNodeId",),
}


def literal_graph_order_key(collection, row):
    if collection == "references":
        return list(literal_canonical_bytes(row))
    return [row[field] for field in GRAPH_ORDER_FIELDS[collection]]


def materialize_graph_order_case(collection, coordinate, direction, fixtures, goldens):
    require(direction in ("first", "last"), "GRAPH_ORDER_DIRECTION")
    candidates = []
    for fixture_id, golden in goldens.items():
        rows = golden[collection]
        if collection == "references":
            groups = {"all": rows}
        else:
            groups = {}
            for row in rows:
                prefix = tuple(literal_graph_order_key(collection, row)[:coordinate])
                groups.setdefault(prefix, []).append(row)
        for rows in groups.values():
            if len(rows) > 1:
                candidates.append((fixture_id, rows))
    if candidates:
        fixture_id, group = candidates[0]
        row = copy.deepcopy(group[-1] if direction == "first" else group[0])
        before = literal_graph_order_key(collection, row)
        if collection == "references":
            after = [] if direction == "first" else [256]
        else:
            after = copy.deepcopy(before)
            values = [literal_graph_order_key(collection, item)[coordinate] for item in group]
            after[coordinate] = (-1 if direction == "first" else max(values) + 1) if type(before[coordinate]) is int else ("" if direction == "first" else "\uffff")
        phase_input, tier = fixtures[fixture_id], "S"
        input_rows = None
        baseline = copy.deepcopy(goldens[fixture_id])
        changed = copy.deepcopy(baseline)
        permutation = sorted(range(len(baseline[collection])), key=lambda index: after if typed_equal(baseline[collection][index], row) else literal_graph_order_key(collection, baseline[collection][index]))
        changed[collection] = [copy.deepcopy(baseline[collection][index]) for index in permutation]
        require(not typed_equal(baseline, changed), "GRAPH_ORDER_SEMANTIC_EFFECT")
    else:
        fixture_id = next(fid for fid, graph in goldens.items() if graph[collection])
        source = copy.deepcopy(goldens[fixture_id][collection][0])
        require(collection != "references", "GRAPH_ORDER_REFERENCE_MICRO_UNNEEDED")
        field = GRAPH_ORDER_FIELDS[collection][coordinate]
        low, high = copy.deepcopy(source), copy.deepcopy(source)
        low[field], high[field] = (0, 1) if type(source[field]) is int else ("oracle_a", "oracle_b")
        input_rows = [high, low]
        row = copy.deepcopy(high if direction == "first" else low)
        before = literal_graph_order_key(collection, row)
        after = copy.deepcopy(before)
        after[coordinate] = (-1 if direction == "first" else 2) if type(source[field]) is int else ("" if direction == "first" else "\uffff")
        baseline, changed = [low, high], [high, low]
        phase_input, tier = {"fixtureId": fixture_id, "collection": collection, "rows": input_rows}, "D"
        permutation = None
    case_id = "graph.order." + collection + "." + str(coordinate) + "." + direction
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "sort_key", "path": "/graph/" + collection + "/order", "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(phase_input)), "environment": {"collection": collection, "row": row}, "before": before, "after": after}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "F", "tier": tier, "fixtureId": fixture_id, "collection": collection, "fault": fault, "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0],
        "inputRows": input_rows, "baselinePhaseRows": baseline if tier == "D" else None, "faultPhaseRows": changed if tier == "D" else None,
        "faultPermutation": permutation,
        "expectedDelta": literal_difference(changed, baseline) if tier == "D" else None,
        "expectedDeltaCount": len(literal_difference(changed, baseline)), "expectedDeltaSha256": sha256(json_bytes(literal_difference(changed, baseline))), "expectedChangedSha256": sha256(json_bytes(changed)),
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "coordinate": coordinate, "literalCompanionFixture": fixture_id, "phaseDomain": "final graph ordering" if tier == "S" else "two literal rows with neutral earlier sort coordinates; not a retained graph"},
    }


def run_graph_order_case(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    observations = []
    for index in range(3):
        if case["tier"] == "S":
            expected = copy.deepcopy(goldens[case["fixtureId"]])
            if index == 1:
                original_rows = goldens[case["fixtureId"]][case["collection"]]
                exact_record(sorted(case["faultPermutation"]), list(range(len(original_rows))), "GRAPH_ORDER_PERMUTATION_BIJECTION")
                expected[case["collection"]] = [copy.deepcopy(original_rows[i]) for i in case["faultPermutation"]]
            observation = capture_construction(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, [])
            admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected})
        else:
            phase_input = {"fixtureId": case["fixtureId"], "collection": case["collection"], "rows": case["inputRows"]}
            subject = kernel.SemanticKernel(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema)
            subject.hooks = kernel.OracleHooks(phase_input, {"fault": case["fault"] if index == 1 else None, "conditions": []})
            actual = sorted(copy.deepcopy(case["inputRows"]), key=lambda row: subject.sort_key(case["collection"], row))
            expected = case["faultPhaseRows"] if index == 1 else case["baselinePhaseRows"]
            observation = {"outcome": {"kind": "value", "value": actual}, "edits": subject.hooks.edits}
            admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], {"kind": "value", "value": expected})
        if index == 1:
            exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(expected)), case["expectedChangedSha256"], "GRAPH_ORDER_EXPECTED_BINDING")
            baseline = goldens[case["fixtureId"]] if case["tier"] == "S" else case["baselinePhaseRows"]
            delta = literal_difference(expected, baseline)
            exact_record(len(delta), case["expectedDeltaCount"], "GRAPH_ORDER_DELTA_COUNT")
            exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(delta)), case["expectedDeltaSha256"], "GRAPH_ORDER_DELTA_BINDING")
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if index == 1 else 0)
        observations.append({"outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"]})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def materialize_comparison_case(case_id, subject, actual_json, expected_json, literal_verdict_json, target_index):
    require(subject in ("kernel", "literal"), "COMPARISON_SUBJECT")
    actual, expected, verdict = strict_json(actual_json), strict_json(expected_json), strict_json(literal_verdict_json)
    require(type(verdict) is list and type(target_index) is int and 0 <= target_index < len(verdict), "COMPARISON_TARGET_INDEX")
    target = verdict[target_index]
    paths = {"TYPE_MISMATCH": "comparison.type", "MISSING_ACTUAL": "comparison.missing", "UNEXPECTED_ACTUAL": "comparison.unexpected", "ARRAY_LENGTH_MISMATCH": "comparison.length", "VALUE_MISMATCH": "comparison.value"}
    path = paths[target["code"]] if subject == "kernel" else "literal." + target["code"]
    phase_input = {"actual": actual, "expected": expected}
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "comparison_record", "path": path, "inputSha256": sha256(json_bytes(phase_input)), "environment": phase_input, "before": target, "after": None}
    survivors = [copy.deepcopy(item) for index, item in enumerate(verdict) if index != target_index]
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "C", "tier": "S", "subject": subject,
        "actualJson": actual_json, "expectedJson": expected_json, "baselineVerdictJson": literal_verdict_json,
        "faultJson": json_bytes(fault).decode("utf-8"), "faultVerdictJson": json_bytes(survivors).decode("utf-8"),
        "expectedHits": [0, 1, 0], "baselineAccepted": False, "faultAccepted": not survivors,
        "expectedSurvivingPaths": [item["path"] for item in survivors],
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "targetIndex": target_index, "expectedVerdicts": "independently authored literal protocol; not generated by either comparator"},
    }


def capture_comparison(subject, actual, expected, fault=None):
    plan = {"fault": fault, "conditions": []}
    if subject == "kernel":
        return kernel.compare_graph(actual, expected, hook_plan=plan)
    require(subject == "literal", "COMPARISON_SUBJECT")
    hooks = kernel.OracleHooks({"actual": actual, "expected": expected}, plan)
    differences = literal_difference(actual, expected, hooks=hooks)
    return {"differences": differences, "edits": hooks.edits}


def run_comparison_case(case):
    actual, expected = strict_json(case["actualJson"]), strict_json(case["expectedJson"])
    baseline_verdict, changed_verdict, fault = strict_json(case["baselineVerdictJson"]), strict_json(case["faultVerdictJson"]), strict_json(case["faultJson"])
    observations = []
    for mode in ("baseline", "fault", "restored", "valid", "valid_wrong_input"):
        positive = mode in ("valid", "valid_wrong_input")
        bound_fault = fault if mode in ("fault", "valid_wrong_input") else None
        observation = capture_comparison(case["subject"], expected if positive else actual, expected, bound_fault)
        wanted = [] if positive else changed_verdict if mode == "fault" else baseline_verdict
        exact_record(observation["differences"], wanted, "COMPARISON_LITERAL_VERDICT")
        exact_record(observation["edits"], [fault] if mode == "fault" else [], "COMPARISON_EXACT_HIT")
        accepted = not observation["differences"]
        exact_record(accepted, True if positive else case["faultAccepted"] if mode == "fault" else case["baselineAccepted"], "COMPARISON_LITERAL_ACCEPTANCE")
        observations.append({"mode": mode, "accepted": accepted, **observation})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations}


def literal_root_roles(graph, mapping, controlling_override=None):
    output = copy.deepcopy(graph)
    incoming = {edge["childNodeId"] for edge in output["edges"] if edge["propagatesGate"]}
    policies = {(rule["slice"], rule["nodeType"]): rule["rootPolicy"] for rule in mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]}
    controlling = [node["id"] for node in output["nodes"] if policies[(node["slice"], node["nodeType"])] == "controlling"]
    reachable = set(controlling if controlling_override is None else controlling_override)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        before = set(reachable)
        for edge in output["edges"]:
            if edge["propagatesGate"] and edge["parentNodeId"] in reachable:
                reachable.add(edge["childNodeId"])
        for node in output["nodes"]:
            if node["parentNodeId"] in reachable:
                reachable.add(node["id"])
        changed = before != reachable
    for node in output["nodes"]:
        policy = policies[(node["slice"], node["nodeType"])]
        if policy == "controlling":
            role = "controlling_root"
        elif policy == "noncontrolling" or (policy == "unreferenced_noncontrolling" and node["id"] not in incoming):
            role = "noncontrolling_root"
        else:
            role = "reachable" if node["id"] in reachable else "noncontrolling_reachable"
        node["rootRole"] = role
    return output


def materialize_root_case(fixture_id, operation, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture, golden = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id]
    case_id = "root." + fixture_id + "." + operation
    conditions = []
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    environment = {"fixtureId": fixture_id}
    if operation == "controlling_empty":
        # Insertion order is fixed by node-family order and then the retained
        # source rows, not by the graph's separately canonical node ordering.
        before = []
        for rule in mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]:
            if rule["rootPolicy"] == "controlling":
                before.extend(row["id"] for row in fixture["context"]["semanticNodes"] if row["slice"] == rule["slice"] and row["nodeType"] == rule["nodeType"])
        require(bool(before), "ROOT_LITERAL_CONTROLLING_COMPANION")
        path, after = "/graph/controllingRoots", []
        atom, expected = "aggregate.controlling_roots", literal_root_roles(golden, mapping, [])
    elif operation == "selected_empty":
        path, before, after = "/typedAst/aggregate/rootRole", mapping["typedAst"]["aggregate"]["rootRole"], "oracle_missing_root_role"
        atom, expected = "aggregate.selected_roots", copy.deepcopy(golden)
        expected["aggregateReadiness"] = "candidate_only"
    else:
        require(operation == "minimum", "ROOT_OPERATION")
        path, before, after = "/typedAst/aggregate/operator", mapping["typedAst"]["aggregate"]["operator"], "minimum"
        expected = copy.deepcopy(golden)
        values = [node["effectiveGate"] for node in golden["nodes"] if node["rootRole"] == "controlling_root"]
        expected["aggregateReadiness"] = "candidate_only" if "candidate_only" in values else "human_determination_required"
        atom = None
    if atom is not None:
        conditions.append({"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "AGGREGATE_NO_CONTROLLING_ROOT", "detail": fixture_id})
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "value", "path": path, "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": environment, "before": before, "after": after}
    delta = literal_difference(expected, golden)
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G" if atom is not None else "F", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": fixture_id, "fault": fault, "conditions": conditions,
        "expectedRootRoles": {node["id"]: node["rootRole"] for node in expected["nodes"]}, "expectedAggregate": expected["aggregateReadiness"],
        "expectedDelta": delta, "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected)), "outputEffect": bool(delta),
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": atom, "code": "AGGREGATE_NO_CONTROLLING_ROOT", "detail": fixture_id} if atom is not None else None,
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "existingFallbackOnly": True, "operation": operation, "unchangedFOutputIsNotAKill": True},
    }


def run_root_case(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
    golden = goldens[case["fixtureId"]]
    expected = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    for node in expected["nodes"]:
        node["rootRole"] = case["expectedRootRoles"][node["id"]]
    expected["aggregateReadiness"] = case["expectedAggregate"]
    exact_record(sha256(json_bytes(expected)), case["expectedGraphSha256"], "ROOT_EXPECTED_BINDING")
    exact_record(literal_difference(expected, golden), case["expectedDelta"], "ROOT_DELTA_BINDING")
    observations = []
    for mode in ("baseline", "corruption", "conditioned", "restored_guard", "restored_fault"):
        active = mode in ("corruption", "conditioned", "restored_guard")
        observation = capture_construction(fixtures[case["fixtureId"]], mapping, source_schema, case["fault"] if active else None, case["conditions"] if mode == "conditioned" else [])
        want_diagnostic = case["contract"] == "G" and mode in ("corruption", "restored_guard")
        wanted = case["intactExpected"] if want_diagnostic else {"kind": "graph", "graph": expected if active else golden}
        admit_outcome(observation["outcome"], wanted)
        admit_selection_edit_transcript(observation["edits"], case, 1 if active else 0)
        observations.append({"mode": mode, "outcomeSha256": sha256(json_bytes(observation["outcome"])), "edits": observation["edits"], "conditionHits": observation["conditionHits"]})
    return {"id": case["id"], "runs": observations, "outputEffect": case["outputEffect"]}


def materialize_cycle_case(fixture_id, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    fixture, golden = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id]
    rule = mapping["typedAst"]["edges"][14]
    exact_record(rule["id"], "E15", "CYCLE_RULE_BINDING")
    rows = [edge for edge in golden["edges"] if edge["ruleId"] == "E15"]
    require(bool(rows), "CYCLE_PRESENT_COMPANION")
    old = rows[0]
    require(old["parentNodeId"] != old["childNodeId"], "CYCLE_DISTINCT_LITERAL_ENDPOINTS")
    raw = {field: old[field] for field in rule["queries"][0]["select"]}
    changed = copy.deepcopy(raw)
    changed["childNodeId"] = old["parentNodeId"]
    case_id = "cycle:self:" + fixture_id
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "query_row", "path": "/typedAst/edges/14/queries/0/select", "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"queryId": "E15:0"}, "before": raw, "after": changed}
    expected = literal_replace_row(golden, "edges", old, {**old, "childNodeId": old["parentNodeId"]})
    expected["edges"].sort(key=lambda edge: tuple(edge[field] for field in GRAPH_ORDER_FIELDS["edges"]))
    expected = literal_readiness(literal_root_roles(expected, mapping))
    condition = {"atom": "gate.acyclic", "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "GATE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE", "detail": old["parentNodeId"]}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "S", "fixtureId": fixture_id, "fault": fault, "conditions": [condition],
        "expectedGraph": expected, "expectedDelta": literal_difference(expected, golden),
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": "gate.acyclic", "code": "GATE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE", "detail": old["parentNodeId"]},
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "existingFallbackOnly": True, "rule": "E15", "cycle": [old["parentNodeId"], old["parentNodeId"]], "allReferentsPresent": True},
    }


def run_cycle_case(case, fixtures, mapping, source_schema, goldens):
