def materialize_node_guard(family_index, coordinate, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    rid, pointer, _, _, _, _, _ = SELECTION_FAMILIES[family_index]
    rule = mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"][family_index]
    fixture_id = "external-outgoing-resolved" if rid == "A15" else ("3a-main" if rid.startswith("A") else "slice3b-complete-candidate")
    fixture, golden = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id]
    node = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["semanticNodes"], {"slice": rule["slice"], "nodeType": rule["nodeType"], "sourcePointer": pointer})[0]
    owner = matching_rows(fixture["context"]["typedOwners"], {"table": rule["ownerTable"], "semantic_node_id": node["id"]})[0]
    variants = {
        "canonicalNodeHash": ("node.value.hash", "NODE_VALUE_HASH_MISMATCH", "oracle_bad_value_hash"),
        "identityHash": ("node.identity.hash", "NODE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH", "oracle_bad_identity_hash"),
        "parentNodeId": ("node.parent", "NODE_PARENT_MISMATCH", "oracle_missing_parent"),
        "canonicalOrdinal": ("node.ordinal.nonnegative", "AST_ORDINAL_TYPE_MISMATCH", -1),
    }
    require(coordinate in variants, "NODE_GUARD_COORDINATE")
    atom, code, new_value = variants[coordinate]
    case_id = "node.guard." + rid + "." + coordinate
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    original = {"node": copy.deepcopy(node), "owner": copy.deepcopy(owner)}
    changed = copy.deepcopy(original)
    changed["node"][coordinate] = new_value
    if coordinate == "canonicalOrdinal":
        original_ordinal = matching_rows(golden["nodes"], {"id": node["id"]})[0]["canonicalOrdinal"]
        fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "value", "path": "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(family_index) + "/ordinal", "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"n": node, "o": owner}, "before": original_ordinal, "after": new_value}
    else:
        fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "query_row", "path": "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(family_index) + "/query/select", "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"queryId": rid}, "before": original, "after": changed}
    expected = copy.deepcopy(golden)
    target = matching_rows(expected["nodes"], {"id": node["id"]})[0]
    target[coordinate] = new_value
    if coordinate == "parentNodeId":
        require(all(row["id"] != new_value for row in expected["nodes"]), "NODE_GUARD_ABSENT_PARENT")
        expected = literal_root_roles(expected, mapping)
    detail = rid if coordinate == "canonicalOrdinal" else node["id"]
    condition = {"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": code, "detail": detail}
    return {
        "id": case_id, "fixtureId": fixture_id, "contract": "G", "tier": "S", "coordinate": coordinate, "nodeId": node["id"], "newValue": new_value,
        "fault": fault, "conditions": [condition], "expectedRootRoles": {row["id"]: row["rootRole"] for row in expected["nodes"]},
        "expectedGraphSha256": sha256(json_bytes(expected)), "expectedDelta": literal_difference(expected, golden),
        "intactExpected": {"kind": "diagnostic", "checkId": atom, "code": code, "detail": detail},
        "authority": {"designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256, "ruleId": rid, "sourcePointer": pointer, "programCorruptionBeforeNamedGuard": True},
    }

    observations = []

def literal_program_value(expression, environment, binding):
    op = expression["op"]
    if op == "literal":
        return copy.deepcopy(expression["value"])
    if op == "param":
        return copy.deepcopy(binding[expression["name"]])
    if op == "row":
        return copy.deepcopy(environment[expression["alias"]])
    if op == "field":
        return copy.deepcopy(environment[expression["alias"]][expression["name"]])
    require(op in ("add", "concat"), "LITERAL_PROGRAM_VALUE_OPERATION", op)
    values = [literal_program_value(value, environment, binding) for value in expression["args"]]
    required_type = int if op == "add" else str
    require(all(type(value) is required_type for value in values), "LITERAL_PROGRAM_VALUE_TYPES", op)
    return sum(values) if op == "add" else "".join(values)


def literal_program_predicate(predicate, environment, binding):
    op = predicate["op"]
    if op in ("true", "false"):
        return op == "true"
    if op == "and":
        for term in predicate["terms"]:
            if not literal_program_predicate(term, environment, binding):
                return False
        return True
    if op == "or":
        for term in predicate["terms"]:
            if literal_program_predicate(term, environment, binding):
                return True
        return False
    if op == "not":
        return not literal_program_predicate(predicate["term"], environment, binding)
    if op == "eq":
        return typed_equal(literal_program_value(predicate["left"], environment, binding), literal_program_value(predicate["right"], environment, binding))
    value = literal_program_value(predicate["value"], environment, binding)
    if op == "in":
        return any(typed_equal(value, alternative) for alternative in predicate["values"])
    if op == "is_null":
        return value is None
    require(op in ("starts_with", "ends_with", "contains") and type(value) is str, "LITERAL_PROGRAM_PREDICATE_DOMAIN", op)
    if op == "starts_with":
        return value[:len(predicate["text"])] == predicate["text"]
    if op == "ends_with":
        return predicate["text"] == "" or value[-len(predicate["text"]):] == predicate["text"]
    return predicate["text"] in value


def literal_query_frames(fixture, query):
    """Expand frozen literal relations by nested products, never subject queries."""
    context, binding = fixture["context"], fixture["context"]["binding"]
    tables = {"nodes": list(context["semanticNodes"]), "owners": list(context["typedOwners"]), "relations": list(context["relations"]), "externalDependencies": list(context["externalDependencies"]), "externalMetadata": list(context["externalMetadata"])}
    for bag in context.get("unboundProjectionContexts", []):
        for table, source in (("nodes", "semanticNodes"), ("owners", "typedOwners"), ("relations", "relations")):
            tables[table].extend(bag.get(source, []))
    scan = query["from"]
    frames = []
    for row in tables[scan["table"]]:
        environment = {scan["as"]: row}
        if literal_program_predicate(scan["where"], environment, binding):
            frames.append(environment)
    for join in query["joins"]:
        right_rows = [row for row in tables[join["table"]] if literal_program_predicate(join["where"], {join["as"]: row}, binding)]
        expanded = []
        for frame in frames:
            require(join["as"] not in frame, "LITERAL_QUERY_ALIAS_REBOUND")
            left_key = literal_canonical_bytes(literal_program_value(join["on"]["left"], frame, binding))
            for row in right_rows:
                if left_key == literal_canonical_bytes(row[join["on"]["right"]]):
                    expanded.append({**frame, join["as"]: row})
        frames = expanded
    return [{"environment": copy.deepcopy(frame), "row": {name: literal_program_value(expression, frame, binding) for name, expression in query["select"].items()}} for frame in frames if literal_program_predicate(query["where"], frame, binding)]


def literal_edge_effect(golden, mapping, old_edge, new_edges, input_hash):
    """Closed O4 edge edit and declared dependent cardinality/identity atoms."""
    graph, conditions = copy.deepcopy(golden), []
    old_edges = old_edge if type(old_edge) is list else [old_edge]
    require(bool(old_edges), "EDGE_LITERAL_PREIMAGE_NONEMPTY")
    positions = []
    for edge in old_edges:
        matches = [index for index, row in enumerate(graph["edges"]) if typed_equal(row, edge)]
        require(len(matches) == 1, "EDGE_LITERAL_PREIMAGE_UNIQUE")
        positions.extend(matches)
    require(len(positions) == len(set(positions)), "EDGE_LITERAL_PREIMAGE_DISTINCT")
    first = min(positions)
    graph["edges"] = [row for index, row in enumerate(graph["edges"]) if index not in positions]
    graph["edges"][first:first] = copy.deepcopy(new_edges)
    old_edge = old_edges[0]
    require(all(edge["ruleId"] == old_edge["ruleId"] for edge in old_edges), "EDGE_LITERAL_SINGLE_RULE_DOMAIN")
    rule = matching_rows(mapping["typedAst"]["edges"], {"id": old_edge["ruleId"]})[0]
    rule_by_node = {(item["slice"], item["nodeType"]): item["id"] for item in mapping["typedAst"]["nodes"]}
    node_ids = {node["id"] for node in graph["nodes"]}
    require(all(row["parentNodeId"] in node_ids and row["childNodeId"] in node_ids for row in graph["edges"]), "EDGE_LITERAL_REFERENTS_PRESENT")
    for parent in graph["nodes"]:
        if rule_by_node[(parent["slice"], parent["nodeType"])] not in rule["parentRules"]:
            continue
        count = sum(row["ruleId"] == rule["id"] and row["parentNodeId"] == parent["id"] for row in graph["edges"])
        detail = {"parent": parent["id"], "actual": count, "bounds": rule["cardinality"]}
        for atom, holds in (("edge.cardinality.lower", count >= rule["cardinality"]["min"]), ("edge.cardinality.upper", rule["cardinality"]["max"] is None or count <= rule["cardinality"]["max"])):
            if not holds:
                conditions.append({"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], "detail": detail})
    remaining = []
    for selector in mapping["typedAst"]["identitySelectors"]:
        if selector["edgeRule"] != rule["id"]:
            continue
        selected = sorted({edge["childNodeId"] for edge in golden["edges"] if edge["ruleId"] == rule["id"]})
        expected = sorted({edge["childNodeId"] for edge in graph["edges"] if edge["ruleId"] == rule["id"]})
        for atom, domain, other in (("identity.members.missing", expected, selected), ("identity.members.extra", selected, expected)):
            for member in domain:
                if member not in other:
                    conditions.append({"atom": atom, "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], "detail": {"selected": selected, "expected": expected, "member": member}})
        for identity in list(graph["identityMappings"]):
            if identity["selectorId"] != selector["id"]:
                continue
            node_id = identity["semantic_node_id"]
            consumers = [edge for edge in graph["edges"] if edge["ruleId"] == rule["id"] and edge["childNodeId"] == node_id]
            # Baseline has exactly one consumer. Edits at that row retain its
            # producer position; distinct-row/exact duplicates immediately follow.
            if len(consumers) != 1:
                conditions.append({"atom": "identity.consumer.count", "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "IDENTITY_CONSUMPTION_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], "detail": {"row": {"mappingNodeId": node_id, "sourceNodeId": identity["source_occurrence_node_id"]}, "consumers": consumers}})
            if not consumers:
                graph["identityMappings"].remove(identity)
                remaining.append(node_id)
            else:
                identity["consumer"] = {field: consumers[0][field] for field in ("ruleId", "parentSlice", "parentNodeId", "canonicalOrdinal", "childSlice", "childNodeId")}
    if remaining:
        conditions.append({"atom": "identity.remaining", "inputSha256": input_hash, "code": "IDENTITY_UNCONSUMED", "detail": sorted(remaining)})
    graph["edges"].sort(key=lambda row: tuple(row[field] for field in GRAPH_ORDER_FIELDS["edges"]))
    graph["identityMappings"].sort(key=lambda row: row["semantic_node_id"])
    return literal_readiness(literal_root_roles(graph, mapping)), conditions


def materialize_edge_effect(rule_index, query_index, operation, fixtures, mapping, goldens):
    rule = mapping["typedAst"]["edges"][rule_index]
    query = rule["queries"][query_index]
    witness = None
    for fixture_id, fixture in fixtures.items():
        frames = literal_query_frames(fixture, query)
        if frames:
            witness = (fixture_id, frames[0])
            break

    fixture_id, frame = witness
    fixture, golden, raw = fixtures[fixture_id], goldens[fixture_id], frame["row"]

    matching_rows(golden["edges"], old_edge)
    require(operation in ("omit", "distinct_many", "exact_duplicate"), "EDGE_EFFECT_OPERATION")
    new_raw = copy.deepcopy(raw)
    if operation == "omit":
        batch = []
    elif operation == "exact_duplicate":
        batch = [raw, raw]
    else:
        new_raw["canonicalOrdinal"] = 1 + max(row["canonicalOrdinal"] for row in golden["edges"])

    new_edges = [{"ruleId": rule["id"], "edgeKind": rule["kind"], "propagatesGate": rule["propagates"], **row} for row in batch]
    input_hash = sha256(json_bytes(fixture))
    expected, conditions = literal_edge_effect(golden, mapping, old_edge, new_edges, input_hash)
    case_id = "edge.effect." + rule["id"] + "." + str(query_index) + "." + operation
    fault = {"id": case_id, "operation": "query_row_batch", "path": "/typedAst/edges/" + str(rule_index) + "/queries/" + str(query_index) + "/select", "inputSha256": input_hash, "environment": {"queryId": rule["id"] + ":" + str(query_index)}, "before": [raw], "after": batch}
