"""Pure provider-independent Slice 4B semantic graph construction.

The module performs no file, database, process, network, credential, or cloud
I/O.  Callers supply already parsed frozen mapping, source-schema, and fixture
objects.  The mapping's executable ``typedAst`` is interpreted directly; the
historical independent interpreter and reference executor are not imported.
"""

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import re


VERSION = "paprnav-s4b-local-semantic-kernel-4"
IMPORT_ALLOWLIST = ("copy", "hashlib", "json", "re")
CANDIDATE_ONLY = "candidate_only"
HUMAN_REQUIRED = "human_determination_required"
READINESS_RANK = {CANDIDATE_ONLY: 0, HUMAN_REQUIRED: 1}
# Check IDs identify individual assertions, never a family of assertions.
# The harness inventories their call sites and binds every ID to a negative.
DETECTORS = frozenset({
    "selection.node_scope", "selection.owner_scope", "selection.node_type",
    "selection.typed_owner", "selection.unique_node", "selection.complete_set",
    "node.value_hash", "node.identity", "node.parent",
    "evidence.keys_required", "evidence.binding_count", "evidence.fragment",
    "evidence.owner", "evidence.purpose", "evidence.link_count", "evidence.set",
    "identity.selected_set", "identity.source_owner", "identity.unique_consumer",
    "identity.consumer_count", "identity.complete_set", "reference.tuple",
    "external.selected_set", "gate.acyclic", "aggregate.controlling_roots",
    "aggregate.selected_roots",
    "node.ordinal", "node.occurrence", "edge.target", "edge.ordinal", "edge.unique", "edge.cardinality",
})
SOURCE_FIELDS = (
    "slice projectionId proposalId id identityHash nodeType nodeKey "
    "sourcePointer parentNodeId canonicalOrdinal canonicalNodeHash createdAt"
).split()
SCHEMA_ASSERTIONS = frozenset({
    "$ref", "type", "required", "properties", "patternProperties",
    "additionalProperties", "minProperties", "const", "enum", "oneOf",
    "items", "minItems", "uniqueItems", "minLength", "maxLength", "pattern",
})
SCHEMA_ANNOTATIONS = frozenset({
    "$schema", "$id", "title", "description", "$comment",
    "x-paprnav-array-kind", "x-paprnav-sort-key",
})
SCHEMA_CONTAINERS = frozenset({"$defs"})
SCHEMA_KEYWORDS = SCHEMA_ASSERTIONS | SCHEMA_ANNOTATIONS | SCHEMA_CONTAINERS
JSON_TYPES = frozenset({"object", "array", "string", "boolean", "integer", "number", "null"})
ATOMIC_CHECKS = frozenset({
    "selection.node.projection", "selection.node.proposal", "selection.owner.projection",
    "selection.owner.proposal", "selection.node.type", "selection.node.slice",
    "selection.owner.table", "selection.owner.self_id", "selection.unique",
    "selection.members.missing", "selection.members.extra", "selection.owner_count",
    "node.identity.hash", "node.identity.id", "edge.cardinality.lower", "edge.cardinality.upper",
    "identity.remaining", "external.members.missing", "external.members.extra", "evidence.binding.count",
    "reference.source.present", "reference.target.present", "reference.source.slice",
    "reference.source.projection", "reference.target.slice", "reference.target.projection",
    "reference.target.type", "reference.target.key",
    "edge.parent.present", "edge.child.present", "edge.parent.slice", "edge.child.slice",
    "edge.child.rule",
    "case.nonempty", "case.unique", "evidence.policy.present",
    "evidence.keys.required", "evidence.fragment.id", "evidence.fragment.hash",
    "evidence.owner.projection", "evidence.owner.proposal", "evidence.purpose",
    "evidence.link.count", "evidence.members.missing", "evidence.members.extra",
    "identity.members.missing", "identity.members.extra", "identity.owner.present",
    "identity.node.present", "identity.node.type", "identity.source.occurrence",
    "identity.consumer.unique", "identity.consumer.count",
    "node.parent", "node.value.hash", "node.ordinal.integer", "node.ordinal.nonnegative",
    "node.occurrence.type", "node.occurrence.kind", "node.occurrence.value",
    "edge.ordinal.integer", "edge.ordinal.nonnegative", "edge.unique",
    "gate.acyclic", "aggregate.controlling_roots", "aggregate.selected_roots",
})
FAULT_OPERATIONS = frozenset({"value", "predicate", "join_index", "selected_row", "consumer_row", "query_row", "query_row_batch", "schema_guard", "atomic_guard", "case_field", "case_indices", "policy_keys", "policy_purpose", "identity_owner", "identity_node", "identity_consumers", "identity_output", "edge_bound", "primitive_guard", "primitive_output", "reference_output", "sort_key", "comparison_record", "admission_atom", "evidence_bindings", "evidence_binding", "evidence_retained", "evidence_generated_field", "consumer_row_batch"})


class SemanticError(ValueError):
    """Named fail-closed error used by deterministic negative tests."""

    def __init__(self, code, detail=None, check_id=None):
        self.code = code
        self.detail = detail
        self.check_id = check_id
        ValueError.__init__(self, code)


class DefensiveBoundary(ValueError):
    """A declared test-only domain horizon, never a completed semantic graph."""

    def __init__(self, record):
        self.record = record
        ValueError.__init__(self, "ORACLE_DEFENSIVE_BOUNDARY")


class OracleHooks:
    """Default-inert, closed data-only instrumentation; no dynamic source execution.

    A hook is applicable only to an exact whole input and exact source-path,
    environment and old-value record. A miss is observed, never manufactured
    into an edit. The harness separately admits the actual one-hit transcript.
    """

    def __init__(self, fixture, plan=None):
        self.plan = copy.deepcopy(plan) if plan is not None else {"fault": None, "conditions": []}
        if type(self.plan) is not dict or set(self.plan) != {"fault", "conditions"}:
            raise SemanticError("ORACLE_PLAN_SHAPE")
        self.input_hash = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(fixture, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        self.fault = self.plan["fault"]
        if self.fault is not None:
            fields = {"id", "operation", "path", "inputSha256", "environment", "before", "after"}
            if type(self.fault) is not dict or set(self.fault) != fields or self.fault["operation"] not in FAULT_OPERATIONS:
                raise SemanticError("ORACLE_FAULT_UNKNOWN")
        if type(self.plan["conditions"]) is not list:
            raise SemanticError("ORACLE_CONDITION_LIST")
        for condition in self.plan["conditions"]:
            if type(condition) is not dict or set(condition) != {"atom", "inputSha256", "code", "detail"} or condition["atom"] not in ATOMIC_CHECKS:
                raise SemanticError("ORACLE_CONDITION_UNKNOWN", condition)
        self.edits = []
        self.condition_hits = []
        self.atom_traces = []
        self.choice_traces = []
        self.trace_paths = []
        self.predicate_traces = []

    def apply(self, operation, path, environment, value):
        fault = self.fault
        if fault is None or fault["inputSha256"] != self.input_hash:
            return value
        if operation != fault["operation"] or path != fault["path"]:
            return value
        if not oracle_record_equal(environment, fault["environment"]) or not oracle_record_equal(value, fault["before"]):
            return value
        self.edits.append({"id": fault["id"], "operation": operation, "path": path, "environment": copy.deepcopy(environment), "before": copy.deepcopy(value), "after": copy.deepcopy(fault["after"]), "inputSha256": self.input_hash})
        return copy.deepcopy(fault["after"])

    def condition(self, atom, code, detail):
        matches = [item for item in self.plan["conditions"] if item["atom"] == atom and item["inputSha256"] == self.input_hash and item["code"] == code and oracle_record_equal(item["detail"], detail)]
        if len(matches) > 1:
            raise SemanticError("ORACLE_CONDITION_OVERLAP", atom)
        if matches:
            self.condition_hits.append(copy.deepcopy(matches[0]))
            return True
        return False


def oracle_record_equal(left, right):
    if type(left) is not type(right):
        return False
    if type(left) is dict:
        return left.keys() == right.keys() and all(oracle_record_equal(left[key], right[key]) for key in left)
    if type(left) is list:
        return len(left) == len(right) and all(oracle_record_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right))
    return left == right


def exact_equal(left, right):
    if type(left) in (int, float) and type(right) in (int, float):
        return left == right
    if type(left) is not type(right):
        return False
    if type(left) is list:
        return len(left) == len(right) and all(exact_equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right))
    if type(left) is dict:
        return left.keys() == right.keys() and all(exact_equal(left[k], right[k]) for k in left)
    return left == right


def primitive_guard(atom, condition, code, detail, hooks, path, continuation=False):
    environment = {"path": path, "code": code, "detail": detail}
    changed = hooks.apply("primitive_guard", atom, environment, condition) if hooks is not None else condition
    if not changed:
        raise SemanticError(code, detail, atom)
    if not condition and not continuation:
        raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "primitive.domain", "atom": atom, "environment": environment, "nextForbiddenOperation": "consume-invalid-primitive-domain"})


def _strict_pairs(items, hooks=None, path=""):
    result = {}
    for index, (key, value) in enumerate(items):
        primitive_guard("json.object.unique", key not in result, "JSON_DUPLICATE_OBJECT_KEY", key, hooks, path + "/" + str(index), True)
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _reject_nonfinite(value, hooks=None, path=""):
    primitive_guard("json.number.finite", False, "JSON_NONFINITE_NUMBER", value, hooks, path)


def strict_loads(text, hooks=None):
    """Parse JSON while rejecting duplicate keys and NaN/Infinity tokens."""

    object_calls, constant_calls = [], []

    def pairs(items):
        index = len(object_calls)
        object_calls.append(None)
        return _strict_pairs(items, hooks, "/objects/" + str(index))

    def constant(value):
        index = len(constant_calls)
        constant_calls.append(None)
        return _reject_nonfinite(value, hooks, "/constants/" + str(index))

    try:
        return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=pairs, parse_constant=constant)
    except DefensiveBoundary:
        raise
    except SemanticError:
        raise
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
        primitive_guard("json.syntax.valid", False, "JSON_PARSE_ERROR", str(error), hooks, "")


def child_pointer(pointer_value, key, hooks=None):
    result = pointer_value + "/" + str(key).replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
    return hooks.apply("primitive_output", "pointer.child", {"path": pointer_value, "key": key}, result) if hooks is not None else result


def pointer(value, path, hooks=None):
    environment = {"document": value, "path": path}
    if path in ("", "/"):
        result = value
    else:
        result = value
        for token in path.lstrip("/").split("/"):
            key = token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
            result = result[int(key)] if type(result) is list else result[key]
    return hooks.apply("primitive_output", "pointer.value", environment, result) if hooks is not None else result


def canonical_bytes(value, hooks=None, path=""):
    result = _canonical_bytes(value, hooks, path)
    if hooks is not None:
        result = bytes(hooks.apply("primitive_output", "canonical.bytes", {"value": value, "path": path}, list(result)))
    return result


def _canonical_bytes(value, hooks=None, path=""):
    if type(value) is dict:
        for key in value:
            _canonical_string(key, hooks, child_pointer(path, key) + "/@key")
        keys = sorted(value, key=lambda item: item.encode("utf-16-be"))
        result = b"{"
        for index, key in enumerate(keys):
            result += (b"," if index else b"") + json.dumps(key, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8") + b":" + canonical_bytes(value[key], hooks, child_pointer(path, key))
        return result + b"}"
    if type(value) is list:
        result = b"["
        for index, item in enumerate(value):
            result += (b"," if index else b"") + canonical_bytes(item, hooks, child_pointer(path, index))
        return result + b"]"
    primitive_guard("canonical.scalar.type", type(value) in (str, bool, int, type(None)), "CANONICAL_JSON_TYPE", type(value).__name__, hooks, path)
    if type(value) is str:
        _canonical_string(value, hooks, path)
    if type(value) is int:
        primitive_guard("canonical.integer.lower", value >= 0, "CANONICAL_JSON_INTEGER", value, hooks, path)
        primitive_guard("canonical.integer.upper", value <= 2147483647, "CANONICAL_JSON_INTEGER", value, hooks, path)
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8")


def _canonical_string(value, hooks=None, path=""):
    primitive_guard("canonical.string.type", type(value) is str, "CANONICAL_JSON_STRING", "NUL or non-string", hooks, path)
    primitive_guard("canonical.string.nul", "\x00" not in value, "CANONICAL_JSON_STRING", "NUL or non-string", hooks, path)
    try:
        value.encode("utf-8", errors="strict")
    except UnicodeEncodeError as error:
        primitive_guard("canonical.string.unicode", False, "CANONICAL_JSON_STRING", "unpaired surrogate", hooks, path)


def digest(value, hooks=None):
    result = hashlib.sha256(canonical_bytes(value)).hexdigest()
    return hooks.apply("primitive_output", "digest.hex", {"value": value}, result) if hooks is not None else result


def row_hash(slice_name, table, identity, hooks=None):
    if slice_name == "slice_3a":
        domain = b"paprnav:ad_extraction_v4:applicability-row:2\0"
    elif slice_name == "slice_3b":
        domain = b"paprnav:ad_extraction_v4:obligation-row:1\0"
    else:
        primitive_guard("row_hash.slice.known", False, "ROW_HASH_SLICE_UNKNOWN", slice_name, hooks, "")
    result = hashlib.sha256(domain + canonical_bytes({"table": table, "identity": identity})).hexdigest()
    return hooks.apply("primitive_output", "row_hash.hex", {"slice": slice_name, "table": table, "identity": identity}, result) if hooks is not None else result


def json_type(value, expected):
    return {
        "object": type(value) is dict,
        "array": type(value) is list,
        "string": type(value) is str,
        "boolean": type(value) is bool,
        "integer": type(value) is int or (type(value) is float and value.is_integer()),
        "number": type(value) in (int, float),
        "null": value is None,
    }[expected]


class JsonSchemaValidator:
    """Closed validator for the exact vocabulary used by the frozen source schema."""

    def __init__(self, schema, hooks=None):
        self.schema = schema
        self.hooks = hooks
        self.union_sites = {}
        self._references = []
        self._inspect(schema, "#")
        for location, reference in self._references:
            self.resolve(reference, location)

    def _guard(self, atom, condition, code, detail, location, operand):
        changed = condition
        environment = {"schemaLocation": location, "operand": operand, "diagnostic": code, "payload": detail}
        if self.hooks is not None:
            changed = self.hooks.apply("schema_guard", atom, environment, condition)
        if not changed:
            raise SemanticError(code, detail, atom)
        if not condition:
            raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "schema.domain", "atom": atom, "environment": copy.deepcopy(environment), "rejectionSuppressed": True, "nextForbiddenOperation": "consume-invalid-schema-domain"})
        return changed

    def resolve(self, reference, location="#"):
        detail = {"location": location, "reference": reference}
        self._guard("schema.reference.string", type(reference) is str, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_UNSUPPORTED", detail, location, reference)
        self._guard("schema.reference.local", reference.startswith("#/"), "SOURCE_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_UNSUPPORTED", detail, location, reference)
        current = self.schema
        try:
            for token in reference[2:].split("/"):
                key = token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
                current = current[int(key)] if type(current) is list else current[key]
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError) as error:
            self._guard("schema.reference.present", False, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_MISSING", detail, location, reference)
        self._guard("schema.reference.schema", type(current) in (dict, bool), "SOURCE_SCHEMA_REFERENCE_NOT_SCHEMA", reference, location, current)
        return current

    def _inspect(self, schema, location):
        if type(schema) is bool:
            return
        self._guard("schema.container.object", type(schema) is dict, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", location, location, schema)
        unknown = set(schema) - SCHEMA_KEYWORDS
        self._guard("schema.vocabulary.known", not unknown, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_KEYWORD", sorted(unknown), location, schema)
        for keyword, value in schema.items():
            child = child_pointer(location, keyword)
            if keyword in ("$defs", "properties", "patternProperties"):
                self._guard("schema.members.object", type(value) is dict, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
                for name, sub_schema in value.items():
                    if keyword == "patternProperties":
                        self._compile(name, child)
                    self._inspect(sub_schema, child_pointer(child, name))
            elif keyword in ("items", "additionalProperties"):
                self._inspect(value, child)
            elif keyword == "oneOf":
                self._guard("schema.oneof.list", type(value) is list, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
                self._guard("schema.oneof.nonempty", bool(value), "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
                self.union_sites[location] = len(value)
                for index, branch in enumerate(value):
                    self._inspect(branch, child_pointer(child, index))
            elif keyword == "$ref":
                self._references.append((location, value))
            elif keyword == "type":
                names = value if type(value) is list else [value]
                self._guard("schema.type.nonempty", bool(names), "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, names)
                for index, name in enumerate(names):
                    self._guard("schema.type.entry.string", type(name) is str, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child_pointer(child, index), name)
                    self._guard("schema.type.entry.known", name in JSON_TYPES, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child_pointer(child, index), name)
            elif keyword == "required":
                self._guard("schema.required.list", type(value) is list, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
                for index, name in enumerate(value):
                    self._guard("schema.required.entry.string", type(name) is str, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child_pointer(child, index), name)
                self._guard("schema.required.unique", len(value) == len(set(value)), "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
            elif keyword in ("minProperties", "minItems", "minLength", "maxLength"):
                self._guard("schema.bound.integer", type(value) is int, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
                self._guard("schema.bound.nonnegative", value >= 0, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
            elif keyword == "uniqueItems":
                self._guard("schema.unique.boolean", type(value) is bool, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
            elif keyword == "pattern":
                self._compile(value, child)
            elif keyword == "enum":
                self._guard("schema.enum.list", type(value) is list, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
                self._guard("schema.enum.nonempty", bool(value), "SOURCE_SCHEMA_SHAPE", child, child, value)
            elif keyword == "x-paprnav-array-kind":
                self._guard("schema.array_kind.known", value in ("set", "sequence"), "SOURCE_CANONICALIZATION_ANNOTATION", child, child, value)
            elif keyword == "x-paprnav-sort-key":
                names = value if type(value) is list else [value]
                self._guard("schema.sort_key.nonempty", bool(names), "SOURCE_CANONICALIZATION_ANNOTATION", child, child, names)
                for index, name in enumerate(names):
                    self._guard("schema.sort_key.entry.string", type(name) is str, "SOURCE_CANONICALIZATION_ANNOTATION", child, child_pointer(child, index), name)

    def _compile(self, pattern, location):
        self._guard("schema.pattern.string", type(pattern) is str, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_PATTERN", location, location, pattern)
        try:
            return re.compile(pattern)
        except re.error as error:
            self._guard("schema.pattern.valid", False, "SOURCE_SCHEMA_PATTERN", {"location": location, "error": str(error)}, location, pattern)

    def validate(self, value, schema_location="#", trace=None):
        schema = self.schema if schema_location == "#" else self.resolve(schema_location)
        self._validate(value, schema, "", schema_location, trace)

    def _validate(self, value, schema, instance_pointer, location, trace):
        if schema is True:
            return
        if schema is False:
            self._guard("schema.instance.allowed", False, "SOURCE_FORBIDDEN_FIELD", instance_pointer, location, value)
        if "$ref" in schema:
            self._validate(value, self.resolve(schema["$ref"], location), instance_pointer, schema["$ref"], trace)
        if "oneOf" in schema:
            matches = []
            matching_traces = []
            for index, branch in enumerate(schema["oneOf"]):
                branch_trace = []
                try:
                    self._validate(value, branch, instance_pointer, f"{location}/oneOf/{index}", branch_trace)
                except SemanticError:
                    continue
                matches.append(index)
                matching_traces.append(branch_trace)
            self._guard("schema.union.nonempty", bool(matches), "SOURCE_ONEOF_NONE:" + location, {"pointer": instance_pointer, "matches": matches}, location, value)
            self._guard("schema.union.unique", len(matches) == 1, "SOURCE_ONEOF_MULTIPLE:" + location, {"pointer": instance_pointer, "matches": matches}, location, value)
            if trace is not None:
                trace.append({"site": location, "pointer": instance_pointer, "alternative": matches[0]})
                trace.extend(matching_traces[0])
        if "type" in schema:
            names = schema["type"] if type(schema["type"]) is list else [schema["type"]]
            self._guard("schema.instance.type", any(json_type(value, name) for name in names), "SOURCE_TYPE_MISMATCH", {"pointer": instance_pointer, "expected": names}, location, value)
        if "const" in schema:
            self._guard("schema.instance.const", exact_equal(value, schema["const"]), "SOURCE_CONST_MISMATCH", instance_pointer, location, value)
        if "enum" in schema:
            self._guard("schema.instance.enum", any(self._enum_match(value, item, index, location, instance_pointer) for index, item in enumerate(schema["enum"])), "SOURCE_ENUM_MISMATCH", instance_pointer, location, value)
        if type(value) is dict:
            for required in schema.get("required", []):
                self._guard("schema.instance.required", required in value, "SOURCE_REQUIRED_MISSING", child_pointer(instance_pointer, required), child_pointer(location + "/required", required), value)
            self._guard("schema.instance.min_properties", len(value) >= schema.get("minProperties", 0), "SOURCE_OBJECT_CARDINALITY", instance_pointer, location, value)
            properties = schema.get("properties", {})
            patterns = schema.get("patternProperties", {})
            for key, item in value.items():
                matched = False
                if key in properties:
                    self._validate(item, properties[key], child_pointer(instance_pointer, key), f"{location}/properties/{key}", trace)
                    matched = True
                for pattern, sub_schema in patterns.items():
                    if re.search(pattern, key) is not None:
                        self._validate(item, sub_schema, child_pointer(instance_pointer, key), f"{location}/patternProperties/{pattern}", trace)
                        matched = True
                if not matched and "additionalProperties" in schema:
                    self._validate(item, schema["additionalProperties"], child_pointer(instance_pointer, key), f"{location}/additionalProperties", trace)
        if type(value) is list:
            self._guard("schema.instance.min_items", len(value) >= schema.get("minItems", 0), "SOURCE_ARRAY_CARDINALITY", instance_pointer, location, value)
            if schema.get("uniqueItems", False):
                for index, item in enumerate(value):
                    self._guard("schema.instance.unique_item", not any(exact_equal(item, value[prior]) for prior in range(index)), "SOURCE_ARRAY_DUPLICATE", child_pointer(instance_pointer, index), location, item)
            if "items" in schema:
                for index, item in enumerate(value):
                    self._validate(item, schema["items"], child_pointer(instance_pointer, index), f"{location}/items", trace)
        if type(value) is str:
            self._guard("schema.instance.min_length", len(value) >= schema.get("minLength", 0), "SOURCE_STRING_LENGTH", instance_pointer, location, value)
            self._guard("schema.instance.max_length", len(value) <= schema.get("maxLength", len(value)), "SOURCE_STRING_LENGTH", instance_pointer, location, value)
            if "pattern" in schema:
                self._guard("schema.instance.pattern", re.search(schema["pattern"], value) is not None, "SOURCE_STRING_PATTERN", instance_pointer, location, value)

    def _enum_match(self, value, alternative, index, location, instance_pointer):
        actual = exact_equal(value, alternative)
        environment = {"schemaLocation": location, "instancePointer": instance_pointer, "index": index, "value": value, "alternative": alternative}
        changed = self.hooks.apply("predicate", "schema.enum.alternative", environment, actual) if self.hooks is not None else actual
        if changed and not actual:
            raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "schema.enum.domain", "environment": environment, "actual": False, "neutralized": True, "nextForbiddenOperation": "accept-invalid-enum-alternative"})
        return changed

    def canonicalize(self, value, schema_location="#"):
        self.validate(value, schema_location)
        schema = self.schema if schema_location == "#" else self.resolve(schema_location)
        return self._canonicalize(value, schema)

    def _canonicalize(self, value, schema):
        if type(schema) is bool:
            return copy.deepcopy(value)
        if "$ref" in schema:
            return self._canonicalize(value, self.resolve(schema["$ref"]))
        if "oneOf" in schema:
            valid = []
            for branch in schema["oneOf"]:
                try:
                    self._validate(value, branch, "", "#", None)
                except SemanticError:
                    continue
                valid.append(branch)
            if len(valid) != 1:
                raise SemanticError("SOURCE_CANONICALIZATION_UNION", len(valid))
            return self._canonicalize(value, valid[0])
        if type(value) is dict:
            result = {}
            for key in sorted(value, key=lambda item: item.encode("utf-16-be")):
                child = schema.get("properties", {}).get(key)
                if child is None:
                    matches = [sub for pattern, sub in schema.get("patternProperties", {}).items() if re.search(pattern, key)]
                    child = matches[0] if matches else schema.get("additionalProperties", True)
                result[key] = self._canonicalize(value[key], child)
            return result
        if type(value) is list:
            result = [self._canonicalize(item, schema.get("items", True)) for item in value]
            if schema.get("x-paprnav-array-kind") == "set":
                sort_key = schema.get("x-paprnav-sort-key")
                if type(sort_key) is str:
                    result.sort(key=lambda item: canonical_bytes(item[sort_key]))
                elif type(sort_key) is list:
                    result.sort(key=lambda item: tuple(canonical_bytes(item[name]) for name in sort_key))
                else:
                    result.sort(key=canonical_bytes)
            return result
        return copy.deepcopy(value)


def validate_exact_mapping_schema(value, schema, path=""):
    """Validate the approved closed mapping schema without external packages."""

    if path:
        raise SemanticError("MAPPING_SCHEMA_ENTRY_PATH_FORBIDDEN", path)
    try:
        JsonSchemaValidator(schema).validate(value)
    except SemanticError as error:
        if error.code.startswith("SOURCE_"):
            raise SemanticError("MAPPING_SCHEMA_" + error.code.removeprefix("SOURCE_"), error.detail) from error
        raise


class SemanticKernel:
    """Execute one frozen source fixture against the mapping's typed AST."""

    def __init__(self, fixture, mapping, source_schema, disabled_detectors=(), hook_plan=None):
        self.fixture = fixture
        self.program = mapping["typedAst"]
        self.validator = JsonSchemaValidator(source_schema)
        self.context = fixture["context"]
        self.binding = self.context["binding"]
        self.proposal = fixture["envelope"]["proposal"]
        self.hooks = OracleHooks(fixture, hook_plan)
        self.query_paths = {}
        for family in ("nodes", "edges", "identitySelectors", "externalBranches"):
            for index, item in enumerate(self.program[family]):
                base = "/typedAst/" + family + "/" + str(index)
                if family == "nodes":
                    self.query_paths[item["id"]] = base + "/query"
                else:
                    for query_index, query in enumerate(item["queries"]):
                        self.query_paths[item["id"] + ":" + str(query_index)] = base + "/queries/" + str(query_index)
        for index, query in enumerate(self.program["references"]):
            self.query_paths["reference:" + str(index)] = "/typedAst/references/" + str(index)
        if disabled_detectors:
            raise SemanticError("LEGACY_DETECTOR_DISABLE_FORBIDDEN", sorted(disabled_detectors))
        self.tables = {
            "nodes": list(self.context["semanticNodes"]),
            "owners": list(self.context["typedOwners"]),
            "relations": list(self.context["relations"]),
            "externalDependencies": list(self.context["externalDependencies"]),
            "externalMetadata": list(self.context["externalMetadata"]),
        }
        for foreign in self.context.get("unboundProjectionContexts", []):
            for table, key in (("nodes", "semanticNodes"), ("owners", "typedOwners"), ("relations", "relations")):
                self.tables[table].extend(foreign.get(key, []))
        self.coverage = {"queries": [], "branchCases": [], "edgeRules": [], "identitySelectors": [], "externalBranches": []}
        self.nodes = {}
        self.owners = {}
        self.raw = {}
        self.node_rules = {}
        self.edges = []
        self.references = []
        self.identity_mappings = []
        self.evidence = []

    def check(self, detector, condition, code, detail=None):
        return self.atom(detector, condition, code, detail)

    def atom(self, atom, condition, code, detail):
        if atom not in ATOMIC_CHECKS:
            raise SemanticError("ORACLE_ATOM_UNKNOWN", atom)
        condition = self.hooks.apply("atomic_guard", atom, {"code": code, "detail": detail}, condition)
        if atom.startswith(("edge.parent.", "edge.child.", "reference.")):
            self.hooks.atom_traces.append({"atom": atom, "truth": condition, "detail": copy.deepcopy(detail)})
        if not condition and not self.hooks.condition(atom, code, detail):
            raise SemanticError(code, detail, atom)
        return condition

    def value(self, expression, environment, path=""):
        value = self._value(expression, environment, path)
        return self.hooks.apply("value", path, environment, value)

    def _value(self, expression, environment, path):
        op = expression["op"]
        if op == "literal":
            return copy.deepcopy(expression["value"])
        if op == "param":
            if expression["name"] not in self.binding:
                raise SemanticError("AST_PARAMETER_MISSING", expression)
            return self.binding[expression["name"]]
        if op == "row":
            return copy.deepcopy(environment[expression["alias"]])
        if op == "field":
            alias, name = expression["alias"], expression["name"]
            if alias not in environment or name not in environment[alias]:
                raise SemanticError("AST_TYPED_FIELD_MISSING", expression)
            return environment[alias][name]
        if op in ("add", "concat"):
            values = [self.value(item, environment, path + "/args/" + str(index)) for index, item in enumerate(expression["args"])]
            expected = int if op == "add" else str
            if any(type(item) is not expected for item in values):
                raise SemanticError("AST_EXPRESSION_TYPE_MISMATCH", expression)
            if op == "add":
                return sum(values)
            result = ""
            for value in values:
                result += value
            return result
        raise SemanticError("AST_EXPRESSION_UNKNOWN", expression)

    def test(self, predicate, environment, path=""):
        result = self._test(predicate, environment, path)
        changed = self.hooks.apply("predicate", path, environment, result)
        if path in self.hooks.trace_paths:
            self.hooks.predicate_traces.append({"path": path, "before": result, "after": changed})
        return changed

    def _test(self, predicate, environment, path):
        op = predicate["op"]
        if op == "true":
            return True
        if op == "false":
            return False
        if op == "and":
            return all(self.test(term, environment, path + "/terms/" + str(index)) for index, term in enumerate(predicate["terms"]))
        if op == "or":
            return any(self.test(term, environment, path + "/terms/" + str(index)) for index, term in enumerate(predicate["terms"]))
        if op == "not":
            return not self.test(predicate["term"], environment, path + "/term")
        if op == "eq":
            return exact_equal(self.value(predicate["left"], environment, path + "/left"), self.value(predicate["right"], environment, path + "/right"))
        if op == "in":
            value = self.value(predicate["value"], environment, path + "/value")
            return any(exact_equal(value, item) for item in predicate["values"])
        if op == "is_null":
            return self.value(predicate["value"], environment, path + "/value") is None
        if op in ("starts_with", "ends_with", "contains"):
            value = self.value(predicate["value"], environment, path + "/value")
            if type(value) is not str:
                raise SemanticError("AST_PREDICATE_TYPE_MISMATCH", predicate)
            if op == "starts_with":
                return value.startswith(predicate["text"])
            if op == "ends_with":
                return value.endswith(predicate["text"])
            return predicate["text"] in value
        raise SemanticError("AST_PREDICATE_UNKNOWN", predicate)

    def query(self, query, label):
        path = self.query_paths[label]
        scan = query["from"]
        alias = scan["as"]
        environments = [{alias: row} for row in self.tables[scan["table"]] if self.test(scan["where"], {alias: row}, path + "/from/where")]
        for join_index, join in enumerate(query["joins"]):
            join_path = path + "/joins/" + str(join_index)
            alias = join["as"]
            if any(alias in environment for environment in environments):
                raise SemanticError("AST_ALIAS_REBOUND", alias)
            right = join["on"]["right"]
            index = {}
            for row in self.tables[join["table"]]:
                if not self.test(join["where"], {alias: row}, join_path + "/where"):
                    continue
                if right not in row:
                    raise SemanticError("AST_TYPED_FIELD_MISSING", {"alias": alias, "name": right})
                indexed_key = self.hooks.apply("join_index", join_path + "/on/right", {alias: row}, row[right])
                index.setdefault(canonical_bytes(indexed_key), []).append(row)
            joined = []
            for environment in environments:
                key = canonical_bytes(self.value(join["on"]["left"], environment, join_path + "/on/left"))
                for row in index.get(key, []):
                    joined.append({**environment, alias: row})
            environments = joined
        result = []
        for environment in environments:
            if self.test(query["where"], environment, path + "/where"):
                selected = {name: self.value(expression, environment, path + "/select/" + name) for name, expression in query["select"].items()}
                selected = self.hooks.apply("selected_row", path + "/select", environment, selected)
                selected = self.hooks.apply("query_row", path + "/select", {"queryId": label}, selected)
                if selected is not None:
                    batch = self.hooks.apply("query_row_batch", path + "/select", {"queryId": label}, [selected])
                    result.extend(batch)
        self.coverage["queries"].append({"id": label, "resultCount": len(result)})
        return result

    def bound_projection(self, slice_name):
        return self.binding["slice3aProjectionId" if slice_name == "slice_3a" else "slice3bProjectionId"]

    def construct_nodes(self):
        self.validator.validate(self.fixture["envelope"])
        if not exact_equal(self.validator.canonicalize(self.fixture["envelope"]), self.fixture["envelope"]):
            raise SemanticError("SOURCE_NONCANONICAL_FIXTURE", self.fixture["fixtureId"])
        for rule_index, rule in enumerate(self.program["nodes"]):
            for selected in self.query(rule["query"], rule["id"]):
                selected = self.hooks.apply("consumer_row", "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/consumer", selected, selected)
                if selected is None:
                    continue
                # Expose a complete malformed phase result before a required
                # role is dereferenced. This is a D observation, not a named
                # production rejection, repaired row, or completed graph.
                if type(selected) is not dict:
                    raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "node.selected.domain", "ruleId": rule["id"], "result": copy.deepcopy(selected), "invalidRole": "", "relation": "object_required", "nextForbiddenOperation": "selected[node]"})
                for role in ("node", "owner"):
                    if role not in selected:
                        raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "node.selected.domain", "ruleId": rule["id"], "result": copy.deepcopy(selected), "invalidRole": role, "relation": "required_role_missing", "nextForbiddenOperation": "selected[" + role + "]"})
                    if type(selected[role]) is not dict:
                        raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "node.selected.domain", "ruleId": rule["id"], "result": copy.deepcopy(selected), "invalidRole": role, "relation": "object_required", "nextForbiddenOperation": role + "[id]" if role == "node" else "owner[projection_id]"})
                node, owner = selected["node"], selected["owner"]
                node_id = node["id"]
                self.atom("selection.node.projection", node["projectionId"] == self.bound_projection(node["slice"]), "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", node)
                self.atom("selection.node.proposal", node["proposalId"] == self.binding["proposalId"], "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", node)
                self.atom("selection.owner.projection", owner["projection_id"] == node["projectionId"], "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", owner)
                self.atom("selection.owner.proposal", owner["proposal_id"] == node["proposalId"], "SELECTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH", owner)
                self.atom("selection.node.type", node["nodeType"] == rule["nodeType"], "SELECTION_NODE_TYPE_MISMATCH", selected)
                self.atom("selection.node.slice", node["slice"] == rule["slice"], "SELECTION_NODE_TYPE_MISMATCH", selected)
                self.atom("selection.owner.table", owner["table"] == rule["ownerTable"], "SELECTION_TYPED_OWNER_MISMATCH", selected)
                self.atom("selection.owner.self_id", owner["semantic_node_id"] == node_id, "SELECTION_TYPED_OWNER_MISMATCH", selected)
                self.atom("selection.unique", node_id not in self.nodes, "SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", node_id)
                try:
                    raw = pointer(self.proposal, node["sourcePointer"])
                except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError, ValueError):
                    raw = self.context.get("syntheticSourceValues", {}).get(node["sourcePointer"])
                    expected = {"sourceDependencyId": owner.get("source_dependency_id"), "targetProjectionId": node["projectionId"]}
                    self.atom("node.occurrence.type", node["nodeType"] == "change_dependency", "SOURCE_OCCURRENCE_MISSING", node)
                    self.atom("node.occurrence.kind", owner.get("dependency_kind") == "incoming_supersession_signal", "SOURCE_OCCURRENCE_MISSING", node)
                    self.atom("node.occurrence.value", exact_equal(raw, expected), "SOURCE_OCCURRENCE_MISSING", node)
                    if node["nodeType"] != "change_dependency" or owner.get("dependency_kind") != "incoming_supersession_signal" or not exact_equal(raw, expected):
                        raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "node.source.domain", "node": copy.deepcopy(node), "raw": copy.deepcopy(raw), "expectedSynthetic": expected, "nextForbiddenOperation": "digest(raw)"})
                self.atom("node.value.hash", digest(raw) == node["canonicalNodeHash"], "NODE_VALUE_HASH_MISMATCH", node_id)
                table = "semantic-node"
                prefix = "avn_" if node["slice"] == "slice_3a" else "aon_"
                identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "nodeType": node["nodeType"], "nodeKey": node["nodeKey"], "pointer": node["sourcePointer"]}
                if node["nodeType"] == "designation_value":
                    table = "designation-value"
                    identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "pointer": node["sourcePointer"], "value": raw}
                elif node["nodeType"] == "identity_mapping":
                    table = "identity-mapping"
                    prefix = "avi_"
                    identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "kind": owner["identity_kind"], "occurrence": owner["source_occurrence_node_id"]}
                identity_hash = row_hash(node["slice"], table, identity)
                self.atom("node.identity.hash", node["identityHash"] == identity_hash, "NODE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH", node_id)
                self.atom("node.identity.id", node_id == prefix + identity_hash[:32], "NODE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH", node_id)
                environment = {"n": node, "o": owner}
                cases = [(index, case) for index, case in enumerate(rule["cases"]) if self.test(case["when"], environment, "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/cases/" + str(index) + "/when")]
                matched_indices = self.hooks.apply("case_indices", "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/cases", {"ruleId": rule["id"], "nodeId": node_id}, [index for index, case in cases])
                cases = [(index, rule["cases"][index]) for index in matched_indices]
                self.hooks.choice_traces.append({"phase": "case", "ruleId": rule["id"], "nodeId": node_id, "matchingIndices": [index for index, case in cases]})
                choice_detail = {"nodeId": node_id, "matches": len(cases)}
                self.atom("case.nonempty", bool(cases), "UNION_SELECTION_NONE:" + rule["id"], choice_detail)
                self.atom("case.unique", len(cases) <= 1, "UNION_SELECTION_MULTIPLE:" + rule["id"], choice_detail)
                if not cases:
                    raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "node.case.choice", "ruleId": rule["id"], "nodeId": node_id, "matchingIndices": [], "nextForbiddenOperation": "cases[0]"})
                case_index, case = cases[0]
                ordinal = self.value(rule["ordinal"], environment, "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/ordinal")
                self.atom("node.ordinal.integer", type(ordinal) is int, "AST_ORDINAL_TYPE_MISMATCH", rule["id"])
                self.atom("node.ordinal.nonnegative", ordinal >= 0, "AST_ORDINAL_TYPE_MISMATCH", rule["id"])
                actual = {key: copy.deepcopy(node[key]) for key in SOURCE_FIELDS}
                fields = {}
                for source_field, output_field in (("representation", "representationStatus"), ("baseGate", "baseGate"), ("reason", "reasonCode")):
                    fields[output_field] = self.hooks.apply("case_field", "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/cases/" + str(case_index) + "/" + source_field, {"ruleId": rule["id"], "caseIndex": case_index, "nodeId": node_id}, case[source_field])
                actual.update(canonicalOrdinal=ordinal, **fields)
                self.nodes[node_id] = actual
                self.owners[node_id] = owner
                self.raw[node_id] = raw
                self.node_rules[node_id] = rule
                self.coverage["branchCases"].append({"policyId": rule["id"], "caseIndex": case_index, "nodeId": node_id})
        expected_ids = {node["id"] for node in self.context["semanticNodes"]}
        cardinality_detail = {"selected": len(self.nodes), "expected": len(expected_ids), "owners": len(self.context["typedOwners"])}
        self.atom("selection.members.missing", not expected_ids - set(self.nodes), "SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", {**cardinality_detail, "missing": sorted(expected_ids - set(self.nodes))})
        self.atom("selection.members.extra", not set(self.nodes) - expected_ids, "SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", {**cardinality_detail, "extra": sorted(set(self.nodes) - expected_ids)})
        self.atom("selection.owner_count", len(self.nodes) == len(self.context["typedOwners"]), "SELECTION_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", cardinality_detail)
        for node in self.nodes.values():
            self.atom("node.parent", node["parentNodeId"] is None or node["parentNodeId"] in self.nodes, "NODE_PARENT_MISMATCH", node["id"])
            self.construct_evidence(node)

    def construct_evidence(self, node):
        rule = self.node_rules[node["id"]]
        raw = self.raw[node["id"]]
        environment = {"n": node, "o": self.owners[node["id"]]}
        rule_index = next(index for index, item in enumerate(self.program["nodes"]) if item is rule)
        policy = next((item for index, item in enumerate(rule["evidence"]) if self.test(item["when"], environment, "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/evidence/" + str(index) + "/when")), None)
        self.hooks.choice_traces.append({"phase": "evidence", "ruleId": rule["id"], "nodeId": node["id"], "selectedIndex": next((index for index, item in enumerate(rule["evidence"]) if item is policy), None)})
        self.atom("evidence.policy.present", policy is not None, "EVIDENCE_POLICY_UNCOVERED", node["id"])
        if policy is None:
            raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "node.evidence.choice", "ruleId": rule["id"], "nodeId": node["id"], "selectedIndex": None, "nextForbiddenOperation": "policy[source]"})
        policy_index = next(index for index, item in enumerate(rule["evidence"]) if item is policy)
        policy_path = "/typedAst/nodes/" + str(rule_index) + "/evidence/" + str(policy_index)
        policy_environment = {"ruleId": rule["id"], "policyIndex": policy_index, "nodeId": node["id"]}
        if policy["source"] == "own":
            keys = raw.get("evidenceKeys", []) if type(raw) is dict else []
        elif policy["source"] == "parent_normalized_identity":
            keys = pointer(self.proposal, node["sourcePointer"].rsplit("/", 1)[0])["normalizedIdentity"]["evidenceKeys"]
        elif policy["source"] == "none":
            keys = []
        else:
            raise SemanticError("EVIDENCE_SOURCE_UNKNOWN", policy)
        keys = self.hooks.apply("policy_keys", policy_path + "/source", policy_environment, keys)
        purpose = self.hooks.apply("policy_purpose", policy_path + "/purpose", policy_environment, policy["purpose"])
        self.atom("evidence.keys.required", policy["source"] == "none" or bool(keys), "EVIDENCE_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:" + node["id"], {"expected": "one_or_more", "actual": len(keys)})
        generated = []
        for ordinal, key in enumerate(keys):
            bindings = []
            for item in self.context["evidenceBindings"]:
                binding_environment = {"node": node, "key": key, "binding": item}
                if not self.hooks.apply("predicate", policy_path + "/binding/proposal", binding_environment, item["proposal_id"] == node["proposalId"]):
                    continue
                if self.hooks.apply("predicate", policy_path + "/binding/key", binding_environment, item["evidence_key"] == key):
                    bindings.append(item)
            bindings = self.hooks.apply("evidence_bindings", policy_path + "/bindings", {"nodeId": node["id"], "key": key}, bindings)
            self.atom("evidence.binding.count", len(bindings) == 1, "EVIDENCE_BINDING_MULTIPLICITY_MISMATCH", {"nodeId": node["id"], "key": key, "count": len(bindings), "proposalId": node["proposalId"]})
            if not bindings:
                continue
            binding = self.hooks.apply("evidence_binding", policy_path + "/binding/selected", {"nodeId": node["id"], "key": key}, bindings[0])
            canonical = self.proposal["evidenceBindings"][key]
            self.atom("evidence.fragment.id", binding["fragment_id"] == canonical["fragmentId"], "EVIDENCE_FRAGMENT_BINDING_MISMATCH", binding)
            self.atom("evidence.fragment.hash", binding["fragment_hash"] == canonical["fragmentHash"], "EVIDENCE_FRAGMENT_BINDING_MISMATCH", binding)
            if node["slice"] == "slice_3a":
                identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "nodeId": node["id"], "purpose": purpose, "evidenceKey": key}
                row_prefix = "avl_"
            else:
                identity = {"projectionId": node["projectionId"], "semanticNodeId": node["id"], "purpose": purpose, "evidenceKey": key, "ordinal": ordinal}
                row_prefix = "aoe_"
            link_hash = row_hash(node["slice"], "evidence-link", identity)
            generated_link = {
                "slice": node["slice"], "projectionId": node["projectionId"], "proposalId": node["proposalId"],
                "id": row_prefix + link_hash[:32], "nodeId": node["id"], "purpose": purpose,
                "canonicalOrdinal": ordinal, "evidenceKey": key, "candidateBindingId": binding["id"], "linkHash": link_hash,
            }
            for field in generated_link:
                generated_link[field] = self.hooks.apply("evidence_generated_field", policy_path + "/generated/" + field, {"nodeId": node["id"], "key": key, "ordinal": ordinal}, generated_link[field])
            generated.append(generated_link)
        retained = [item for item in self.context["evidenceLinks"] if item["slice"] == node["slice"] and item["nodeId"] == node["id"]]
        retained = self.hooks.apply("evidence_retained", policy_path + "/retained", {"nodeId": node["id"]}, retained)
        for item in retained:
            self.atom("evidence.owner.projection", item["projectionId"] == node["projectionId"], "EVIDENCE_OWNER_MISMATCH:" + node["id"], item)
            self.atom("evidence.owner.proposal", item["proposalId"] == node["proposalId"], "EVIDENCE_OWNER_MISMATCH:" + node["id"], item)
            self.atom("evidence.purpose", item["purpose"] == purpose, "EVIDENCE_PURPOSE_MISMATCH:" + node["id"], item)
        self.atom("evidence.link.count", len(retained) == len(generated), "EVIDENCE_CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:" + node["id"], {"generated": len(generated), "retained": len(retained)})
        for index, member in enumerate(generated):
            occurrence = sum(exact_equal(member, item) for item in generated[:index + 1])
            available = sum(exact_equal(member, item) for item in retained)
            self.atom("evidence.members.missing", occurrence <= available, "EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH:" + node["id"], {"nodeId": node["id"], "member": member, "occurrence": occurrence, "generated": generated, "retained": retained})
        for index, member in enumerate(retained):
            occurrence = sum(exact_equal(member, item) for item in retained[:index + 1])
            available = sum(exact_equal(member, item) for item in generated)
            self.atom("evidence.members.extra", occurrence <= available, "EVIDENCE_SET_MISMATCH:" + node["id"], {"nodeId": node["id"], "member": member, "occurrence": occurrence, "generated": generated, "retained": retained})
        self.evidence.extend(generated)
        compact = [[item[key] for key in ("purpose", "canonicalOrdinal", "evidenceKey", "candidateBindingId", "linkHash")] for item in generated]
        node.update(evidence=compact, evidenceCount=len(compact), evidenceSetHash=digest(compact))

    def construct_edges(self):
        identities = {}
        for rule_index, rule in enumerate(self.program["edges"]):
            emitted = []
            for index, query in enumerate(rule["queries"]):
                for row in self.query(query, f"{rule['id']}:{index}"):
                    batch = self.hooks.apply("consumer_row_batch", "/typedAst/edges/" + str(rule_index) + "/queries/" + str(index) + "/consume", {"queryId": f"{rule['id']}:{index}"}, [row])
                    for member in batch:
                        emitted.append({"ruleId": rule["id"], "edgeKind": rule["kind"], "propagatesGate": rule["propagates"], **member})
            counts = {}
            for edge in emitted:
                parent = self.nodes.get(edge["parentNodeId"])
                child = self.nodes.get(edge["childNodeId"])
                trace_start = len(self.hooks.atom_traces)
                self.atom("edge.parent.present", parent is not None, "REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], edge)
                self.atom("edge.child.present", child is not None, "REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], edge)
                if parent is not None:
                    self.atom("edge.parent.slice", parent["slice"] == edge["parentSlice"], "REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], edge)
                else:
                    self.hooks.atom_traces.append({"atom": "edge.parent.slice", "truth": "not_evaluated/domain_unavailable", "detail": copy.deepcopy(edge)})
                if child is not None:
                    self.atom("edge.child.slice", child["slice"] == edge["childSlice"], "REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], edge)
                    self.atom("edge.child.rule", self.node_rules[child["id"]]["id"] in rule["targetRules"], "REFERENCE_TARGET_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], edge)
                else:
                    for atom in ("edge.child.slice", "edge.child.rule"):
                        self.hooks.atom_traces.append({"atom": atom, "truth": "not_evaluated/domain_unavailable", "detail": copy.deepcopy(edge)})
                if rule["propagates"] and (parent is None or child is None):
                    raise DefensiveBoundary({
                        "phase": "edge.target", "ruleId": rule["id"], "edge": copy.deepcopy(edge),
                        "missingLookup": "parentNodeId" if parent is None else "childNodeId",
                        "presentEndpoint": copy.deepcopy(child if parent is None else parent),
                        "actualAtomTrace": copy.deepcopy(self.hooks.atom_traces[trace_start:]),
                        "nextForbiddenOperation": "propagate",
                    })
                self.atom("edge.ordinal.integer", type(edge["canonicalOrdinal"]) is int, "AST_ORDINAL_TYPE_MISMATCH", edge)
                self.atom("edge.ordinal.nonnegative", edge["canonicalOrdinal"] >= 0, "AST_ORDINAL_TYPE_MISMATCH", edge)
                identity = tuple(edge[key] for key in self.program["edgeRowIdentity"])
                self.atom("edge.unique", identity not in identities, "EDGE_ROW_IDENTITY_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], {"first": identities.get(identity), "second": edge})
                identities[identity] = edge
                counts[edge["parentNodeId"]] = counts.get(edge["parentNodeId"], 0) + 1
            for parent in self.nodes.values():
                if self.node_rules[parent["id"]]["id"] not in rule["parentRules"]:
                    continue
                count = counts.get(parent["id"], 0)
                minimum, maximum = rule["cardinality"]["min"], rule["cardinality"]["max"]
                bound_environment = {"ruleId": rule["id"], "parentNodeId": parent["id"], "count": count}
                bound_path = "/typedAst/edges/" + str(rule_index) + "/cardinality/"
                minimum = self.hooks.apply("edge_bound", bound_path + "min", bound_environment, minimum)
                maximum = self.hooks.apply("edge_bound", bound_path + "max", bound_environment, maximum)
                bounds = {"min": minimum, "max": maximum}
                self.atom("edge.cardinality.lower", count >= minimum, "CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], {"parent": parent["id"], "actual": count, "bounds": bounds})
                self.atom("edge.cardinality.upper", maximum is None or count <= maximum, "CARDINALITY_MISMATCH:" + rule["id"], {"parent": parent["id"], "actual": count, "bounds": bounds})
            self.edges.extend(emitted)
            self.coverage["edgeRules"].append({"ruleId": rule["id"], "count": len(emitted)})

    def construct_identities(self):
        consumed = {}
        for selector_index, selector in enumerate(self.program["identitySelectors"]):
            rows = []
            for index, query in enumerate(selector["queries"]):
                for row in self.query(query, f"{selector['id']}:{index}"):
                    rows.extend(self.hooks.apply("consumer_row_batch", "/typedAst/identitySelectors/" + str(selector_index) + "/queries/" + str(index) + "/consume", {"queryId": f"{selector['id']}:{index}"}, [row]))
            expected = {edge["childNodeId"] for edge in self.edges if edge["ruleId"] == selector["edgeRule"]}
            selected = {row["mappingNodeId"] for row in rows}
            for member in sorted(expected):
                self.atom("identity.members.missing", member in selected, "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], {"selected": sorted(selected), "expected": sorted(expected), "member": member})
            for member in sorted(selected):
                self.atom("identity.members.extra", member in expected, "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], {"selected": sorted(selected), "expected": sorted(expected), "member": member})
            for row in rows:
                node_id = row["mappingNodeId"]
                hook_path = "/typedAst/identitySelectors/" + str(selector_index)
                hook_environment = {"selectorId": selector["id"], "row": row}
                owner = self.hooks.apply("identity_owner", hook_path + "/owner", hook_environment, self.owners.get(node_id))
                self.atom("identity.owner.present", owner is not None, "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], row)
                if owner is None:
                    continue
                node = self.hooks.apply("identity_node", hook_path + "/node", hook_environment, self.nodes.get(node_id))
                self.atom("identity.node.present", node is not None, "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], row)
                if node is None:
                    raise DefensiveBoundary({"phase": "identity.node.domain", "selectorId": selector["id"], "row": row, "nextForbiddenOperation": "node[nodeType]"})
                self.atom("identity.node.type", node["nodeType"] == "identity_mapping", "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], row)
                self.atom("identity.source.occurrence", owner["source_occurrence_node_id"] == row["sourceNodeId"], "IDENTITY_SET_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], row)
                self.atom("identity.consumer.unique", node_id not in consumed, "IDENTITY_DOUBLE_CONSUMPTION:" + selector["id"], row)
                consumers = [edge for edge in self.edges if edge["childNodeId"] == node_id and edge["ruleId"] == selector["edgeRule"]]
                consumers = self.hooks.apply("identity_consumers", hook_path + "/consumers", hook_environment, consumers)
                self.atom("identity.consumer.count", len(consumers) == 1, "IDENTITY_CONSUMPTION_MISMATCH:" + selector["id"], {"row": row, "consumers": consumers})
                if not consumers:
                    continue
                edge = consumers[0]
                consumer = {key: edge[key] for key in ("ruleId", "parentSlice", "parentNodeId", "canonicalOrdinal", "childSlice", "childNodeId")}
                output = {**copy.deepcopy(owner), "selectorId": selector["id"], "consumer": consumer}
                output = self.hooks.apply("identity_output", hook_path + "/output", hook_environment, output)
                self.identity_mappings.append(output)
                consumed[node_id] = selector["id"]
            self.coverage["identitySelectors"].append({"selectorId": selector["id"], "count": len(rows)})
        remaining = {node["id"] for node in self.nodes.values() if node["nodeType"] == "identity_mapping"} - set(consumed)
        self.atom("identity.remaining", not remaining, "IDENTITY_UNCONSUMED", sorted(remaining))

    def construct_references(self):
        raw_references = []
        for index, query in enumerate(self.program["references"]):
            for row in self.query(query, f"reference:{index}"):
                raw_references.extend(self.hooks.apply("consumer_row_batch", "/typedAst/references/" + str(index) + "/consume", {"queryId": f"reference:{index}"}, [row]))
        for reference in raw_references:
            source = self.nodes.get(reference["sourceNodeId"])
            target = self.nodes.get(reference["targetNodeId"])
            self.atom("reference.source.present", source is not None, "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH", reference)
            self.atom("reference.target.present", target is not None, "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH", reference)
            # A suppressed absence contribution does not fabricate an object.
            # Unavailable coordinate atoms remain unevaluated. The reference
            # envelope below performs no endpoint dereference.
            if source is not None:
                self.atom("reference.source.slice", reference["sourceSlice"] == source["slice"], "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH", reference)
                self.atom("reference.source.projection", reference["sourceProjectionId"] == source["projectionId"], "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH", reference)
            if target is not None:
                self.atom("reference.target.slice", reference["targetSlice"] == target["slice"], "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH", reference)
                self.atom("reference.target.projection", reference["targetProjectionId"] == target["projectionId"], "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH", reference)
                self.atom("reference.target.type", reference["targetNodeType"] == target["nodeType"], "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH", reference)
                self.atom("reference.target.key", reference["targetNodeKey"] == target["nodeKey"], "REFERENCE_TUPLE_MISMATCH", reference)
        envelope = self.program["referenceEnvelope"]
        for reference in raw_references:
            row = {envelope["renameFields"].get(key, key): copy.deepcopy(value) for key, value in reference.items() if key not in envelope["validatedRedundantFields"]}
            row["referenceKind"] = envelope["kindLabels"].get(row["referenceKind"], row["referenceKind"])
            row = self.hooks.apply("reference_output", "/typedAst/referenceEnvelope", reference, row)
            self.references.append(row)

    def construct_external(self):
        result = []
        for branch_index, branch in enumerate(self.program["externalBranches"]):
            rows = []
            for index, query in enumerate(branch["queries"]):
                for row in self.query(query, f"{branch['id']}:{index}"):
                    rows.extend(self.hooks.apply("consumer_row_batch", "/typedAst/externalBranches/" + str(branch_index) + "/queries/" + str(index) + "/consume", {"queryId": f"{branch['id']}:{index}"}, [row]))
            result.extend(rows)
            self.coverage["externalBranches"].append({"id": branch["id"], "count": len(rows)})
        actual = sorted(row["sourceNodeId"] for row in result)
        expected = sorted(node["id"] for node in self.nodes.values() if node["nodeType"] == "change_dependency")
        for index, member in enumerate(expected):
            occurrence = sum(item == member for item in expected[:index + 1])
            available = sum(item == member for item in actual)
            self.atom("external.members.missing", occurrence <= available, "EXTERNAL_SET_MISMATCH", {"actual": actual, "expected": expected, "member": member, "occurrence": occurrence})
        for index, member in enumerate(actual):
            occurrence = sum(item == member for item in actual[:index + 1])
            available = sum(item == member for item in expected)
            self.atom("external.members.extra", occurrence <= available, "EXTERNAL_SET_MISMATCH", {"actual": actual, "expected": expected, "member": member, "occurrence": occurrence})
        return result

    def propagate(self):
        children = {node_id: [] for node_id in self.nodes}
        incoming = set()
        for edge in self.edges:
            if edge["propagatesGate"]:
                children[edge["parentNodeId"]].append(edge["childNodeId"])
                incoming.add(edge["childNodeId"])
        controlling = []
        for node in self.nodes.values():
            policy = self.node_rules[node["id"]]["rootPolicy"]
            if policy == "controlling":
                controlling.append(node["id"])
                node["rootRole"] = "controlling_root"
            elif policy == "noncontrolling" or (policy == "unreferenced_noncontrolling" and node["id"] not in incoming):
                node["rootRole"] = "noncontrolling_root"
        controlling = self.hooks.apply("value", "/graph/controllingRoots", {"fixtureId": self.fixture["fixtureId"]}, controlling)
        reachable = set()
        work = list(controlling)
        while work:
            node_id = work.pop()
            if node_id in reachable:
                continue
            reachable.add(node_id)
            work.extend(children[node_id])
            work.extend(node["id"] for node in self.nodes.values() if node["parentNodeId"] == node_id)
        for node in self.nodes.values():
            if "rootRole" not in node:
                node["rootRole"] = "reachable" if node["id"] in reachable else "noncontrolling_reachable"
        active, complete = set(), set()

        def effective(node_id):
            self.check("gate.acyclic", node_id not in active, "GATE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE", node_id)
            if node_id in active:
                return self.nodes[node_id]["baseGate"]
            if node_id in complete:
                return self.nodes[node_id]["effectiveGate"]
            active.add(node_id)
            values = [self.nodes[node_id]["baseGate"]] + [effective(child) for child in children[node_id]]
            result = max(values, key=lambda gate: READINESS_RANK[gate])
            self.nodes[node_id]["effectiveGate"] = result
            active.remove(node_id)
            complete.add(node_id)
            return result

        for node_id in self.nodes:
            effective(node_id)
        self.check("aggregate.controlling_roots", bool(controlling), "AGGREGATE_NO_CONTROLLING_ROOT", self.fixture["fixtureId"])
        aggregate_role = self.hooks.apply("value", "/typedAst/aggregate/rootRole", {"fixtureId": self.fixture["fixtureId"]}, self.program["aggregate"]["rootRole"])
        aggregate_roots = [node["id"] for node in self.nodes.values() if node["rootRole"] == aggregate_role]
        self.check("aggregate.selected_roots", bool(aggregate_roots), "AGGREGATE_NO_CONTROLLING_ROOT", self.fixture["fixtureId"])
        if not aggregate_roots:
            return CANDIDATE_ONLY
        operator = self.hooks.apply("value", "/typedAst/aggregate/operator", {"fixtureId": self.fixture["fixtureId"]}, self.program["aggregate"]["operator"])
        operation = max if operator == "maximum" else min
        return operation((self.nodes[node_id]["effectiveGate"] for node_id in aggregate_roots), key=lambda gate: READINESS_RANK[gate])

    def sort_key(self, collection, row):
        fields = {
            "nodes": ("slice", "sourcePointer", "nodeType", "nodeKey", "id"),
            "edges": ("parentSlice", "parentNodeId", "edgeKind", "canonicalOrdinal", "childSlice", "childNodeId"),
            "identityMappings": ("semantic_node_id",),
            "evidence": ("slice", "nodeId", "purpose", "canonicalOrdinal", "evidenceKey"),
            "externalDependencies": ("sourceNodeId",),
        }
        if collection == "references":
            key = list(canonical_bytes(row))
        else:
            key = [row[field] for field in fields[collection]]
        return self.hooks.apply("sort_key", "/graph/" + collection + "/order", {"collection": collection, "row": row}, key)

    def construct(self):
        self.construct_nodes()
        self.construct_edges()
        self.construct_identities()
        self.construct_references()
        external = self.construct_external()
        aggregate = self.propagate()
        self.coverage["typedOwnerCount"] = len(self.owners)
        self.coverage["typedOwnerTables"] = sorted({owner["table"] for owner in self.owners.values()})
        result = {
            "fixtureId": self.fixture["fixtureId"],
            "nodes": sorted(self.nodes.values(), key=lambda node: self.sort_key("nodes", node)),
            "edges": sorted(self.edges, key=lambda edge: self.sort_key("edges", edge)),
            "identityMappings": sorted(self.identity_mappings, key=lambda row: self.sort_key("identityMappings", row)),
            "evidence": sorted(self.evidence, key=lambda row: self.sort_key("evidence", row)),
            "references": sorted(self.references, key=lambda row: self.sort_key("references", row)),
            "externalDependencies": sorted(external, key=lambda row: self.sort_key("externalDependencies", row)),
            "aggregateReadiness": aggregate,
            "retentionClassification": self.hooks.apply("value", "/typedAst/aggregate/retention", {"fixtureId": self.fixture["fixtureId"]}, self.program["aggregate"]["retention"]),
        }
        return result, copy.deepcopy(self.coverage)


def compare_graph(actual, expected, disabled_checks=(), hook_plan=None):
    """Return exact, path-addressed differences without altering either input."""

    differences = []
    if disabled_checks:
        raise SemanticError("LEGACY_COMPARISON_DISABLE_FORBIDDEN", sorted(disabled_checks))
    hooks = OracleHooks({"actual": actual, "expected": expected}, hook_plan)

    def record(check_id, difference):
        emitted = hooks.apply("comparison_record", check_id, {"actual": actual, "expected": expected}, difference)
        if emitted is not None:
            differences.append(emitted)

    def walk(left, right, path):
        if type(left) is not type(right):
            record("comparison.type", {"path": path, "code": "TYPE_MISMATCH", "actualType": type(left).__name__, "expectedType": type(right).__name__})
        elif type(left) is dict:
            for key in sorted(set(left) | set(right)):
                child = child_pointer(path, key)
                if key not in left:
                    record("comparison.missing", {"path": child, "code": "MISSING_ACTUAL"})
                elif key not in right:
                    record("comparison.unexpected", {"path": child, "code": "UNEXPECTED_ACTUAL"})
                else:
                    walk(left[key], right[key], child)
        elif type(left) is list:
            if len(left) != len(right):
                record("comparison.length", {"path": path, "code": "ARRAY_LENGTH_MISMATCH", "actual": len(left), "expected": len(right)})
            for index, (left_item, right_item) in enumerate(zip(left, right)):
                walk(left_item, right_item, child_pointer(path, index))
        elif not exact_equal(left, right):
            record("comparison.value", {"path": path, "code": "VALUE_MISMATCH", "actual": left, "expected": right})

    walk(actual, expected, "")
    return {"differences": differences, "edits": hooks.edits} if hook_plan is not None else differences
